blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, attention has settled on one kind of intelligent individual, the embodied robot; we argue that the era of Physical AI holds a second kind of equal importance, the person augmented by AI. Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person. Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change. We give the paradigm a conceptual core, the cognitive gap between what a person could bring to a situation and what they can hold in working memory, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop of sensing, keeping, understanding, living alongside, acting for and thinking with the person, and growing, enclosed by a personal runtime and by trust. Because a symbiont changes what a person can do in front of others, it also raises risks of a new kind, from covert assistance in examinations to pressure on everyone to adopt it, and we treat their governance as part of the paradigm.
blocks.zh: 10年来,人工智能的进步是通过机器自己能做的多少来衡量的. 大型基础模型现在编写代码并运行多步任务,个人特工代表个人行事. 然而人们仍然忘记了自己曾经知道的事情,错过了自己不看的东西,没有找到正确的词句,在没有自身历史利益的情况下面对艰难的选择,因为能够帮助摆脱困境的机器. 当AI进入物理世界时,注意力已经固定在一种智能个体上,即被体现的机器人上;我们主张,物理AI的时代具有第二种同等的重要性,即由AI所增强的人. 人工一般智能(人工智能)询问机器的智能程度如何,与此同时,人工智能(人工智能)是人工智能强化的人类智能(人工智能),人工智能询问机器在特定人身上能够提供多少智能. 认识它需要一种新型的系统,一种认知的共鸣:一种终生的,嵌入的,实时的,私人的,低调的,以及主动的伴奏,这些伴奏能够感知人通过外部设备感受到的东西,保持他们多年的上下文,模拟他们的处境和思想,在正确的时刻参与他们的思考,用他们的背景来完成日常的任务,并且不断学习人作为两者的改变. 我们赋予这个范式一个概念核心, 一个人能给一个情况带来的东西和他们在工作记忆中能持有的东西之间的认知差距, 并组织它的设计空间,作为感知的共生循环, 保持,理解, 与人并肩生活, 为人做和思考, 并成长, 被个人的运行时间和信任所包围。 因为一个共鸣会改变一个人在别人面前能够做的事情,它也带来了一种新的风险,从在考试中暗中协助,到向每个人施压以采纳,我们把他们的治理作为范式的一部分.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : A map of the perspective paper.
Part I says why the era of Physical AI holds a second form of intelligent individual, the person augmented by AI, and what a cognitive symbiont is.
Part II follows one loop, in which the output of each section is the input of the next, with a runtime beneath it and trust around it.
Part III widens the view from one augmented individual to many.
Part IV examines the risks, how augmentation can be governed, and how the whole can be measured.
Each box names the section’s purpose and the figures, tables, and equations it contributes.
blocks.zh:
图1:展望文件地图。
第一部分说,为什么物理AI的时代有第二种形式的智慧个体,即由AI增强的人,以及认知共鸣是什么.
第二部分遵循一个循环,其中每个节的输出是下一个节的输入,其下方有一个运行时间并信任周围.
第三部分将观点从个人扩大到许多人。
第四部分审查风险、如何管理扩增以及如何衡量整体。
每个框都列出本节的目的以及它所贡献的数字、表格和方程式。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “…human brains and computing machines will be coupled together very tightly.” – J. C. R. Licklider, Man-Computer Symbiosis , 1960 ( Licklider, 1960 )
blocks.zh: “人类的大脑和计算机器将紧密结合。” – J. C. R. Licklider, Man-Computer Symbiosis, 1960 (Licklider, 1960年).

blocks.en:
For the past decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been scored on a single axis: how much a machine can accomplish on its own.
Measured on that axis, the results are substantial.
AI models now can write and review code, draft and summarize documents, search, plan, and carry out multistep tasks on a computer ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2024a ) .
Productivity at the desk, the part of work that takes place in front of a screen, has been transformed and in large part solved.
An ordinary day, however, still contains the same losses it always did, and one person’s day is enough to show them.
In the morning, working alone, a researcher has an idea that slips away before it is written down.
In the afternoon, in a meeting, a colleague asks about a result she published three years ago, and she cannot recall the number.
In the evening, facing a decision, she cannot remember how she reasoned the last time she faced one like it.
Two further losses belong to the same family: a visitor in an unfamiliar country who does not know how to decline an invitation politely, and someone who has just failed at something, who needs one sentence from a person who knows their story and receives a paragraph of generic encouragement instead.
The first three are failures of access, in which something the person already possesses fails to reach the moment in which it is needed, and the last two are gaps of knowledge and of support that the person cannot close alone at that moment; none of the five is a failure of intelligence.
In each case an AI that holds the relevant knowledge exists, and in each case it is absent from the situation: it does not know who this person is, where they are, what they are trying to do, or what they are feeling, and it has no natural way to interact and communicate with them in the moment.
Sections 9.2 , 8.6 , and 6.6 return to the three moments of this day.
blocks.zh:
在过去的十年里,人工智能的进步是在一个单一的轴心上取得的:一台机器能够独立完成多少.
以这一轴心衡量,成果是巨大的。
AI模型现在可以在计算机上写作和审查代码,起草和总结文件,搜索,规划和执行多步任务(OpenAI, 2023;Yang等人, 2024;Anthropic, 2024a).
办公桌的生产力,在屏幕前进行的工作部分,已经转变,在很大程度上得到解决。
然而,普通的一天仍然有同样的损失,一个人的一天就足以显示这些损失。
早上,一个人工作,一个研究员有一个想法,在写下来之前就溜走了.
下午,在一次会面中,一位同事询问她三年前公布的结果,她无法记得这个数字。
在晚上,面对一个决定,她不记得她上次面对这样一个人时是如何推理的.
另有两个损失属于同一个家庭:一个陌生国家的来访者不知道如何礼貌地拒绝邀请,另一个是刚刚失败的人,他需要一个知道自己的故事并接受一段一般性鼓励的人的一句话。
前三种是访问失败,其中个人已经拥有的东西无法到达需要的时候,最后两种是知识和支持的空白,即此时个人无法单独接近;这五种东西都不是智力的失败.
在每一种情况下,都存在掌握相关知识的AI,在每一种情况下,它都与情况无关:它不知道这个人是谁,他们在哪里,他们想做什么,或者他们有什么感觉,它目前没有自然的方式与他们互动和沟通.
第9.2、8.6和6.6节回到今天的三个时刻。

blocks.en:
Most readers already carry a picture of the system that would close these gaps.
In the Iron Man films, Jarvis is always present, has known its owner for years, acts while he is speaking and moving, and never asks him to stop and explain. 1 1 1 J.A.R.V.I.S. appears in Iron Man (2008) through Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015).
We use it only as a shared reference point, never as evidence. The reference is useful because it allows the subject of this perspective paper to be stated in one sentence: we are concerned with how every person could have such a system, and with how far beyond Jarvis such a system should go.
The vignette Beyond Jarvis in Section 4.2 lists six directions, of which three matter most here, and each is developed later in the paper.
Jarvis sees through a laboratory and a suit that its owner built, whereas a symbiont for everyone must see through a handful of affordable external devices, and it gains channels Jarvis never had, such as physiological signals, first-person video, and the owner’s own account, in their own words, of what they are thinking.
Jarvis mostly executes and alerts, and rarely models its owner’s goals, emotions, or blind spots, whereas the center of gravity of a symbiont is exactly that layer of mind.
And Jarvis gives almost no help with other people or other cultures, which is where a symbiont is most distinctive.
Section 4.2 makes this comparison precise.
blocks.zh:
大多数读者已经对该系统进行了描述,以弥补这些差距。
在"铁人"电影中,贾维斯总是在场,多年认识其主人公,在演讲和感动时表演,从不要求他停下来解释. 1 1 J.A.R.V.I.S.在"铁人"(2008)中出现,通过复仇者:Ultron时代(2015).
我们只把它当作一个共同的参照点,从来不当作证据。 这一提法是有用的,因为它允许在一句话中阐述这一展望文件的主题:我们关心每个人如何拥有这样一个系统,以及这样一个系统应该走多远。
第4.2节中的Vignette Beyond Jarvis列出了六个方向,其中三个方向主要在这里,每个方向在论文的后面发展.
贾维斯通过实验室和它所有者建造的西装看到,而为所有人建造的节拍器则必须通过几个负担得起的外部装置看到,它也获得了贾维斯从未有过的渠道,比如生理信号,第一人称视频,以及所有者用他们自己的话来说自己的想法。
贾维斯大多执行和提醒,很少模拟主人的目标、情绪或盲点,而共鸣的重心恰恰就是那一层心灵。
而贾维斯对其他人或其他文化几乎没有任何帮助,这就是一个韵母最独特的地方.
第4.2节使这一比较精确。

blocks.en: 1.1  The Other Half of the Endgame
blocks.zh: 1.1 国家 结局的另一半

blocks.en:
AI is leaving the screen for the physical world, and with it comes the question of what kinds of intelligent individuals that world will contain.
The answer that has drawn most of the field’s attention is the embodied robot, an AI with a body, senses, and goals of its own ( Gemini Robotics Team, 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) .
We argue that the era of Physical AI will contain a second kind of individual of equal importance: a person whose own senses, memory, and judgment are joined to an AI that lives on their body (Section 2.2 ).
This paper is a perspective on that second kind of individual.
Foundation models, world models, and methods of self-improvement enter it as enabling technologies (Section 3 ) and as replaceable components (Section 7.4 ), while the proposal itself concerns the form in which an augmented person exists and is helped.
blocks.zh:
AI正在离开屏幕去物理世界,随之而来的问题是世界将包含什么样的智慧个体.
吸引了大部分领域关注的答案是被体现的机器人,一个拥有自身身体,感官和目标的AI(双子机器人团队,2025;NVIDIA,2025).
我们争辩说,身体AI的时代将包含第二种同等重要的个人:一个人,他自己的感官、记忆和判断与生活在身体上的AI结合(第2.2节)。
本文是对这一第二类个人的看法。
基础模型、世界模型和自我改进方法作为使能技术(第3节)和可替换组件(第7.4节)输入,而提案本身则涉及增强人的存在和得到帮助的形式。

blocks.en:
The second kind of individual also changes what progress in AI is measured against, and in this sense the endgame of AI has two halves.
Artificial general intelligence (AGI) asks how intelligent the machine can be .
The other half, which we call AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI) , asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person .
The two are built on the same base: the same foundation model can act as an autonomous agent that completes tasks, or as a cognitive symbiont that augments one human being.
What differs is the object of evaluation, the mode of existence, and the relationship with the person (Figure 2 ).
This paper is entirely about the second half, and it makes two commitments to the first.
A symbiont delegates errands to standard agents (Section 9.1 ), and it improves with every gain in the base model (Section 7.4 ).
blocks.zh:
第二类个人也改变AI的衡量进度,从这个意义上说,AI的结局有两半.
人工一般智能(AGI)问机器能有多聪明.
另一半是人工智能,
两者都是建立在同一个基础上的:同一个基础模型可以起到一个完成任务的自主剂的作用,也可以起到一个能增强一个人的认知共鸣的作用.
不同之处在于评价对象,存在模式,以及与人的关系(图2).
这份文件完全是关于下半部分,它对第一个部分作出了两项承诺。
共鸣代表给标准代理人跑腿(第9.1节),随着基准模型的完善(第7.4节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : The two halves of the endgame.
AGI runs from chatbots to autonomous agents and is scored on what the AI completes.
AHI runs from reactive assistants to cognitive symbionts and is scored on what the person can now do.
Both share one base of models, agents, memory, and hardware, and both inherit every improvement to it.
A system sits on one half or the other according to what it is evaluated on, so the same chat product is a chatbot when its answers are scored and a reactive assistant when what its user can then do is scored; today the first two stages of the AHI half are still scored on what the AI produces (Table 1 ).
Arrows mark growth within a half, and the two halves are parallel, not successive stages.
blocks.zh:
图2 结束游戏的两半.
AGI从聊天员到自主代理,在AI完成的方面得分.
AHI从反应助手到认知共鸣,被评为个人现在能做什么.
两者都共享一个模型,代理,内存和硬件的基础,并且都继承了每一个改进.
一个系统根据它所评价的内容坐落在一个或者另一个上,所以同一个聊天器产品是当它的答案被打入时的聊天器,而当它的用户能够做的被打入时,一个反应助理;今天,AI半的前两个阶段仍然在AI的产生上打入(表1).
箭头在半之内标志着增长,两个半边是平行的,而不是连续的阶段.

blocks.en: 1.2  The Bottleneck Has Moved
blocks.zh: 1.2 Bottleneck 已移动

blocks.en:
A person’s cognitive bandwidth is fixed.
Working memory holds a few items, attention goes one place at a time, and a day has twenty-four hours.
The capability of AI on isolated tasks keeps rising, but the coupling between an AI and a given person has barely changed: how much the AI knows about the person, how fast it can step in, how much it interrupts when it does, and how far the person trusts it.
The result is a widening gap between what a model could contribute and what a person actually receives (Figure 3 a). The next step for personal AI is tighter coupling, and tighter coupling is a different problem from a larger model. The claim requires qualification, since coupling is itself built on strong base models; Section 3 describes which technologies first made coupling possible, and the paper opposes only the assumption that a larger base is sufficient.
Three observable symptoms mark insufficient coupling: every conversation starts by re-explaining the background, help arrives too late or too loudly, and people entrust nothing important to the system.
They point, respectively, to Sections 6 , 8 , and 12 .
Figure 3 b shows the mechanism by which the relationship nonetheless shifts: stronger models absorb more context, which lowers the cost of being understood, which moves interaction off the screen and onto the body, which produces a new kind of context, the record of a life, which makes those models more useful to that person in turn.
blocks.zh:
一个人的认知带宽是固定的。
工作记忆持有一些物品,注意力一次去一个地方,一天有24小时.
AI执行孤立任务的能力不断提高, 人工智能对这个人了解多少,能够介入的速度多快,在介入时会中断多少,以及该人对此事的信任程度有多高.
其结果是,一个模型能够起到什么作用与一个人实际得到什么之间的差距越来越大(图3a)。 个人AI的下一步是收紧耦合,收紧耦合与更大的模型不同. 索赔要求定性,因为耦合本身建立在强大的基础模型上;第3节描述了哪些技术首先使耦合成为可能,而论文仅反对一个更大的基础就足够了的假设.
3种可观察到的症状标志着耦合不足:每一次对话都从重新解释背景开始,帮助来得太迟或太大声,人们将任何对系统重要的事物托付给别人.
他们分别提到第6、8和12条。
图3b显示了关系仍然变化的机制:更强大的模型吸收更多的上下文,降低了被理解的成本,将互动从屏幕上移到身体上,产生一种新的上下文,生命的记录,使这些模型反过来对那个人更有用.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : (a) AI capability on isolated tasks keeps rising while coupling with a particular person stays nearly flat; the shaded region is augmentation that is never realized.
The curves are a conceptual sketch, not measurements.
(b) The mechanism of the shift: a causal loop in which stronger base models lower the cost of being understood, move interaction onto the body, and generate a new kind of context that makes the models more useful to each person in turn, without being used to train them.
blocks.zh:
图3:(a) 与特定人员结合的人工智能能力不断提高,但与特定人员结合几乎保持平坦;阴影区域是从未实现的增强。
曲线是概念草图,不是测量.
(b) 国家 移位机制:一个因果循环,更强大的基础模型降低被理解的成本,将交互作用移到身体上,并产生一种新的背景,使模型反过来对每个人更有用,而不被用来训练.

blocks.en: 1.3  Risk and Legitimacy
blocks.zh: 1.3 风险和合法性

blocks.en:
A system that makes a person more capable in front of other people raises questions that a system which only completes tasks does not.
When a student can recall a textbook during an examination, or a negotiator is handed a line that reads the other side’s hesitation, the gain of one person is a cost to another, and the other party usually does not know.
The same privacy that keeps the exchange between a person and their symbiont from intruding on others also hides the help from an examiner, an interviewer, or a friend.
Products built on this capability have already been sold for cheating, as Cluely was in 2025 ( TechCrunch, 2025 ) , and chatbot providers have switched off features for the duration of China’s college entrance examination ( Bloomberg News, 2025 ) .
Public attitudes toward cognitive enhancement are cautious, and the main objection is fairness ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ; Faber et al., 2016 ) .
We treat these concerns as part of the proposal.
A symbiont differs from earlier cognitive enhancements in a respect that matters for governance: it is external, removable, and inspectable, so it can follow the rules of the settings a person enters and show that it did.
Part IV develops the risks and the governance that follows from this property.
blocks.zh:
一个使一个人在其他人面前更有能力的系统提出了一个只完成任务的系统不会的问题.
当学生在考试期间可以回忆教科书,或者谈判者被交给一行读对方犹豫不决的线条时,一个人的收益是另一人的代价,另一方通常不知道.
同样的隐私使得一个人和他们的共鸣者之间的交流不被别人干涉,也隐藏了考官,面试者或朋友的帮助.
以这种能力为基础的产品已经因作弊而售出,如Cluely在2025年(TechCrunch,2025年),聊天机器人供应商在中国大学入学考试期间关闭了功能(Bloomberg News,2025年).
公众对于认知增强的态度是谨慎的,主要的反对意见是公平(Pew Research Center, 2022; Faber et al., 2016).
我们将这些关切视为提案的一部分。
共鸣与早期的认知增强在对治理很重要的方面有所不同:它是外部的,可移动的,并且可以检查的,这样它就可以遵循一个人进入的设置的规则,并显示它确实做到了.
第四部分发展这种财产带来的风险和治理。

blocks.en: 1.4  Thesis and Contribution
blocks.zh: 1.4 论文和贡献

blocks.en:
Our thesis is the following.
Realizing the second half of the endgame requires an AI that exists in a new way: a cognitive symbiont that senses what the person senses, keeps their life, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out their errands with their context in hand, and keeps learning them while both of them change.
The paper develops this thesis in four parts.
Figure 1 lays them out.
Part I (Sections 2 to 4 ) locates the paradigm historically and technically and gives it a conceptual core.
Part II (Sections 5 to 12 ) follows one loop from sensing to trust, in which the output of each section is the input of the next.
Part III (Sections 13 and 14 ) asks who gains and what a society of augmented individuals looks like.
Part IV (Sections 15 to 18 ) examines what could go wrong, how augmentation can be governed, and how the claims of the paper can be measured.
blocks.zh:
我们的论文如下。
实现结局的后半部分需要一种以新方式存在的AI:一种认知共鸣,它能感知人所感知的事物,保持他们的生活,模拟他们的处境和思想,在正确的时刻参与他们的思考,用他们手持的上下文执行他们的任务,并且在他们两人都改变的时候不断学习他们.
该论文分为四部分。
图1列出了这些内容。
第一部分(第2至第4节)在历史和技术上定位范式,并赋予其概念核心.
第二部分(第5至12节)遵循从感知到信任的一个循环,其中每个节的输出是下一个节的输入.
第三部分(第13和14节)询问谁受益,一个由增强的个人组成的社会是什么样子。
第四部分(第15至18节)审查了可能出现的问题,如何管理扩充,以及如何衡量论文中的索赔。

blocks.en:
The contribution of the paper is the paradigm itself, taken as a whole.
We name a second kind of intelligent individual for the era of Physical AI, the person augmented by AI, and a second half of the endgame of AI, AI-augmented human intelligence, which differs from the first by its object of evaluation, its mode of existence, and its relationship with the person.
We propose the cognitive symbiont as the form of system that realizes it, define it through the cognitive gap and six necessary properties, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop whose stages are each given a mechanism, a set of research questions, and a way of being evaluated.
We treat the risks of augmentation, to the person and through the person to others, as part of the paradigm, and propose that a symbiont follow the rules of the settings its owner enters and be able to show that it did.
We change the unit of evaluation from the AI to the augmented individual and state the open problems of the direction as a research program.
We propose no new algorithm; the claim of the paper is to the framing, to the organization of the design space, and to the standard of evidence it sets.
Our hope is that the concept will orient a new paradigm of AI research, one in which the measure of progress is how much more capable each particular person has become.
blocks.zh:
文件的贡献是整个范式本身。
我们为物理AI时代命名了第二类智能个体,由AI扩充的人,以及AI的下半场结束游戏"人工智能"(AI-augated human intelligence),它因其评价对象,存在模式,以及它与人的关系而与前者不同.
我们提出认知共鸣作为系统实现它的形式,通过认知差距和六个必要的属性来定义它,并组织其设计空间作为共生循环,每个阶段都给出一个机制,一组研究问题,以及一个被评价的方法.
我们把增强风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险、人的风险。
我们把评估单位从大赦国际改为扩大的个人,并将方向的公开问题说成是研究方案。
我们建议不采用新的算法;纸的主张是框架、设计空间的组织及其设定的证据标准。
我们希望,这一概念将指导人工智能研究的新模式,其中衡量进展的尺度是每个特定个人的能力有多大。

blocks.en: 2  Where We Stand
blocks.zh: 2 我们站在哪

blocks.en:
This section sets up the coordinate system used throughout the paper.
The vertical axis is the relationship: four roles the AI has played with a person, in the order in which each became technically possible.
The horizontal axis is existence: two forms an intelligent individual can take.
We then place the paper in eighty years of work on the same question and state what has changed.
blocks.zh:
本节设置了整个论文使用的坐标系统.
垂直轴是关系:AI与一个人一起扮演的4个角色,按照每个角色在技术上成为可能的顺序排列.
水平轴是存在的:智慧个体可以采取两种形式.
然后,我们将文件放在八十年的工作上,讨论同样的问题,并阐述已经发生的变化。

blocks.en: 2.1  Four Roles in Human–AI Relations
blocks.zh: 2.1 人类-大赦国际关系中的四项作用

blocks.en:
Table 1 divides the relationship between a person and an AI into four roles.
Reading down the table, three properties change together.
What the AI knows widens from the current message to a whole life.
Where the AI sits moves from a chat window to a computer, to the cloud, and finally onto the body.
And the value it offers shifts from giving the person information, to doing tasks for them, to doing those tasks their way, to making the person themselves more capable.
The first three roles share an evaluation target, the AI, and the fourth changes it to the person.
blocks.zh:
表1将一个人和AI的关系分为四个角色.
读下表,三个属性一起变化.
AI知道的东西从现在的信息扩展到整个生活.
AI坐在那里从聊天窗口向电脑,云端移动,最后到达身体.
它提供的价值从给人信息, 给他们做任务, 做这些任务的方式, 到让个人自己更有能力。
前三个角色共享一个评价目标——AI,第四个角色将其修改为人物.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Four roles in human–AI relations, ordered by the relationship with the person. Down the table the AI knows more (a message, a task, your preferences, your life), moves closer (a chat box, a computer, the cloud, your body), and its value shifts from giving you information to making you stronger. A symbiont contains the first three roles; it does not replace them.
blocks.zh: 表1:人与AI关系中的四个角色,由与人的关系所决定. 在桌子下方,AI知道更多的信息(信息、任务、你的喜好、你的生活),移动得更近(聊天箱、计算机、云层、你的身体),其价值从给你信息转向使你更强大。 一个共鸣包含前三个角色;它不会取代它们.

blocks.en:
The third role deserves an accurate description, since it is the closest existing relative of the fourth.
The personal agents released in 2026, such as Meta’s Muse ( Meta, 2026a ) , xAI’s Grok Bot ( GIGAZINE, 2026 ) , and OpenAI’s Dots ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , already track long-term goals, run continuously in the background, and learn preferences. 2 2 2 Capabilities as described at launch; we do not evaluate these products here. It would be inaccurate to describe them as systems that merely complete tasks.
The difference from the fourth role is one of position and purpose: a personal agent acts for the person from the cloud, while a symbiont thinks with the person at their side. The fourth role includes the first three. A symbiont has to be a competent autonomous agent and a competent personal agent before it can be anything more (Section 9.1 ), and the four roles can coexist inside one system.
We therefore read the table as four solutions to one problem under four technical conditions, and we avoid reading it as an inevitable sequence of eras.
blocks.zh:
第三个角色值得准确描述,因为它是第四个角色中现存最亲近的.
2026年发布的个人代理,如Meta的Muse(Meta,2026a),xAI的Grok Bot(GIGAZINE,2026),以及OpenAI的Dots(OpenAI,2026),已经跟踪长期目标,在背景中连续运行,学习偏好. 2 2 发射时描述的能力;我们不评估这些产品。 把它们说成只是完成任务的系统是不准确的。
与第四角色的区别在于位置和目的的区别:个人代理人为来自云层的人行事,而同音符则与站在他们身边的人一起思考. 第四角色包括前三角色. 共鸣必须是一个胜任的自主代理和胜任的个人代理才能成为更多的人(第9.1节),四个角色可以在一个系统内共存.
因此,我们把表格看作是在四个技术条件下解决一个问题的四种解决办法,我们避免把它看作是一个不可避免的时代序列。

blocks.en: 2.2  Two Forms of Intelligent Individuals
blocks.zh: 2.2 两种智能个人形式

blocks.en:
On the horizontal axis, we foresee, there are two ways for an intelligent individual to exist in the future world of Physical AI (Figure 4 ).
An AI-augmented individual is a real person who gains a symbiont through wearables and other interfaces.
The person remains the subject: the goals are theirs, the body is theirs, and the AI borrows their senses and their hands.
An AI as individual is an embodied robot with its own body, perception, actions, and goals.
The two forms matter equally for the future we describe, and this paper is concerned only with the first.
Our central claim about the pair is that they share a cognitive core : long-term memory, a model of the situation and of other minds, timely intervention, and learning from experience.
They differ in three places only: whose goals, whose body, and whose responsibility.
The cognitive capabilities developed in Sections 6 to 10 therefore transfer to embodied robots, and this is the source of the paradigm’s generality; Section 14.2 returns to it.
The third column of Figure 4 , AI-driven devices in the environment, appears in the paper only as the symbiont’s extended reach into the physical world (Section 14.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在水平轴上,我们预见到,在未来的物理AI世界中,智慧个体有两种方法存在(图4 ).
人工智能强化个体是指通过可穿戴性和其他接口获得共鸣的真人.
人物仍然是主题:目标是他们的,身体是他们的,AI借用他们的感官和手.
作为个人的人工智能是具有自身身体、感知、行动和目标的体现的机器人。
这两种形式对我们描述的未来同样重要,本文件只涉及第一种形式。
我们对于双胞胎的核心主张是,他们共享一个认知核心:长期记忆、情况模式和其他思维模式、及时干预和从经验中学习。
它们仅在三个方面有所不同:谁的目标、谁的身体和谁的责任。
因此,第6至第10节中发展起来的认知能力转移到了体现的机器人,这是范式通俗性的来源;第14.2节又回到了范式中。
图4的第三栏,即环境中的AI驱动装置,仅作为同义体延伸到物理世界时才出现在文件中(第14.2节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Two forms of intelligent individuals.
Left: an AI-augmented individual, a person with a symbiont that senses and speaks through wearable devices.
Middle: an AI as individual, an embodied robot.
The two share one cognitive core, indicated by the common bar.
Right, in lighter tone: devices in the environment that either form can reach into (Section 14.2 ).
The paper’s scope is the left form.
“AI as individual” is a functional description and carries no claim about consciousness or legal personhood.
blocks.zh:
图4:两种智能个体形式.
左:一个AI-Augated的个人,一个有共鸣,通过可穿戴的装置感知和说话的人.
中间:作为个人的AI,一个被体现的机器人.
两者共享一个认知核心,由共同的条表示.
对,用较轻的音调:在环境中,任一形式都可以达到的装置(第14.2节)。
论文的范围是左侧形式。
“作为个人的AI”是一种功能描述,不主张意识或法人身份。

blocks.en: 2.3  Eighty Years of the Same Question
blocks.zh: 2.3 同问八十年

blocks.en:
Using machines to augment the human intellect is an old question, and Table 2 places the paper inside that lineage. Licklider (1960) imagined people and computers thinking together in real time; Engelbart (1962) made the unit of augmentation the person together with their tools and methods; Clark and Chalmers (1998) argued that cognition can extend into external tools; Weiser (1991) and the first wearable computing researchers ( Starner et al., 1997 ; Mann, 1997 ) put computing into daily life and onto the body; and lifelogging, from Bush ’s Memex ( 1945 ) through MyLifeBits ( Gemmell et al., 2006 ) and SenseCam ( Hodges et al., 2006 ) , recorded a life and showed that the record could support memory.
More recent neighbors are egocentric AI ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , mixed-initiative interaction ( Horvitz, 1999 ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) , just-in-time adaptive interventions in mobile health ( Nahum-Shani et al., 2018 ) , the thought-partner program of Collins et al. (2024) , and the lifecycle view of context engineering ( Hua et al., 2025 ) .
For each line the table records what has been settled and what we ask next, and each of those questions is taken up in a later section.
Our claim with respect to these lines is a narrow one: none of them has taken, as its target, the augmentation of a particular person across a life.
blocks.zh:
使用机器来增强人类的智力是一个老问题,表2将纸张置于这一血统之内。 Licklider(1960年)想象着人和计算机一起实时思考;Engelbart(1962年)将人的增强单位与他们的工具和方法结合起来;Clark和Chalmers(1998年)认为认知可以延伸到外部工具;Weiser(1991年)和第一个可穿戴的计算研究人员(Starner等人,1997年;Mann,1997年)将计算放入日常生活和身体;以及生命记录,从Bush的Memex(1945年)通过MyLifeBits(Gemell等人,2006年)和SenseCam(Hodges等人,2006年),记录了一种生活,并显示记录可以支持记忆.
较近的邻居是自私自利的AI(Grauman等人,2022年;Yang等人,2025年),混合主动互动(Horvitz,1999年;Amershi等人,2019年),移动健康中适时的适应性干预(Nahum-Shani等人,2018年),柯林斯等人的思想伙伴计划(2024年),以及背景工程的生命周期观点(Hua等人,2025年).
对于每一行,表格记录了已经解决的事项和我们接下来要问的问题,每个问题将在后面一节讨论。
我们对这几条线的主张是狭隘的:其中没有任何一条是将某一个人在一生中增加作为目标。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Lineage and nearest neighbors. Each line of work has settled something this paper relies on, and the fourth column states the question we take up from it.
blocks.zh: 表2:直系及近邻. 每一行工作都解决了本文所依赖的问题,第四栏阐述了我们从中探讨的问题。

blocks.en: 2.4  Why Now
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 为什么现在

blocks.en:
Five conditions turn an eighty-year-old question into a tractable research problem, and each is developed in the next section.
Foundation models understand language, images, and sound and can reason over them, so that a symbiont has, for the first time, a brain (Section 3.1 ).
Agent technology lets a model plan, use tools, operate a computer, and run for a long time, so that it has hands (Section 3.2 ).
Long-term memory, retrieval, and context management let it keep an understanding of one person across months and years (Section 3.3 ).
World models let it begin to predict what the environment and the person will do next (Section 3.4 ).
And wearable devices have matured to the point where first-person audio and video can be captured all day and a reply can be delivered to the ear with low latency, so that the symbiont can have senses and be present (Section 3.5 ).
What has not changed matters equally: the social infrastructure of privacy and trust, the observability of inner states, the stability of continual learning, and the cost of computing around the clock.
These are the sources of Sections 12 and 17 .
blocks.zh:
五个条件将一个八十年的问题变成一个可引导的研究问题,每个条件在下一节中发展出来.
基础模型理解语言,图像,和声音,并且可以对这些模型进行推理,这样一个共鸣第一次就有一个大脑(第3.1节).
Agent Technology让一个模型计划,使用工具,操作一台计算机,并运行很长一段时间,以便它有手(第3.2节).
长期记忆、检索和上下文管理允许它保持对一个人历时数月的了解(第3.3节)。
世界模型允许它开始预测环境和个人下一步将做什么(第3.4节)。
而可穿戴的装置已经成熟到可以全天捕捉第一人称的音频和视频,并且可以低潜向耳朵发送回信,这样音节就可以有感官并存在(第3.5节).
没有改变的事物同样重要:隐私和信任的社会基础设施、内在状态的可观察性、持续学习的稳定性以及全天候计算的成本。
这些是第12节和第17节的来源。

blocks.en: 3  Technical Foundations
blocks.zh: 3个技术基金会

blocks.en:
A symbiont is built on technologies that already exist and are improving quickly.
This section reads five of them for one purpose: to state, for each, what it already provides and what it still lacks.
The gaps, collected in Table 3 , are the research space of the rest of the paper.
Figure 5 shows how the five lines stack up and where the layer this paper proposes sits.
We keep to a few representative works per line, report no benchmark numbers, and end every subsection with what the line means for a symbiont.
blocks.zh:
在已经存在并且正在迅速改进的技术的基础上,建立了共鸣。
本节读了其中的五个,目的只有一个:分别说明它已经提供和仍然缺乏什么。
表3中收集的空白是论文其余部分的研究空间。
图5显示这五行的叠加方式以及本文建议的地层位置.
我们每行保留一些有代表性的工作,报告没有基准数,每一小节结尾都用线条对韵母的意思表示.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : The stack a symbiont is built on.
From the bottom: wearable and embedded hardware, foundation models (one axis that runs from language to omni-modal to reasoning to world models), the personal runtime, the agentic harness, and the symbiont layer that this paper proposes.
The side notes record what exists today and what the paper adds at each level.
blocks.zh:
图5: 堆叠一个韵母是建立在。
从底部:可穿戴和嵌入式硬件,基础模型(一个轴线,从语言到全方位模式到推理到世界模型),个人运行时间,代理吊带,以及本文提议的共鸣层.
侧面注意到记录了今天存在的情况以及文件在每个级别上增加的内容。

blocks.en: 3.1  Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 基础模式

blocks.en:
The brain of a symbiont comes from four steps in the development of foundation models.
Scale came first: the Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , in-context learning at the scale of GPT-3 ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , and the scaling laws that made the next steps predictable ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) .
Alignment made the models usable by ordinary people in ordinary language ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , and GPT-4 ( OpenAI, 2023 ) together with openly released weights ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) spread the capability.
Reasoning followed, from chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) to models that think before they answer ( OpenAI, 2024b ; Guo et al., 2025 ) ; this is what makes the slow loop of Section 8.2 possible.
The fourth step is the one that matters most here.
Multimodal and then omni-modal models took images into the language model ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , then speech and video in real time ( OpenAI, 2024a ; Gemini Team, 2024 ) , then any-to-any input and output ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) , and full-duplex speech models learned to listen and speak at the same time ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) .
Context windows of a million tokens made the inclusion of an entire day in the context window expensive rather than impossible.
For a symbiont, omni-modality is a requirement: its input is a first-person stream of sight and sound and its output is a whisper or a line of text, and a model that only reads and writes text never reaches the scene.
What foundation models lack can be stated with equal precision.
They have no persistence, since each conversation starts from nothing; no sense of time; no body; and they are trained on the average person and know nothing about the one in front of them.
Sections 6 , 8 , 5 , and 7 answer these four gaps in turn.
blocks.zh:
韵母的大脑来自基础模型发展的四个步骤.
缩放第一:变形器(Vaswani等人,2017年),缩放GPT-3(Brown等人,2020年)规模的内文学习,以及使下一步可以预测的缩放定律(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年).
对齐使普通人能够使用普通语言的模型(Ouyang等人,2022年)和GPT-4(OpenAI,2023年)以及公开释放的重量(Touvron等人,2023年)使这种能力得到推广。
由思维链引发的原因 (Wei et al., 2022) 给那些在回答之前思考的模型(OpenAI, 2024b; Guo et al., 2025) ; 这使得8.2节的慢循环成为可能.
第四步是这里最重要的一步。
多模式模式和随后的全模式模式将图像带入语言模式(Radford等人,2021年;Alayrac等人,2022年;Liu等人,2023年),然后是实时的语音和视频(OpenAI,2024a;双子团队,2024年),然后是任意输入和输出(Wu等人,2024年;Xu等人,2025a年),以及同时学会听和说话的全复式语音模式(Défossez等人,2024年).
百万个令牌的上下文窗口使得在上下文窗口中包含一整天是昂贵的而不是不可能的.
对于一个韵母,omni-modernity是一个要求:其输入是视觉和声音的第一人称流,其输出是低语或一行文字,一个只读写文字的模型永远不会到达现场.
可以同样精确地说明缺乏什么基础模型。
他们没有毅力,因为每次谈话都从无到有;没有时间感;没有身体;他们接受普通人的训练,对他们面前的人一无所知。
第6、8、5和7节依次回答了这四个差距。

blocks.en: 3.2  Agents and Harnesses
blocks.zh: 3.2 代理人和工具

blocks.en:
An agent is a model system that repeatedly observes, thinks, and acts toward a goal.
A harness is everything outside the model that turns it into an agent: the loop itself, tool interfaces, memory, context management, planning and decomposition, permissions and sandboxing, verification of results, and reusable procedural knowledge, often called skills.
The same model placed in different harnesses performs very differently, a fact that recurs across published results on coding agents, and it makes the harness a research object in its own right.
The line of work runs from interleaving reasoning with action ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , learning to call tools ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , and reflecting on failure ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , to agents that build a library of reusable skills ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , which is an early precedent for a harness that improves itself (Section 10.4 ).
Generative Agents gave agents a memory stream, reflection, and planning ( Park et al., 2023 ) , which remains the closest academic prototype of an agent with a life, and CoALA organized these components in the language of cognitive architectures ( Sumers et al., 2024 ) .
On the engineering side, Anthropic’s guide to building agents argued for simple, composable patterns and for the agent–computer interface as something to be designed ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) ; SWE-agent showed that an interface built for the agent changes its performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; computer-use agents learned to operate any desktop or web page ( Anthropic, 2024a ; OpenAI, 2025b ) ; the Model Context Protocol standardized tool access ( Anthropic, 2024b ) ; and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex became the first autonomous agents in large-scale daily use ( Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025a ) .
In 2026 Muse and Dots pushed agents into personal life, and the Muse Gadget SDK for embedded platforms is a sign that agent platforms are reaching into devices ( Meta, 2026a ; Meta, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026 ) .
The benchmarks of the field all score task completion ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
代理是一种模式系统,它反复观察,思考,并采取行动实现一个目标.
牵引装置是模型外将它变成代理器的一切:环本身,工具界面,内存,上下文管理,规划和分解,权限和沙箱,结果的验证,以及可重复使用的程序知识,通常称为技能.
放在不同绳索上的模型 表现非常不同, 这一事实 重复了公布的结果 在编码剂上, 它使绳索 本身成为一个研究对象。
工作范围包括:与行动交互推理(姚等人,2023年),学习调用工具(史克等人,2023年),反思失败(申等人,2023年),以及建立可重复使用技能图书馆(王等人,2024年)的特工人员,这是提高自身能力的利用的早期先例(第10.4节).
Generative Agents给特工们一个记忆流,反思和规划(Park et al., 2023 ),这仍然是拥有生命的特工们最接近的学术原型,CoALA用认知架构的语言组织这些组件(Sumers et al., 2024 ).
在工程方面,Anthropic的建筑代理指南主张简单、可堆肥的图案和代理-计算机接口是需要设计的东西(Schluntz和Zhang, 2024年);SWE代理显示,为代理建造的接口改变了其性能(Yang等人, 2024年);计算机使用代理学会操作任何桌面或网页(Anthropic, 2024a;OpenAI, 2025b);模式背景协议标准化工具访问(Anthropic, 2024b);以及诸如Claude Code和Codex等编码代理成为了第一个大规模日常使用的自主代理(Anthropic, 2025;OpenAI, 2025a)。
2026年,Muse和Dots将代理推向个人生活,嵌入式平台的Muse Gadget SDK是代理平台到达设备的标志(Meta,2026a;Meta,2026b;OpenAI,2026).
球场所有积分任务完成的基准(周等人,2024;谢等人,2024;希门尼斯等人,2024;姚等人,2025;米亚隆等人,2024).

blocks.en:
For a symbiont this line provides hands.
Booking a trip, buying something, handling a desktop, writing code: today’s agents can already do these, and a symbiont delegates such work through its harness (Section 9.1 ).
Beyond delegation, a symbiont is a new kind of harness, one organized around a life instead of a task (Section 11.3 ).
Today’s harnesses are task-level: they have a beginning and an end, they are driven by requests, their tools are APIs, their memory is scoped to the task, and their score is completion.
They have no body, no first-person senses, no model of the person, and no output that means “do nothing.”
Sections 8 , 9 , and 11 take up these gaps.
blocks.zh:
对于一个共鸣 这个线提供了手。
安排旅行、购买东西、处理桌面、写字码:今天的代理人已经可以这样做了,一个共和党人通过自己的操纵来代表这项工作(第9.1节)。
除了授权之外,共鸣是一种新型的利用,一种围绕着生活而不是一项任务(第11.3节)。
今天的绳索是任务层面的:它们有始有终,它们受请求驱动,工具是API,它们的内存被限定为任务范围,它们的得分是完成.
他们没有身体,没有第一人称感,没有人的模型,也没有输出“无所作为”。 “
第8、9和11节述及这些差距。

blocks.en: 3.3  Memory, Context, and Personalization
blocks.zh: 3.3 记忆、背景和个人化

blocks.en:
Three kinds of work let a model remember a person.
Memory systems grew from retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) to MemGPT, which brought the tiered storage of an operating system into the model ( Packer et al., 2023 ) ; to the memory stream and reflection of Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) and MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) ; to A-MEM, which lets memories link to one another and evolve ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ; to Mem0, a production-oriented long-term memory layer ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) ; and to sleep-time compute, which organizes memory while the system is idle ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
LoCoMo and LongMemEval measure long-conversation memory ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Context management is the second kind: Context Engineering 2.0 describes a lifecycle of collecting, managing, and using context, and observes that the practice is shifting from prompting a model toward managing everything a long-running system knows ( Hua et al., 2025 ) ; long context, cache compression, hierarchical summaries, and on-demand loading are the engineering means.
Personalization is the third: LaMP measures generation tailored to a user ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) ; parameter-efficient adaptation makes a small module per user feasible ( Hu et al., 2022 ) ; test-time training and its descendants change weights during use ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2025 ) ; and the continual-learning literature deals with forgetting.
These are the direct foundation of Section 6 and the toolbox of Section 10 , and this paper does not require a new memory mechanism.
What the line lacks follows from what it remembers, which is dialogue rather than a life.
There is no first-person stream of sight and sound, no physiology, no distinction between what the person said and what the system inferred (Section 7.2 ), no views that switch with the question (Section 6.4 ), no distinction between short-lived context and settled knowledge (Section 6.1 ), no consistent treatment of forgetting and deletion (Section 6.5 ), and the personalization it offers optimizes for sounding like the person, which is a different thing from understanding them (Section 10.1 ).
blocks.zh:
三种工作让模特儿记得一个人
记忆系统从检索式生成(Lewis等人,2020年)发展到MemGPT,这把操作系统的分层存储带入模型(Packer等人,2023年);到基因代理(Park等人,2023年)和记忆银行(Zhong等人,2024年)的内存流和反射;到A-MEM,它让记忆相互连接并进化(Xu等人,2025b年);到Mem0,一个面向生产的长期记忆层(Chhikara等人,2025年);到睡眠时间计算,在系统闲置时组织记忆(Lin等人,2025年)。
LoCoMo和LongMemEval测量长期对话记忆(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年).
环境管理是第二类: Content Engineering 2.0描述了收集、管理和使用上下文的生命周期,并指出,这种做法正在从激励模型转向管理一个长期系统所知道的一切(Hua等人,2025年);长的上下文、缓存压缩、分级汇总和按需加载是工程手段。
个性化是第三个:针对用户定制的LAMP计量生成(Salemi等人,2024年);参数高效的适应使每个用户一个小模块可行(Hu等人,2022年);测试时间培训及其后代在使用过程中的权重变化(Sun等人,2020年;Sun等人,2025年;Behrouz等人,2025年);持续学习的文献涉及遗忘.
这些是第6条的直接基础和第10条的工具箱,本文不需要新的记忆机制.
这条线所缺少的是它所记得的,即对话而不是生活。
没有第一人称的视觉和声音流,没有生理学,没有区分人所说的话和所推断的系统(第7.2节),没有与问题切换的观点(第6.4节),没有区分短命背景和固定的知识(第6.1节),没有一致的处理遗忘和删除(第6.5节),也没有为声音提供最佳的个性化,这与理解两者是不同的(第10.1节)。

blocks.en: 3.4  World Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 世界模式

blocks.en:
A world model is an internal model that predicts what happens next.
One thread comes from reinforcement learning, where World Models and the Dreamer family plan in imagination ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) .
A second is the predictive-representation route of JEPA and V-JEPA 2 ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) .
A third is generative world simulation at the pixel level: Genie and Genie 3, Sora, and Cosmos ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) .
A fourth is first-person data, which makes the world as seen through a person’s eyes a learnable object: Ego4D ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) , Project Aria and its second-generation research glasses ( Engel et al., 2023 ; Meta, 2025a ) , and EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
A parallel thread models people.
Large foundation models show real but brittle theory-of-mind ability ( Kosinski, 2024 ; Ullman, 2023 ; Strachan et al., 2024 ) . Park et al. (2024) built a generative agent for each of 1,052 real people from a two-hour interview and found that the agents reproduced their participants’ survey answers about as well as the participants reproduced their own answers two weeks later; it is the strongest evidence to date that a predictive model of a particular person can be built from a small amount of first-person narrative.
Mental world modeling treats beliefs, intentions, and other mental variables as part of the world state itself ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) , which is the position this paper adopts for the mental side of the personal model (Section 7.5 ).
For a symbiont, world models provide the ability to think ahead: to predict what is about to happen around the person (an external, physical world model) and how the person will think, feel, and react, including to a reminder (an internal, mental world model).
Sections 7.4 and 7.5 show how both enter the personal model and why the system still stands, in a degraded form, without them.
Today’s world models are third-person, short-horizon, and built once; the models of people are built from a single interview, never updated, and unable to tell that they have gone stale.
blocks.zh:
一个世界模型是一个内部模型,可以预测接下来会发生什么.
一条线来自强化学习,其中"世界模型"和"梦想家家庭计划"在想象中出现(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018;Hafner等人, 2020;Hafner等人, 2025).
第二个是JEPA和V-JEPA 2的预测代表路线(LeCun,2022年;Assran等人,2025年)。
第三是在像素层面进行基因世界模拟:Genie and Genie 3, Sora, and Cosmos(Bruce等人,2024年;Parker-Holder and Fruchter,2025年;Brooks等人,2024年;NVIDIA,2025年).
第四种是第一人称数据,它使通过一个人的眼睛所看到的世界成为一个可以学习的物体:Ego4D (Grauman等人,2022年),Aria项目及其第二代研究眼镜(Engel等人,2023年;Meta,2025a年),以及EgoLife(杨等人,2025年).
一个平行线条模型的人。
大型基础模型展现出真实但简洁的思维理论能力(Kosinski,2024;Ullman,2023;Strachan等人,2024). Park等人(2024年)通过两小时的采访,为1052名真人每人建造了基因制剂,发现特工复制了参与者的调查答案,两周后参与者也复制了自己的答案;这是迄今为止最有力的证据,即可以通过少量第一人称叙事来构建特定人物的预测模型.
精神世界建模将信仰,意图,以及其他精神变量视为世界状态本身的一部分(Fei and Zhao, 2026),这是本文为个人模型的精神方面所采取的立场(第7.5节).
对于一个共鸣体,世界模型提供了提前思考的能力:预测人周围即将发生的事情(一种外部的,物理的世界模型),以及人将如何思考,感受,和反应,包括对一个提醒(一种内部的,心理的世界模型).
第7.4和7.5节说明了个人模式是如何进入的,以及系统为何仍然以退化的形式存在,而没有这些模式。
今天的世界模型是第三人称的,短视的,并且曾经建造过一次;人们的模型是从单一的采访中建造的,从来没有更新过,并且无法说他们已经僵化了.

blocks.en: 3.5  Wearable and Embedded Hardware
blocks.zh: 3.5 可穿戴和嵌入的硬件

blocks.en:
In three years the hardware conditions for senses and presence have changed in four places.
On the head, Ray-Ban Meta glasses showed that ordinary people will wear a camera and microphones all day ( Meta, 2023 ) ; the Orion prototype and Meta Ray-Ban Display added a display ( Meta, 2024 ; Meta, 2025b ) , lightweight display glasses such as the Even G1 appeared ( Even Realities, 2024 ) , and Project Aria serves as a research platform ( Engel et al., 2023 ) .
On the body, pendants and recorders capture all-day audio ( Mehta, 2024 ; Silberling, 2025 ; Plaud, 2024 ) , rings and bands capture physiology, and Meta’s surface-EMG wristband, published in Nature , trains a generic model on data from thousands of people so that a new wearer can type and gesture with no calibration, and twenty minutes of personal data improve it further ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) .
This is a ready-made example of a generic model with a small personal adaptation on the input side, and Section 10.3 returns to it.
Closer to the body, AlterEgo reads the muscle signals of silent, deliberate speech ( Kapur et al., 2018 ) , and brain–computer interfaces, noninvasive ( Lévy et al., 2025 ) and implanted ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ) , remain in research and early clinical stages.
In compute, neural accelerators in phones and glasses, together with quantization and distillation, run billion-parameter models on the device ( Gunter et al., 2024 ) ; low-power always-on event detection is the premise of the duty cycle in Section 5.5 ; and full-duplex speech models make listening while speaking feasible in latency.
The counterexamples are instructive as well: the Humane AI Pin, a dedicated assistant device launched in 2024, was discontinued within a year ( Zeff, 2025 ) , which suggests that a new device has to offer something the phone in the person’s pocket does not.
The first generation of senses, private output, and local compute therefore exists, and Section 5 can discuss design.
What is missing can be listed: battery and heat limit what “all day” means, display glasses are far from a shared canvas, there is no mature model from physiology to mental state, silent speech and neural interfaces are at an early stage, and above all no device has been designed as one sense of one symbiont, since each is a separate product.
blocks.zh:
三年来,感官和存在的硬件条件在四个地方发生了变化.
在头部,雷班梅塔眼镜显示普通人将全天佩戴相机和麦克风(Meta,2023年);猎户座原型和梅塔雷班显示器增加了一个显示器(Meta,2024年;Meta,2025年b),Even G1等轻量级显示眼镜出现(Even Realities,2024年),项目Aria作为研究平台(Engel等人,2023年).
在身体上,吊床和录音机捕捉全天音频(Mehta,2024;Silberling,2025;Plaud,2024),环和波段捕捉生理学,Meta的表面-EMG腕带在"自然"上发表,训练一个来自数千人的数据的通用模型,这样新穿戴者就可以无校准地打字和手势,20分钟的个人数据进一步改善(Kaifosh等人,2025).
这是一个现成的通用模型的例子,输入侧面有少量个人改编,第10.3节回归.
在身体附近,AlterEgo读到静默,刻意演说(Kapur等人,2018年),以及脑-计算机接口,非侵入性(Lévy等人,2025年)和植入性(Willett等人,2023年;Card等人,2024年)的肌肉信号,仍然处于研究和早期临床阶段.
在计算中,手机和眼镜中的神经加速器,加上量子化和蒸馏,在设备上运行了十亿参数模型(Gunter等人,2024年);低功率常发生事件检测是5.5节中值班周期的前提;全复式语音模型使得在演讲时的听力在潜伏中可行.
反例也颇具启发性:Humane AI Pin是2024年推出的专用辅助设备,在一年内停用(Zeff, 2025年),这表明新设备必须提供个人口袋里的手机没有的东西.
第一代感官,私人输出,以及本地计算因此存在,第五节可以讨论设计.
所缺少的东西可以列出:电池和热量限制“一整天”的含义,显示眼镜远非共享的画布,从生理学到精神状态都没有成熟的模型,沉默的言语和神经界面处于早期阶段,而且最重要的是,没有设备被设计成一种共振的单感,因为每种都是单独的产物.

blocks.en: 3.6  What Is Still Missing
blocks.zh: 3.6 仍然失踪的是什么

blocks.en:
Table 3 collects the five lines, what each gives, and what each lacks, and maps every gap to the section that addresses it.
The five lines are each growing stronger, and none of them has, as its goal, the augmentation of one particular person.
Organizing them toward that goal is the task of the conceptual framework in the next section.
blocks.zh:
表3收集了五行,每一行给出的,以及每一行缺乏的,并将每一个缺口都映射到解决它的部分.
五行各有增益,无一以增益为宗旨.
在下一节中,概念框架的任务是为实现这一目标而组织它们。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Five lines of technology, what each already gives a cognitive symbiont, and what it lacks. The last column maps every gap to the sections that address it; the gaps are the research space of Part II.
blocks.zh: 表3:五行技术, 每一行已经给出的认知符号, 以及它缺少的。 最后一栏将每个缺口映射到处理这些缺口的章节;这些缺口是第二部分的研究空间。

blocks.en: 4  Conceptual Foundations
blocks.zh: 4 概念基础

blocks.en:
This section gives the vision a theoretical shape.
We first define the objects, then state the invariant that runs through the paper, then list the properties a symbiont must have and test them against the fictional reference everyone knows, and finally draw the map that organizes the research space.
The pattern throughout is definition, formalization, example.
blocks.zh:
本节给予视觉理论形状.
我们首先定义物体,然后写出贯穿纸张的无变体,然后列出一个韵母必须具有的属性,并对照每个人都知道的虚构参考物来测试它们,最后绘制出组织研究空间的地图.
整个模式是定义,形式化,比如说.

blocks.en: 4.1  Definitions
blocks.zh: 4.1 定义

blocks.en: Five definitions turn the slogan “an AI that knows you better than you know yourself” into a claim that can be examined and disputed.
blocks.zh: 5种定义将“了解你比了解你自己更清楚的AI”的口号变成了可以进行审查和争论的主张。

blocks.en:
Definition 4.1: Self-context The self-context of a person h h at time t t , written C t h C^{h}_{t} , is the set of all facts bearing on their situation: what they have experienced, what they know, what they have committed to, whom they are related to and how, the state of their body, where they are, and what they are doing.
It has three parts: what can be observed from outside, O ≤ t O_{\leq t} ; what the person has said themselves, R ≤ t R_{\leq t} ; and what can be inferred from the two, K t K_{t} .
blocks.zh:
定义4.1:自定义 一个人h h 的自我写作,写作C t h c^{h}_{t}t}t},是与其处境相关的所有事实的集合:他们经历过什么,他们知道什么,他们承诺什么,他们与谁有关,他们是如何,他们的身体状况,他们在哪里,他们在做什么.
它有三个部分:从外部可以观察到什么,O ≤ t O_{\leq t}; 这个人自己说过什么,R ≤ t R_{\leq t} 从两者可以推断什么,K t t K_{t}。

blocks.en: Definition 4.2: Working context At any moment, the part of C t h C^{h}_{t} that h h can actually bring to bear is a small subset c t ⊂ C t h c_{t}\subset C^{h}_{t} , limited by working memory, attention, time, and emotion.
blocks.zh: 定义4.2:工作背景 在任何时刻,H可以实际带来的Ct h C^{h}_{t},是一个小子集c t ⊂ c_{t_{t}\subset C^{h}_{t}t},受工作记忆,注意力,时间和情感的限制.

blocks.en: Definition 4.3: Cognitive gap For a concrete situation x t x_{t} , with U U the outcome the person achieves in it, G t = U ⁡ ( x t , C t h ) − U ⁡ ( x t , c t ) , G_{t}\;=\;U\!\left(x_{t};\,C^{h}_{t}\right)\;-\;U\!\left(x_{t};\,c_{t}\right), (1) the difference between what the person could achieve with their whole self-context and what they achieve with the small part they can hold at the time.
blocks.zh: 定义4.3:认知差距 对于一个具体情况x t x_{t},随着U U, 一个人在其中取得的结果,G t = U ⁡ (x t, C t h) − U ⁡ (x t, c t), G_{t}\;=\;U\!\左(x_{t}t});\,C^{h}_{t}\r}\t}\t\r\;-\;U\t\t}t};\,c_{t}\rrightt}\r),), (1) 人用其整个自我体力所能达到的与他们当时能持有的一小部分所能达到的区别.

blocks.en:
The cognitive gap is the invariant of the paper.
It measures something other than intelligence: the price every person pays, every day, in what they forgot, failed to notice, could not think through, or could not put into words.
A researcher who, writing a new paper, cannot recall an argument she made in a blog post three years ago is paying it, and so is a parent who snaps at a child because the sleepless night is not in working memory as an explanation. The job of a symbiont is to shrink G t G_{t} : to return to the person, at the right moment, the part of their own context that is out of reach. Mind reading is not required; what is required is that the right slice of C t h C^{h}_{t} be placed into c t c_{t} , or that the reasoning or the errand the person would have undertaken, given the time, be carried out on their behalf.
blocks.zh:
认知差距是论文的不变量.
它衡量的是智力以外的东西:每个人每天付出的代价,在他们忘记的东西中,没有注意到,无法思考,或者无法用言语表达。
写新论文的研究员无法回忆她三年前在博客文章中的论点, 一个韵母的工作是缩小G t GQQT}:在正确的时刻回到个人身上,他们自己背景中无法达到的部分. 不需要心读;需要的是将C t h C^{h}_{t}的右切片放入c t_{t}t},或者根据时间,由当事人代为进行推理或差事.

blocks.en: Definition 4.4: Cognitive symbiont A cognitive symbiont is an AI system s s that (i) exists continuously across the life of a person h h ; (ii) maintains, from authorized observation and from h h ’s own statements, a model M t ≈ C t h M_{t}\approx C^{h}_{t} of h h ’s world; (iii) is present during h h ’s ongoing activities through a private, two-way channel; (iv) at each moment chooses one way of taking part from {silence, hint, suggestion, question, action on h h ’s behalf} so as to reduce G t G_{t} ; (v) learns from outcomes; and (vi) leaves final judgment and goals with h h .
blocks.zh: 定义4.4:认知共鸣 认知共鸣是一种人工智能系统,即:(一) 在一个人的一生中持续存在hh;(二) 从授权的观察和hh自己的发言中,维持一个h世界的模型Mt ≈C tC _{M_{t}\近似C^{h}_{h}_{t}t}; (三) 通过一个私人双向渠道在h正在进行的活动期间存在; (四) 在每一时刻从{沉默、暗示、建议、提问、h’行动}中选择一种参与方式,以减少Gt G_{t}t};(五) 从结果中学习; (六) 将最终判断和目标留给h 。

blocks.en: Condition (vi) is also where this paper draws the boundary that the extended mind ( Clark and Chalmers, 1998 ) leaves open for a tool that learns and takes initiative: the symbiont extends what the person can bring to a situation, and judgment and goals stay with the person.
blocks.zh: 条件(六)也是本文画出延伸的心灵(Clark and Chalmers, 1998)为学习和主动性的工具敞开的界限:共鸣将人所能带给的情况延伸,判断和目标留在人身上.

blocks.en: Definition 4.5: Augmented individual The augmented individual h ⊕ s h\oplus s is the unit of evaluation of this paper, with the augmentation gain in a situation defined as Δ aug ​ ( x t ) = U ⁡ ( x t , h ⊕ s ) − U ⁡ ( x t , h ) . \Delta_{\mathrm{aug}}(x_{t})\;=\;U\!\left(x_{t};\,h\oplus s\right)\;-\;U\!\left(x_{t};\,h\right). (2)

The definitions settle the boundary with AGI in one line: AGI raises U ⁡ ( ⋅ , s ) U(\cdot;\,s) , and AHI raises U ⁡ ( ⋅ , h ⊕ s ) U(\cdot;\,h\oplus s) .
Two cautions apply to the notation. U U is a situation-specific outcome and is never summed across situations, and ⊕ \oplus marks a coupling condition rather than an arithmetic operation.
The formulas serve to remove ambiguity, and no theorem is derived from them.

blocks.en: 4.2  Six Properties and the Jarvis Test
blocks.zh: 4.2 六个属性和贾维斯测试

blocks.en:
Table 4 lists six properties a symbiont must have.
Four of them, private, real-time, low-friction, and embedded, come directly from what makes the system usable in the middle of a life; lifelong and proactive are added because without the first the gap cannot close across time, and without the second the person cannot ask about what they do not know they are missing.
The properties pull against one another: being proactive conflicts with being low-friction, and being lifelong conflicts with being private.
Those tensions are exactly the research problems of Sections 8 and 12 .
“All day” is read throughout as availability, never as continuous computation (Section 5.5 ).
blocks.zh:
表4列出了一个韵母必须拥有的六个属性.
其中四个,私人的,实时的,低调的,和嵌入式的,直接来自什么使得系统在人生的中间可以使用;终生的和主动的被添加,因为如果没有第一个,差距无法跨时间的拉近,没有第二个,人无法问起他们不知道他们失踪了什么.
财产相互牵制:主动与低调冲突,终生与私人冲突。
这些紧张关系正是第8和第12节的研究问题。
“一整天”全读为可用,而不是连续计算(第5.5节)。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Six properties of a cognitive symbiont, and the Jarvis test. Each property is necessary; the third column says what fails without it. The properties pull against one another (proactive against low-friction, lifelong against private), and those tensions are the research problems of Sections 8 and 12 .
blocks.zh: 表4:一个认知共鸣的六个属性,以及贾维斯测试. 每一个财产都是必要的;第三栏说没有它就失败。 其特性相互牵制(主动反对低温防滑,终身反对私人),这些紧张关系是第8节和第12节的研究问题。

blocks.en:
Beyond Jarvis What Jarvis already is. Jarvis passes all six properties.
It has known its owner for years (lifelong); it lives in the laboratory, the house, and the suit (embedded); it reports and warns during combat (real-time); the voice inside the helmet is heard by its owner alone (private); it never asks him to stop and type or explain (low-friction); and it speaks up about incoming threats, energy, and injuries unasked (proactive). Where a symbiont goes beyond it. (1) Senses. Jarvis sees through infrastructure its owner built; a symbiont sees through a few affordable wearables, with channels Jarvis never had (Section 5 ).
(2) Mind. Jarvis knows schedules, systems, and the battlefield, while the center of gravity of a symbiont is the owner’s goals, emotions, and blind spots (Section 7 ).
(3) Cognitive help. Jarvis executes and alerts; it rarely helps its owner make a life decision, recover from a setback, or deal with people and cultures, which is where a symbiont is most distinctive (Sections 9.2 to 9.5 ).
(4) Growth. Across the films Jarvis’s understanding of its owner barely changes; a symbiont must understand the person better the longer the two live together, and the whole system must evolve with it (Section 10 ).
(5) Everyone. Jarvis is one person’s bespoke system; a symbiont is a paradigm for all (Section 13 ).
(6) Trust. Jarvis’s loyalty is given by the script; a symbiont’s must be given by the architecture (Section 12 ).
The subject of this paper is everyone’s Jarvis, six steps further on.
blocks.zh:
超越贾维斯 贾维斯已经是了 贾维斯通过所有六个属性.
它认识它的主人已有多年(终生);它住在实验室、房屋和衣服(嵌入);它在战斗中报告和警告(实时);头盔内的声音由主人(私人)单独听到;它从不要求他停下来打字或解释(低防爆);它谈到即将来临的威胁、能量和伤害(主动)。 凡有毗卢遮那超越. (1) 感应。 Jarvis通过基础设施查看其所有者建造的基础设施;Symbiont通过几个负担得起的可穿戴设备,而Jarvis从未拥有过这些渠道(第5节)。
(2) 发觉. 贾维斯知道时间表、系统和战场,而共鸣的中心是主人的目标、情绪和盲点(第7节)。
(3)认知帮助. Jarvis执行和警告;它很少帮助主人作出生活决定,从挫折中恢复过来,或处理人和文化,这是共鸣最独特的地方(第9.2至9.5节)。
(4)增长. 整个电影中, Jarvis 对主人翁的理解几乎没有改变; 共鸣者必须更了解一个人,
(5)诸人. Jarvis是一个人说话的系统;共鸣是所有人的典范(第13节)。
(6) 信托。 Jarvis的忠诚由剧本给予;一个韵母必须由建筑给予(第12节).
本文的主题是每个人的Jarvis,

blocks.en: 4.3  The Symbiosis Loop
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 共生循环

blocks.en:
Figure 6 is the map of the research space and the table of contents of Part II.
The person sits at the center.
Around them runs a loop: sense and interact (borrowed senses, borrowed voice, and digital traces), keep (live context, working state, and lifelong knowledge), understand (a model of the person’s situation, mind, relations, and goals, built on a replaceable backbone), live alongside (real-time, private, proactive participation, with silence as one of the formal outputs), act for and think with (the ladder of help from errands to thinking to social life, the help stage for short), and grow (learning from outcomes and updating the record, the model, the policy, and eventually the whole stack).
Beneath the loop is the runtime that makes it run across devices and time; around it is trust , which governs authorization, privacy, correction, and exit.
One feature of the figure is deliberate: the person’s own words enter the record directly, without passing through inference.
Of the technology lines in Section 3 , agents and memory research cover mostly the keep stage and the errand end of the help stage.
The weakest stages are the mental layer of understanding, the timing of participation, online learning and whole-stack evolution, and the treatment of trust as architecture.
The figure is a conceptual map rather than a system architecture, and it does not require a monolithic implementation.
blocks.zh:
图6是研究空间图和第二部分目录.
其人坐于中心.
围绕它们展开一个循环:感知和互动(借出感知、借出的声音和数字痕迹),保持(生活环境、工作状态和终身知识),理解(基于可替代的骨干构建的个人状况、思维、关系和目标的模型),并肩生活(实时、私人、主动参与、沉默作为正式产出之一),为(从工作到思考的阶梯、短暂的帮助阶段)和成长(学习成果并更新记录、模式、政策,最终是整个堆)。
环绕环路是运行时间, 让它穿越设备与时间; 环绕环路是信任,
该数字的一个特点是刻意:个人的言语直接输入记录,而不经过推断.
在第3节的技术线中,代理人和内存研究主要涵盖保持阶段和帮助阶段的外出结束。
最薄弱的阶段是理解的精神层,参与的时机,在线学习和全层进化,以及将信任作为架构对待.
该图是概念图而非系统架构,不需要单体执行.

blocks.en: 4.4  Scope and Non-Claims
blocks.zh: 4.4 范围和非索赔

blocks.en:
The paper does not claim that an AI can read thoughts that were never expressed; that everyone should wear devices all day; that a complete context is a precondition for the system to work (Section 12.2 shows it must be useful under partial context); that a symbiont outperforms the person in every domain; that the four roles of Section 2.1 are inevitable historical stages; that any one foundation model, or any one way of organizing a system around it, is the only correct backbone (Section 7.4 ); that it proposes a form of foundation model or a route to general intelligence (Section 1.1 ); that a symbiont raises a trait such as intelligence or emotional skill (Section 15.3 ); that its use is legitimate in every setting (Section 16.2 ); or that any interface standard or protocol should be adopted.
It claims that this is a research direction worth organizing on its own, with its own invariant, properties, design space, and standard of evidence.
blocks.zh:
该文件没有声称AI能够读懂从未表达过的思想;每个人都应该整天戴着装置;完整的上下文是系统发挥作用的先决条件(第12.2节表明它必须在部分上下文中有用);共鸣在每一个领域都比人好;第2.1节的四个作用是不可避免的历史阶段;任何一种基础模型,或围绕它组织系统的任何一种方式,都是唯一的正确骨干(第7.4节);它提出一种基础模型或通向一般情报的路线(第1.1节);共鸣引起一种象智能或情感技能这样的轨迹(第15.3节);它的使用在每个场合都是合法的(第16.2节);或应当通过任何接口标准或协议。
它声称,这是一个值得自己组织起来的研究方向,有其自身的变异性,属性,设计空间和证据标准.

blocks.en: Part II
blocks.zh: 第二编

blocks.en: The Anatomy of a Symbiont
blocks.zh: 共生体的解剖

blocks.en:
Part II follows the symbiosis loop of Figure 6 once around the person, and each of its sections takes the output of the previous one as its input.
Section 5 asks what the symbiont senses the person with and what it speaks through, since it has no body of its own.
Section 6 turns the resulting streams into a record with three timescales, one entry point, and many views.
Section 7 , the technical center of the paper, asks how that record becomes an understanding of the person’s situation and mind, on a backbone that can be replaced.
Section 8 turns understanding into participation at the right moment, with silence as a formal output.
Section 9 says what the symbiont does once present, on a ladder from errands to thinking to social life.
Section 10 asks how the system and the person change over many rounds, up to the evolution of the whole stack.
Beneath the loop, Section 11 describes the runtime on which all of this runs, and around it, Section 12 treats trust as part of the architecture.

第二部分沿图6的共生循环环绕人一圈,其每个部分都以上一个的输出作为输入.
第5节 问共鸣对人有何感知,言语何在,因为它没有自己的身体.
第6节将由此产生的溪流变成一个记录,有三个时间尺度,一个切入点,以及许多观点.
第7节是文件的技术中心,它询问该记录如何在可以更换的骨干上了解个人的情况和思想。
第8节将理解转化为正确的参与,沉默作为正式产出。
第9节说,共鸣者曾经在从工作到思考到社会生活的阶梯上做什么。
第十节 问系统与人如何在多个回合中变化,直到整个堆积的进化.
在循环线下,第11节描述了所有这一切运行的运行时间,围绕它,第12节将信任视为架构的一部分.
