blocks.en: 5  Sensing and Interacting
blocks.zh: 5 遥感和互动

blocks.en:
The loop of Figure 6 opens with the question of what the symbiont senses the person with and what it speaks to them through.
Hardware here is the symbiont’s borrowed body: borrowed senses on the way in, a borrowed voice and a borrowed canvas on the way out.
The borrowed hands, devices in the environment, wait until Section 14.2 .
blocks.zh:
图6的循环开启了一个问题,即共鸣对人有什么感知,对人有何感知.
这里的硬件是Symbiont借来的身体:进场时借来的感官,出场时借来的语音和借来的画布.
借用的手,设备在环境中,等待到第14.2节.

blocks.en: 5.1  Borrowed Senses, Borrowed Voice
blocks.zh: 5.1 借词、借词

blocks.en:
An embodied robot comes with eyes, ears, and a mouth.
A symbiont has none of its own and must borrow three things: the sensors on a person’s body, so that it sees what they see and hears what they hear; the person’s digital traces on screens, in documents, in code, and in messages; and a channel of output that only the person receives, a voice in the ear, a line in the glasses, a picture laid over the world.
Its perception is therefore first-person, incomplete, and moving with the person, and its speech is close to the ear, short, and tied to the setting the person is in.
The quality of the senses sets the ceiling on understanding and the quality of the voice sets the floor on help, and neither is the goal in itself.
This is also the sense in which hardware and AI are the same project, which Section 5.6 develops.
blocks.zh:
一个有内涵的机器人 带着眼睛、耳朵和嘴
一个共鸣体没有它自己的东西,必须借用三件事:一个人身上的传感器,这样它就能看到他们所看到和听到的;这个人在屏幕上的数字痕迹,在文件上,在代码上,在信息中;以及只有一个人得到的输出渠道,在耳朵里发出声音,在眼镜里发出线条,一张布满世界的图片.
因此,它的感官是第一人称的,不完整的,和人一起移动的,它的言语接近耳,很短,与人的设定联系在一起.
感官的质量为理解设定了上限,声音的质量为地板设定了帮助,而目标本身也不是.
这也是硬件和AI是同一项目,第5.6节发展起来的感受.

blocks.en: 5.2  The Device Constellation
blocks.zh: 5.2 设备星座

blocks.en:
No single device can carry all of this, so a symbiont senses and speaks through a constellation (Figure 7 ): glasses with a first-person camera, microphones, eye tracking, and a one-line display; a pendant or pin that records audio and takes snapshots all day and stands in when glasses are not worn; earbuds or bone conduction for private voice output; a microphone close to the mouth so that the person can speak to it at the level of a breath without being overheard; a ring, watch, or band for heart rate, sleep, and activity, and increasingly for EMG gestures; a phone for compute and a screen on the move; and a desktop with authorized access to screen content, the IDE, documents, and meeting software.
Each device carries a role on the way in, on the way out, or both, and a runtime (Section 11 ) manages them as one.
Table 5 lists the signal sources and what each reveals about the physical and the mental side of a life.
blocks.zh:
没有任何单个设备能够携带所有这些,所以一个共鸣感官和通过一个星座说话(图7):戴着第一人称相机、麦克风、眼睛跟踪和单线显示的眼镜;一个记录全天录音和快照并在没有戴眼镜时站在那里的圆柱或圆针;一个用于私人语音输出的耳机或骨导线;一个靠近口腔的麦克风,使人能够在呼吸的层次上说话,而不会被听到;一个环、表或带用于心率、睡眠和活动,而且越来越多地用于EMG手势;一个用于计算和移动时显示屏幕的电话;以及一个可授权进入屏幕内容、IDE、文件和会议软件的桌面。
每个设备在进场、出场或两者兼而有之,运行时间(第11节)将它们作为一体管理。
表5列出了各种信号源,以及每个信号源揭示的人生的身心方面。

blocks.en:
Two further classes of device belong in the constellation even though they are not yet in daily use, and the first of them may become the most valuable wearable of all.
Neural interfaces read the body’s own signals of intention and attention.
At the surface of the body, EMG wristbands already decode the motor commands behind typing and gesture ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) , and electrodes in a headband or around the ear record the electrical activity of the brain, in many studies with results comparable to scalp recording ( Kaongoen et al., 2023 ) ; implanted interfaces, now in early clinical trials, decode attempted speech at far higher fidelity ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ) .
For a symbiont these interfaces matter for a specific reason.
They are the channel through which a deliberate command could one day reach the symbiont without being spoken, typed, or acted out, at a lower cost to the person than any other channel.
What they may read is held to the rule of every input channel (Section 5.4 ): commands the person directs to the symbiont, with states such as attention or fatigue read only under separate authorization.
They are also the channel in which the privacy of thought (Section 12.4 ) is at its most literal, so the paper places them at the far end of the constellation, with the highest ceiling and the strictest conditions, and treats their maturation as part of the hardware problem of Section 17.4 .
The second class is the environment itself: cameras and microphones in the home, the cabin sensors and head-up display of a car, the instruments of a laboratory, eye-tracking contact lenses, haptic garments, and medical implants such as continuous glucose monitors.
These enter the constellation on the same terms as the wearables, each with a role on the way in or out, separate authorization, and management by one runtime, and they are where the symbiont’s senses turn into reach (Section 14.2 ).
We therefore treat the full list of modalities in three tiers.
Sight, sound, text, and digital traces are the bulk of what is usable today; physiology, motion, and gaze are collectable now and need research into their interpretation; and neural signals run from available, in surface EMG, through research, in non-invasive recording, to distant, in implanted interfaces, with the chemical senses furthest of all.
“Omni” means that whatever signal arrives can be used; it does not require that every signal be collected.
blocks.zh:
另外两类设备虽然尚未投入日常使用,但都属于星座,其中第一类设备可能成为所有设备中最有价值的可穿戴设备.
神经界面读取身体自身的意向和注意力信号.
在身体表面,EMG腕带已经解码了打字和手势背后的电动机指令(Kaifosh等人,2025年),头带或耳周围的电极记录了大脑的电活性,在许多研究中,结果与头皮记录相当(Kaongoen等人,2023年);植入接口,现在在早期临床试验中,解码了在远高忠诚度的尝试演说(Willett等人,2023年;Card等人,2024年)。
对于一个韵母来说,这些接口具有特定的原因。
它们是一个渠道,通过这个渠道,某一天,一个蓄意的指令可以到达共鸣区,而无需说话、打字或行动,对人的成本比任何其他渠道都要低。
他们可能读到的都是每个输入通道的规则(第5.4节):命令人直接到音节上,注意或疲劳等状态只在单独的授权下读取.
它们也是思想隐私(第12.4节)在最字面上的渠道,因此纸张把它们放在星座最远的一端,有最高的上限和最严格的条件,并将它们的成熟作为第17.4节硬件问题的一部分.
第二类是环境本身:家中的摄像头和麦克风,机舱传感器和车头展示,实验室的仪器,眼睛跟踪隐形眼镜,偶然的服装,以及连续的葡萄糖监视器等医学植入.
它们以与可穿戴物相同的条件进入星座,每个星座在进出途中都有一个角色,单独授权,管理一次,它们也是共鸣感变为伸展的地方(第14.2节)。
因此,我们把模式的完整清单分为三个层次。
视觉、声音、文字和数字痕迹是今天可以使用的大部分内容;生理学、运动和视线现在可以收集,需要对其解释进行研究;神经信号从现有的、在表面的EMG、通过研究、在非侵入性记录、到遥远的、植入的界面,到最远的化学感知。
“Omni”是指可以使用任何信号;它并不要求收集每一个信号。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : The device constellation.
Each device carries a role on the way in (sensing, private input) or on the way out (private output, shared canvas), and often both; a runtime manages them as a single set of senses.
The symbiont itself has no body and borrows every one of them.
Neural interfaces and the devices of the environment are the far end of the constellation.
blocks.zh:
图7:装置星座.
每个设备在进场(感知,私人输入)或出场(私人输出,共享画布)的路上都扮演一个角色,而且往往两者兼而有之;运行时间将它们作为一组感官管理.
节奏本身没有身体,每借一次.
神经界面和环境的装置是星座的远端.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Signal sources and what each reveals about the physical and the mental side of a life. “Omni” means the system can take whatever signal arrives; it does not mean every signal must be collected. The two sides of the table anticipate Section 7.1 ; the last column is the horizon on which each source becomes usable.
blocks.zh: 表5:信号源和每个信号显示的关于生命的身心方面。 “Omni”是指系统能够接收到的任何信号;并不意味着必须收集每一个信号。 表格的两侧预测第7.1节;最后一栏是每个来源可使用的视野。

blocks.en: 5.3  Channels Out
blocks.zh: 5.3 频道关闭

blocks.en:
How the symbiont speaks to the person decides whether it can be used at all in a given setting, so output deserves the same attention as input.
Table 6 lists the channels, from a word in the ear to a picture projected into a room.
Three design rules follow.
The strength of a message must match the setting: a line of text in a meeting, a sentence while walking, an expanded answer when the person is alone; and since the choice of channel is part of how the symbiont helps, it is one of the decision variables of the intervention policy in Section 8.4 .
A private channel and a shared canvas are different instruments: the first lets the person receive help among people without disturbing them, the second lets the person and the symbiont, or the person and other people, look at the same picture and think about it together, and this second instrument, Jarvis’s holographic table, earns its place in collaboration and explanation.
And every channel must support retraction and update: a cue that expires before delivery should never appear, and one overtaken by new information must be withdrawn (Section 8.2 ).
The AR overlay deserves separate mention, because it is where the symbiont can draw its understanding onto the world the person sees: a name and the last topic discussed next to the person in front of them, the paragraph relevant to what they are thinking highlighted on the document on the desk, a route laid over a street in a city they do not know.
Current single-eye displays with small fields of view make the first of these feasible today, and wide-field lightweight AR remains a research problem.
blocks.zh:
音节是如何对人说话的,决定它是否能够在特定的环境下使用,因此输出值得与输入一样的关注.
表6列出了各种渠道,从耳边一个字到投射到房间的照片。
设计规则有三条
消息的强度必须和设定相匹配:会议中的文字行,行走时的句子,一个人孤独时的扩展答案;由于选择通道是共鸣帮助方式的一部分,因此它是第8.4节干预政策的决定变量之一.
一个私人频道和一个共享的画布是不同的乐器:第一乐器让个人在人们中间得到帮助而不会打扰他们,第二乐器让个人和共鸣者,或者个人和其他人一起看一看,一起思考,第二乐器,贾维斯的全息表,在协作和解释中赢得了它的位置.
每个频道必须支持收回和更新:一个在交货前到期的提示绝不应出现,一个被新信息取代的提示必须撤销(第8.2节)。
AR 覆盖部分值得单独提及,因为它可以让共鸣者了解所看到的世界:在他们面前的人旁边讨论的名字和最后一个话题,与他们在书桌文件上强调的想法有关的段落,一条他们不知道的城市街道上的路线。
目前带有小视野的单眼显示器使得这些今天的第一种可行,而广域轻量级AR仍然是一个研究问题.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Channels out, and when each fits. The private channels (first three rows) deliver help to the person alone, discreetly where the setting allows; the shared canvas (last row) lets the person and the symbiont, or the person and other people, look at the same picture. Jarvis’s holographic table belongs to the last row.
blocks.zh: 表 6:通道断裂,每个通道合时. 私人频道(前三行)向个人单独提供帮助,在设置允许的地方谨慎地提供帮助;共享的画布(前一行)让人和共鸣,或者人和其他人看同一张照片. 贾维斯的全息表属于最后一行。

blocks.en: 5.4  Private Channels
blocks.zh: 5.4 私人频道

blocks.en:
Privacy, as a property, has two parts that the design keeps apart: what passes between the person and the symbiont belongs to the person, and its delivery can be discreet, so that the person can speak to the symbiont and hear from it without disturbing anyone nearby.
On the way in, this means a breath-level microphone, very short gestures (an EMG band removes the need to raise a hand), and typed text; silent speech from muscle signals and neural interfaces lie further out, and the boundary we keep is the one AlterEgo marks, since it reads what a person deliberately subvocalizes and nothing else ( Kapur et al., 2018 ) , a rule that binds a neural interface as much as a microphone.
On the way out, it means in-ear voice, a line in the glasses, and haptic cues, with strength and content matched to the setting.
Three requirements that sound alike must be kept apart.
That the content of the exchange stays the person’s is what the paper requires.
That its delivery is discreet is a capability whose use follows the setting: where a setting presumes unaided performance or the sincerity of what is said, as an examination, a negotiation, or an apology does, whether the person is being assisted becomes a declarable fact, and declared presence is the default there (Sections 16.1 and 15.5 ).
That a device record other people without their knowledge is what the paper rejects, and Section 12.5 sets the rules.
blocks.zh:
隐私作为一个财产,有两个部分是设计所分开的: 人与音节之间的传递属于人,其传递可以是谨慎的,这样人就可以向音节说话,从中听到,而不会打扰附近的任何人.
在进场途中,这意味着一个呼吸级的麦克风,非常短的手势(一个EMG乐队取消了举手的需要),并打出文字;来自肌肉信号和神经界面的无声讲话更进一步地排出,我们所保持的边界是AlterEgo标记,因为它读到的是一个人故意潜伏的东西和别的东西(Kapur等人,2018年),这个规则像麦克风一样束缚神经界面.
出道时,意思是耳朵内的声音,眼镜中的一条线,以及偶然的提示,其强度和内容与设定相匹配.
声音相同的三项要求必须分开。
交换的内容必须保留在个人的纸上。
交付是谨慎的,其使用符合以下条件:一种环境假设,如检查、谈判或道歉,所言的无助表现或诚意是否属实,无论该人是否正在得到援助,都成为可申报的事实,而且宣布的存在是默认的(第16.1和15.5节)。
这个装置记录了其他人的不知情情况,这是报纸拒绝的,第12.5节规定了规则。

blocks.en: 5.5  Always On
blocks.zh: 5.5 总是打开

blocks.en:
Companionship around the clock translates into a system requirement of availability: the symbiont can be reached and can pick up at any moment, which is a different thing from computing at full load at every moment.
Battery life and latency are the two hard constraints, and the design that reconciles them is a cognitive duty cycle .
Most of the time only lightweight event detection runs: someone says the person’s name, a meeting begins, their stress rises, they whisper.
An event wakes heavier computation, and the quiet hours of the night are used for offline consolidation (Section 6.3 ).
The structure mirrors human attention, which is also not continuous.
It yields three research quantities: the recall and false-alarm rate of event detection, the latency budget from an event to a useful cue, and the daily energy and thermal budget.
Low latency has to be written as an end-to-end budget: how many milliseconds each stage may take from sensor to model to ear, which stages can run on the device and which must go to the cloud, and which can be prepared in advance so that the fast loop of Section 8.2 finds its material ready.
The duty cycle is also the first answer to the concern that round-the-clock AI depends on enormous compute; it turns the concern into an engineering quantity, and Section 11.4 completes the argument.
blocks.zh:
昼夜伴奏会转化为对可用性的系统要求:共鸣可以到达,随时可以接动,这与每时每刻的满载计算不同.
电池生命和耐用性是两个硬性制约, 调和它们的设计是一个认知任务周期。
多数时候只有轻量级事件侦测,
事件会更重的计算,夜晚的安静时间用于离线合并(第6.3节)。
结构反映了人类的注意力,这种注意力也不是连续的.
它产生三个研究量:事件探测的召回率和假警报率、从事件到有用提示的延迟预算以及日常能量和热能预算。
低延迟必须写成端到端的预算:每个阶段从传感器到模型到耳朵可能需要多少毫秒,哪些阶段可以在设备上运行,哪些阶段必须到云端,哪些阶段可以预先准备,这样8.2节的快速循环才能找到其材料.
值班周期也是对全天候AI依赖巨大计算这一担忧的第一个答案;它将关注转化为工程量,第11.4节完成了论证.

blocks.en: 5.6  Co-Evolution of Hardware and Models
blocks.zh: 5.6 硬件和模型的共同演变

blocks.en:
The form of the senses will change with the capability of the models, and the training targets of the models will change with new senses.
From today’s recorders and glasses to EMG bands, silent speech, and eventually neural interfaces, each step makes it easier for the AI to understand what a person has in mind, and each step raises the level of privacy at stake.
Two judgments follow from the recent record.
A dedicated device that adds little to the phone does not last, as the AI pin of 2024 did not ( Zeff, 2025 ) , and a cognitive core without the right hardware never reaches the scene.
Hardware and the core are one design problem, and Section 10.4 treats a change of device as one of the ways the whole stack evolves: the person changes their glasses, and their symbiont is still theirs.
blocks.zh:
感官的形式会随着模型的能力而改变,模型的训练目标也会随着新的感官而改变.
从今天的录音机和眼镜到EMG乐队,无声的演说,以及最终的神经界面,每一步都让AI更容易理解一个人的心思,每一步都提升了关乎隐私的水平.
两项判决来自最近的记录。
由于2024年的AI pin没有(Zeff, 2025), 而没有正确硬件的认知核心也从未到达现场,
硬件和核心是一个设计问题,第10.4节将设备的改变视为整个堆积进化的方式之一:人改变眼镜,他们的韵母仍然是他们的.

blocks.en: 6  Personal Context and Lifelong Knowledge
blocks.zh: 6 个人背景和终身知识

blocks.en:
The senses of Section 5 deliver streams.
This section asks how streams become something a symbiont can use: the live context of what the person is doing now, and the knowledge that stays valid across years.
The two words are not interchangeable.
Knowledge is what has settled; context is what is current, from the project the person is working on this week to the scene the glasses see this second.
Both must be kept, and the claim that organizes the section is that one entry point has to receive all of a person’s context, work and life together, for the picture of the person to be rich enough for cognitive-level help.
blocks.zh:
第5节的感官传递着溪流.
本节询问溪流是如何成为一个共鸣体可以使用的东西的:一个人现在所做的活的上下文,以及多年来一直有效的知识.
此二字不可互换.
知识是已经解决的;背景是当前的情况, 从这个人这个星期的工作项目到现场,眼镜看到的是第二个。
两者都必须保持,组织这一节的主张是,一个切入点必须接收一个人的所有背景、工作和生活,这样一个人的照片就足够丰富,足以提供认知层面的帮助。

blocks.en: 6.1  Three Timescales of One Record
blocks.zh: 6.1 一个记录的三个时间尺度

blocks.en:
Context is information relevant to what the person is doing now.
It is short-lived, high-volume, and mostly discarded once used: where this conversation has got to, which file is open in the editor and which error it stopped on, what the glasses can see and who is present, what is on today’s calendar. Knowledge is what has settled out of many contexts and stays relevant across them.
It is long-lived, curated, and comparatively small: facts about the person and their world, relationships, preferences, commitments, their history, the reasons they gave for things.
Between the two lies a third layer, working state , which lives for days or weeks: the project being pushed forward, the discussion that has not been closed, the decision due this week.
The project tree in which events and projects organize one another belongs here.
Two flows connect the three layers (Figure 8 ).
Consolidation moves material upward, from context to working state to knowledge, through the filtering and merging of Section 6.3 .
Recall moves material downward, placing the right slice of knowledge into the context of the moment, which is exactly the step from C t h C^{h}_{t} to c t c_{t} in Definition 4.1 .
When one word is needed for the whole we write the record .
blocks.zh:
有关情况与此人目前的行为有关。
它寿命短、容量大,而且大部分在使用后被丢弃:这次谈话的目的地、编辑器打开的文件、停止的错误、眼镜可以看到的、谁在场、今天日历上的内容。 知识是许多背景所决定的,在其中仍然具有相关性。
它具有悠久的寿命,有典故,而且相对较小:关于个人及其世界的事实,关系,偏好,承诺,他们的历史,他们给事物的原因.
两层是第三层, 工作状态, 持续数天或数周: 工程推进,
活动和项目相互组织的项目树属于这里.
二流连接三层(图8).
通过过滤和合并第6.3节,合并使材料向上,从上下文到工作状态到知识。
回顾材料向下移动,将正确的知识片段放在瞬间的背景中,这正是定义4.1中从Ct h C^{h}_{t}到ct c_{t}的步骤。
当需要一个词 整个我们写记录。

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : Three timescales of one record.
Live context is large and mostly discarded, working state holds projects and open threads for days to weeks, and knowledge is small, curated, and persistent.
Consolidation moves material up; recall moves the right slice down into the working context c t c_{t} of Definition 4.1 .
blocks.zh:
图8:一个记录的三个时标。
生活环境大而大部分被抛弃,工作状态会维持项目和开放线条长达数天到数周,知识也很小,被整理,且具有持久性.
合并将材料向上移动;召回将右切片移到定义4.1的工作背景c t _{t}。

blocks.en:
The word context is also used for the input window of a language model, and in context engineering it refers to the information given to a model so that the model can complete a task ( Hua et al., 2025 ) .
Personal context, as used here, is information about the person that is valid now, and its lifecycle serves a person’s life.
The two meet at the recall step: injecting personal knowledge into a model’s context window is an act of context engineering.
We borrow the lifecycle view and nothing else.
blocks.zh:
上下文也用于语言模型的输入窗口,在上下文工程中,它指的是提供给模型的信息,这样模型就可以完成一个任务(Hua等人,2025年).
个人背景,如这里所使用的,是目前有效的个人信息,其生命周期服务于一个人的生命。
两人在召回阶段相遇:将个人知识注入模型的背景窗口是一种背景工程行为.
我们借用了整个生命周期的风景,没有别的了。

blocks.en: 6.2  One Entry Point for Every Context
blocks.zh: 6.2 每个背景都有一个切入点

blocks.en:
Table 7 lists the sources of personal context and what each sees on its own.
Each sees a partial person.
A chat assistant knows someone who asks questions, a coding assistant knows a programmer, a desktop agent knows someone at work, and a band knows a body with a heart rate.
Questions that matter for cognitive-level help cross these boundaries: why the person was unproductive in the editor this morning (they slept five hours and the first meeting went badly), how this decision relates to the one they made six months ago, whether the stress the band sees matches the deadline the desktop sees. Only an entry point that receives every source into one record can answer such questions, and only such a record supports a picture of the person rich enough for the help described in Section 9 . The same observation has a consequence for the runtime of Section 11 : it must be a layer across devices and applications, and it cannot be any one application.
Receiving every source is a capability of the entry point and never the default for collection.
Each source is authorized separately, the symbiont must be useful at low levels of authorization (Section 12.2 ), and the privacy column of the table exists for that reason.
This is also what separates the proposal from one more memory layer: memory research records the conversations of a single entry point, whereas the record here spans all of a person’s entry points.
blocks.zh:
表7列出了个人背景的来源以及每个人自己看到的。
每个都看到一个部分的人。
一个聊天助理认识一个提问的人,一个编码助理认识一个程序员,一个桌面代理认识一个在工作的人,一个乐队认识一个有心率的身体.
对于认知层面很重要的问题会帮助跨越这些界限:为什么这个人在今天上午的编辑中毫无成果(他们睡了5小时,第一次会面也糟糕),这个决定和他们六个月前所做的决定有何关系,乐队看到的压力是否与桌面看到的最后期限相符. 只有从每个来源得到一个记录的切入点才能回答这些问题,只有这样一个记录才能证明一个人的丰富情况,足以提供第9节所述的帮助。 同样的意见对第11节的运行时间产生了影响:它必须是跨设备和应用程序的一层,不能是任何一个应用程序。
接收每个来源是进入点的能力,绝不是收集的默认.
每个来源都是单独授权的,韵母必须在低授权水平上有用(第12.2节),因此表的隐私栏存在.
这也是将提案与另一个记忆层区分开来的原因:记忆研究记录了单个切入点的对话,而这里的记录覆盖了一个人的所有切入点。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Sources of personal context, and what each sees on its own. A chatbot knows a questioner, a coding assistant knows a programmer, a desktop agent knows an office worker, a band knows a body with a heart rate. Only one entry point that joins them can answer questions that cross the boundaries. Each source is authorized separately (Section 12.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表7:个人背景的来源,以及每个人自己看到的。 聊天员知道问话员,编码助理知道程序员,桌面代理知道办公室工人,乐队知道一个有心率的身体. 只有加入它们的一个切入点才能回答跨越边界的问题. 每个来源分别授权(第12.2节)。

blocks.en: 6.3  From Streams to a Record
blocks.zh: 6.3 从流到记录

blocks.en:
Three stages turn raw streams into knowledge.
At the front, on the device and at the edge, filtering drops what is high-frequency, volatile, and not worth keeping and forwards the rest.
At the back, storage absorbs frequent writes and updates and grows large.
The third stage is periodic offline consolidation, which plays the role that sleep plays for human memory: in idle hours it merges the day’s fragments into events, files events into projects, promotes repeated patterns into stable knowledge, and demotes what has expired.
Sleep-time compute and memory systems in which memories link and evolve are technical precedents ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) , and the rhythm resolves the tension between filtering at the front and accumulation at the back.
Scale forces a decision about fidelity.
A day of first-person audio and video runs to gigabytes and a life to petabytes; keeping everything is impossible and unnecessary.
Raw streams are kept briefly; event-level summaries and indices of when and where something of a given kind happened are kept for the long term; knowledge entries carry pointers back to their sources.
The underlying difficulty is that what will matter later is unknown now, and the compromise is a low-fidelity index that allows the past to be revisited.
Section 17.4 lists modeling a life’s record at this scale as the first open problem.
blocks.zh:
三个阶段将原始溪流转化为知识.
在前部,设备上和边缘,过滤会降低高频,挥发,不值得保持和前进的其余部分.
在背面,存储会吸收频繁的写作和更新,并长大.
第三个阶段是定期的离线整合,它扮演着睡眠为人类记忆所扮演的角色:在闲置的时间里,它将当天的碎片合并为事件,将事件记录为项目,将重复的规律推广为稳定的知识,并将过期的东西降级.
睡眠时间计算和记忆连接和进化的记忆系统是技术先例(Lin等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年b),节奏解决了前部过滤和后部积累之间的紧张关系.
规模决定了忠诚
一天的第一人称音频和视频运行到千兆字节,生活到百兆字节;保存一切是不可能和不必要的.
原始流得到简短保存;事件一级摘要和特定事件发生时间和地点的指数长期保存;知识条目将指针带回源头。
根本的难题是,以后的事情现在还不得而知,折衷方案是低忠诚指数,允许重新审视过去。
第17.4节将模拟这种规模的生命记录列为第一个公开问题。

blocks.en: 6.4  One Life, Many Views
blocks.zh: 6.4 " 一个生命,许多 " 视图

blocks.en:
The organizing claim of the section is that the same record is projected into different views depending on the question, and that any view can be switched to at any time (Figure 9 , Table 8 ).
A logic view arranges events and projects as a tree that grows into a graph; a domain view separates work, life, family, and health; a person view separates what concerns the person from what concerns others; a lifetime view separates stable knowledge from passing state, which aligns with the three timescales above; a chronological view orders by when something happened, when it was learned, and whether it still holds; and a physical/mental view separates what happened from how it felt.
Views are projections of one store: the record underneath is one, and a view is generated by the question.
The logic view is the main thread, and a life is never forced into a single tree.
MyLifeBits offered multiple views for retrieval ( Gemmell et al., 2006 ) ; here views also serve understanding (Section 7 ) and the person’s own inspection and correction of what is held about them (Section 12 ).
The paper specifies requirements on representation and retrieval and does not prescribe a graph or a vector store.
blocks.zh:
本节的组织主张是,根据问题的不同,同一记录被投射到不同的观点中,任何观点都可以随时切换(图9,表8)。
逻辑观点将事件和工程安排为树,生长成图;域观将工作,生活,家庭,健康区分开来;人观将人所关心的事物与他人所关心的事物区分开来;终身观将稳定知识与过去状态区分开来,这与上面三个时间尺度一致;按时间顺序排列某事发生时,何时得知,以及是否仍然持有;体力/精神观将发生的事情与感觉区分开来.
观点是一商店的预测:下面的记录是一商店,问题产生一个视图。
逻辑视图是主线,生命从不被迫进入单一树.
MyLifeBits为检索提供了多种观点(Gemmell等人,2006年);这里的观点还有助于理解(第7节),有助于个人自己检查和纠正对他们的看法(第12节)。
文件具体规定了对表示和检索的要求,没有规定图表或矢量储存。

blocks.en:
Figure 9 : One life, many views.
The same handful of events (a meeting, a family plan, a bad night’s sleep) appears in six views, by logic, domain, person, lifetime, time, and nature.
The views are projections of one record and can be switched at will.
blocks.zh:
图9:一个生命,许多观点.
从逻辑、领域、人、寿命、时间和自然等六种观点来看,
这些观点是对一个记录的预测,可以随意切换。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Views of the record and the questions they answer. Views are projections of one store: the record underneath is one, and a view is generated by the question being asked.
blocks.zh: 表8:对记录的看法及其回答的问题。 观点是一商店的预测:下面的记录是一商店,所问问题产生一种观点。

blocks.en: 6.5  Updating, Forgetting, and Repair
blocks.zh: 6.5 更新、忘却和修理

blocks.en:
Frequent updating raises four problems: conflict, change, forgetting, and repair.
Conflict between old and new is handled by keeping three times apart: when something happened, when the system learned it, and until when it holds.
Change is the second, since preferences change, relationships change, and commitments are kept or cancelled, and the record has to follow them without losing the history.
Forgetting, the third, comes in two kinds, decay that reduces noise and deletion that respects the person’s wishes, and deleting a raw record does not delete the summaries and judgments derived from it; the paper states the consistency requirement and leaves the mechanism open.
Repair is the fourth.
When the person says “you misunderstood me”, the system must locate the layer in which the misunderstanding lives, a fact, a reason, a current goal, or a long-term preference, and propagate the correction to the entries inferred from it and to the advice already given; changing its answer in the conversation is only the first step.
This gives a measurable quantity: the half-life of an error in the record, and the number of inferences it reached before it was corrected.
Section 10.4 returns to the related question of what survives when the base model is replaced.
blocks.zh:
频繁更新提出了四个问题:冲突、变化、遗忘和修复。
新旧之间的冲突通过保持三次的距离来解决:当事物发生时,当系统得知时,直到它保持时.
变化是第二个,因为优惠改变,关系改变,承诺被保留或取消,记录必须遵循,而不失去历史.
第三种是遗忘,它分两种,衰变减少了噪音,删除了尊重个人愿望的内容,删除原始记录不会删除由此而产生的摘要和判断;该文件阐述了一致性要求,并留下了机制。
修行为第四.
当一个人说“你误解了我”时,系统必须找出误解所存在的层次、事实、原因、当前目标或长期偏好,并宣传从中推断出的条目和已经给出的建议的更正;在谈话中改变答案只是第一步。
这给出了一个可计量的数量:记录中一个错误的半衰期,以及更正前得出的推断数量.
第10.4节回到了基准模型被替换后生存的相关问题。

blocks.en: 6.6  Remembering the Future, and the Reasons
blocks.zh: 6.6 记住未来和原因

blocks.en:
A record holds more than the past.
It holds commitments, plans, the question to ask someone at the next meeting, decisions still forming, and the longer view of who the person wants to become.
Psychology calls this prospective memory; it is the kind of memory people fail at most often, and it is where a symbiont produces value most easily, by returning a future intention to the working context at the right moment.
It also gives the proactive help of Section 8 its most natural trigger: the system acts because the person said they would, and does not have to guess that they might want to.
The record also holds reasons and not only conclusions: why the person declined that offer, why they abandoned that plan, which two options they still have not chosen between, what new evidence would make them reconsider; the third moment of the day in Section 1 is a record that kept the conclusion and lost the reasons.
Keeping reasons is the precondition for the decision support of Section 9.2 ; a record without reasons can only answer questions about history.
blocks.zh:
记录比过去多。
它包含承诺,计划,在下次会议上询问某人的问题,决定仍在形成,以及一个人想要成为谁的更长远的看法.
心理学将这种未来的记忆称为未来记忆;它是一种人们在最大程度上经常失败的记忆,也是共鸣最容易产生价值的地方,在正确的时机将未来的意向回归工作环境.
它还给第8条的主动帮助提供了最自然的触发因素:系统之所以起作用,是因为有人说会这样做,而不必猜测他们是否愿意这样做。
记录中也有一些理由,而不仅仅是结论:为什么当事人拒绝这一提议,为什么他们放弃了他们尚未选择的两个选择,是什么新证据会使他们重新考虑;第1节中的第三个时刻是保留结论并失去理由的记录。
保留理由是第9.2节决定支持的先决条件;没有理由的记录只能回答有关历史的问题。

blocks.en: 6.7  The Others in Your Life
blocks.zh: 6.7 人生中的其他人

blocks.en:
A person’s colleagues, family, and friends are part of their context, and a symbiont has to remember where a conversation with someone left off in order to support the person’s social life.
Those people have not authorized being modeled.
We distinguish relational facts, what has happened between the person and them, which may be kept, from inferred portraits, what kind of person they are, which must be held to stricter limits than anything about the person themselves.
Section 12.5 sets the boundary in detail.
blocks.zh:
一个人的同僚、家人和朋友是他们的背景的一部分,
这些人没有被授权做模特。
我们区分关系事实,人与人之间发生的事,从推断的肖像中,可以保留他们是什么人,必须将其置于比个人本身更严格的限制之下.
第12.5节详细规定了边界。

blocks.en: 7  Understanding a Person
blocks.zh: 7 了解一个人

blocks.en:
The record of Section 6 is evidence.
This section asks how evidence becomes understanding of a person, and it is the technical center of the paper.
It runs along one line: what must be understood, where the evidence comes from, how the understanding is represented, which backbone it runs on, what a world model adds to it, and where it stops.
World models appear only at the fifth step, as the source of one capability, prediction.
blocks.zh:
第6节的记录是证据。
本节询问证据如何成为对一个人的理解,它是论文的技术中心.
它沿着一条线走:必须理解什么,证据来自何处,理解是如何体现的,它运行在哪个主干上,它增加了什么世界模型,它在哪里停止.
世界模型仅出现在第五步,作为一种能力的来源,预测.

blocks.en: 7.1  What Must Be Understood
blocks.zh: 7.1 必须明白什么

blocks.en:
Three objects must be understood.
The first is the situation , the physical side: where the person is, whom they are with, what they are doing, what the world in front of them is about to do.
The second is the mind , the mental side: the person’s intention at this moment, their cognitive load, their emotion, their uncertainty, and the more stable layer of goals, values, and blind spots.
The third is change : the situation changes by the minute, the mind by the hour, and the person by the year, so that the difficulty of understanding someone lies less in drawing a likeness than in making the likeness move.
The same experience has two faces, the event visible from outside and the person’s experience of it, and the record keeps both, so the model must represent both.
Mental world modeling makes the same commitment at the level of world state, treating beliefs and intentions as state variables alongside physical ones ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) ; Section 7.5 builds on it.
The third object, change, is the root of the staleness detection in that section and of the mutual growth in Section 10 .
blocks.zh:
三物须知.
第一是情况,物理方面:人在哪里,与谁在一起,他们在做什么,他们面前的世界将要做什么。
第二是心灵,精神方面: 人此时的意图,他们的认知负荷,他们的情感,他们的不确定性,以及更稳定的目标,价值和盲点层.
第三是变化:情况在瞬间变化,在瞬间变化,在瞬间变化,在瞬间变化,在瞬间变化的人,因此理解某人的困难在于画出一个相似的事物,而不是使相似的事物移动.
同样的经历有两种面貌,即从外部可见的事件和人物的体验,记录保持两者,所以模型必须代表两者.
精神世界建模在世界状态下做出了同样的承诺,将信仰和意图与物理变量一起作为状态变量处理(Fei和Zhao, 2026年);第7.5节在此基础上发展.
第三个物体,即变化,是该节中Stality探测和第十节中相互生长的根.

blocks.en: 7.2  Two Roads to the Mind
blocks.zh: 7.2 两条通往心灵的道路

blocks.en:
There are two independent sources of evidence about a mind, and a symbiont needs both (Figure 10 ).
The observation road infers from behavior, choices, expression, environment, and physiology; its strength is that it sees patterns the person cannot see themselves (they do not sleep after every meeting with a certain colleague), and its weakness is that one behavior has many possible causes.
The self-report road takes what the person says: their account of a situation, a whispered sentence, a correction of a misreading; its strength is that only the person can say what they felt and why, and its weakness is that accounts shift with mood and flatter the teller.
The two roads feed one layered model, and every entry carries its source and its uncertainty.
Self-report has priority on feelings and reasons; observation has priority on patterns the person cannot see.
When they disagree, the right response is to mark the disagreement, lower the weight placed on the inference, and ask when the moment is right, never to let the model overrule the person.
The result of Park et al. (2024) , in which agents built from two-hour interviews reproduced their participants’ survey answers about as well as the participants reproduced their own, shows how dense the information on the self-report road is; those agents are never updated, and that is what the symbiont adds.
Most existing systems travel only the observation road, inferring preferences from interaction history, and the dedicated low-friction channel of Section 5.4 is what gives a symbiont the second.
blocks.zh:
关于一个心灵,有两个独立的证据来源,一个韵母都需要两者(图10 ).
观察道路从行为,选择,表达,环境,生理学中推断出来;它的优点在于它看到了人无法看到的规律(每次与某个同事见面后,它们都不睡觉),它的弱点在于一种行为有许多可能的原因.
自我报告之路取其所言:他们叙述的情况,悄悄的句子,纠正误读;其优点是,只有人才能说出他们的感觉和原因,其弱点是,账户会随着情绪的改变和对出纳者的恭维而变化.
两条道路都提供一层层模型,每条条目都带有其来源和不确定性.
自我报告优先关注感情和原因;观察优先关注个人无法看到的模式。
当他们不同意时,正确的反应是标记分歧,降低对推论的份量,并询问时机是否合适,绝不让模型推翻人.
Park et al. (2024) 的结果是,通过两小时的访谈所建的代理人转载了参与者的调查答复,参与者转载了自己的调查答复。 结果显示,自报路上的资料有多密集;这些代理人从未更新过,这就是共鸣补充的内容。
大多数现有系统只行走观测道路,推断出互动史上的偏好,第5.4节的专用低防滑道是第二节的韵母.

blocks.en:
Figure 10 : Two roads to the mind.
Observation infers patterns from behavior and physiology; self-report records what the person says about intent, feeling, and reasons.
Both feed one layered model, with every entry tagged by source and uncertainty; disagreements are marked, down-weighted, and resolved by asking.
blocks.zh:
图10:通往思想的两条道路。
观察推断出行为和生理学的规律;自我报告记录了一个人对意图,感觉,和原因的描述.
两者都提供一个分层的模型,每个条目都有源码和不确定性的标记;分歧被标记、减量和通过询问解决。

blocks.en: 7.3  Layers of the Personal Model
blocks.zh: 7.3 个人模式的层次

blocks.en:
Table 9 gives the representation: seven layers, each with its evidence, its rate of change, and the misuse it invites, so that a passing state is never mistaken for a trait.
The last layer, preferences about help, is new relative to the usual user profile and is the parameter source of the intervention policy in Section 8.4 .
One structural property of the table follows from an everyday observation: a person who switches between a home dialect, a national language, and English changes manner, values, and even reasoning with the switch.
The table is therefore indexed by context.
The self at work, the self at home, and the self speaking the home dialect take different values in the identity, relations, and help-preference layers and share the experience-and-knowledge layer.
The differences are not contradictions to be averaged into one personality; the model’s task is to recognize which self is active, from language, setting, and company, and to act with that self’s manner, weights, and social norms.
Cultural psychology documents the underlying phenomenon of cultural frame switching in bicultural people ( Hong et al., 2000 ; Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006 ) , and the context-indexed model is what makes the cultural help of Section 9.4 possible.
blocks.zh:
表9给出了表述方式:七层,每层都有其证据,变化速度,以及它所招致的滥用,这样一个经过的状态就不会被误认为是特征.
最后一层,关于帮助的偏好,相对于通常的用户配置是新的,是第8.4节干预政策的参数来源.
表格的一个结构属性来自于日常观察:一个在家庭方言,国语之间切换的人,英语会改变方式,价值,甚至用开关推理.
因此,该表按上下文编制索引。
在工作中的自我,在家的自我,以及自言自语的家语方言,在身份,关系,帮助偏好层次上都具有不同的价值观,分享经验和知识层次.
这些差异并不是被平均归纳成一个人格的矛盾;模型的任务就是从语言,设置和公司的角度去认识哪个自我是活跃的,并且用这种自我的方式,权重和社会规范来行动.
文化心理学记录了双文化人文化框架转换的根本现象(Hong等人,2000年;Ramírez-Esparza等人,2006年),背景索引模型是第9.4节的文化帮助得以实现的原因。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Layers of the personal model. Each layer carries its evidence and its rate of change, and the last column names the misuse it invites. The table is indexed by context: the identity, relations, and help-preference layers take different values for the self at work, the self at home, and the self speaking a home dialect, while experience and knowledge are shared. The last layer parameterizes the intervention policy of Section 8.4 .
blocks.zh: 表9:个人型号的图层. 每一层都有其证据和变化速度,最后一栏列出它所邀请的滥用情况。 该表按上下文索引:身份,关系,和帮助偏好层对工作时的自我,家庭的自我,以及自言自语的家语方言采用不同的价值观,同时分享经验和知识. 最后一层将8.4节的干预政策参数化。

blocks.en: 7.4  The Backbone
blocks.zh: 7.4 (中文(简体) ). 后骨头

blocks.en:
The personal model has to be computed by something, and the paper binds it to nothing in particular.
The claim is precise.
The personal model and the record are defined at the level of information : what must be known, what must be predicted, and how confidence is expressed.
The backbone is the engine that turns evidence into that information, and the engine can be changed while the interface stays, so that what varies between engines is the quality of the estimates.
Two independent axes describe the engine (Figure 11 ).
The first axis is the foundation model itself, of which three kinds matter here.
A language model understands what the person says and writes, holds a textual portrait in its context, and reaches memory through retrieval.
An omni-modal model understands what the person sees and hears, reads situation and mood from tone and scene, and makes the first-person stream interpretable for the first time.
A world model turns understanding into prediction: what is about to happen around the person, how they will think and react, and whether a given reminder will be welcome.
The three are members of one family, each extending the evidence the model can take in and the inference it can draw from it, and later members contain the earlier ones.
The second axis is orthogonal to the first.
An agentic system belongs to this second axis rather than to the family: it is an organization of computation around a foundation model of any of the three kinds, the model together with the harness of Section 3.2 , and the model inside an agentic system can be exchanged for any member of the family.
What the harness adds is that understanding ceases to be a single pass and becomes a process: the system can look something up, ask the person a question, check the record, update the model, and plan the next step, whichever model sits inside it.
The grid of Figure 11 therefore has six cells, and the two axes can be traversed independently.
The first usable systems will stand in the upper-left cell, a language model inside a harness, since that is what today’s agents are, and the design is headed toward the upper-right cell, a world model inside a harness that anticipates as well as perceives. The design must stand on the weakest cell and improve automatically along either axis. On a language model alone the symbiont is a text assistant with a memory; without a world model the intervention policy estimates reactions by heuristics; without a harness, understanding cannot check itself.
The information interface is what makes the claim concrete: the mental-state layer of Table 9 asks every cell for the same output, an estimate of intent and an estimate of emotion, each with its confidence, which a language model produces from dialogue text, an omni-modal model from tone and scene as well, a world model from predictions of what comes next, and a harness from any of these together with the result of checking them against the record.
This is also why Section 10.4 requires that a change of foundation model, or of harness, preserve the relationship.
blocks.zh:
个人模型必须用某种东西来计算,而纸张则不加特别的束缚.
申诉是准确的。
个人模型和记录是在信息层面界定的:必须知道什么,必须预测什么,如何表达信心。
骨干是将证据转化为该信息的引擎,在接口停留时可以改变引擎,这样,不同引擎之间的变化就是估计的质量.
两个独立的轴来描述引擎(图11).
第一轴是基础模型本身,其中三种类型在此重要.
一个语言模型能理解人物的言语和写作,在其上下文中持有文字肖像,并通过检索到达内存.
一个OMNI模式模型能够理解人所看到的和听到的,从语气和场景中读取情况与心情,使第一人称流首次可以解释.
一个世界模型将理解转化为预测:在人周围会发生什么,他们将如何思考和反应,以及是否欢迎某个提醒。
三者是一家人,各自延伸模型能够吸收的证据和从中得出的推断,后来的成员包含早期的.
第二轴为正交向第一轴.
一个代理系统属于这一第二个轴而非家族:它是一个围绕任何三种类型的基础模型进行计算的组织,该模型与第3.2节的利用一起,代理系统内部的模型可以交换给家族的任何成员.
绳子所补充的是,理解不再是一个单一的通道,而成为一个过程:系统可以向上查找一些东西,向人提问,检查记录,更新模型,并计划下一步,无论哪个模型坐在里面.
因此图11的网格有6个细胞,两个轴可以独立穿行.
第一个可用的系统将站在左上角的细胞中,一个语言模型,它位于一个带子中,因为今天的代理就是这个,设计正朝右上角的细胞的方向发展,而这个带子中的世界模型是预测和感知的。 设计必须站在最弱的细胞上,并沿着任一轴自动改进。 单在一个语言模型上,symbiont是一个具有内存的文本助手;没有世界模型,干预政策就估计了heuristics的反应;没有控制,理解无法检查自己.
信息界面使得诉求变得具体:表9的心理状态层向每个细胞询问相同的输出,对意图的估计和对情感的估计,每个细胞都充满自信,一个语言模型从对话文本中产生,从语气和场景中产生全方位模式模型,从预测接下来会发生的事情中产生世界模型,从其中任何一种模式中产生,加上对照记录检查的结果.
这也是为什么第10.4节要求改变基础模式或改变利用方式来维护这种关系。

blocks.en:
Figure 11 : Two axes of the backbone.
Columns: the family of foundation models, from language to sight and sound to dynamics, each extending what counts as evidence.
Rows: how much system is organized around the model, from a single pass to a process inside an agentic harness.
The two axes are independent, since a harness can be wrapped around any of the three models; the dashed path is the likely order in which systems will move through the grid, and the heavy line is the information interface of the personal model, which is the same in every cell.
blocks.zh:
图11:骨干两轴.
柱子:基础模型的家族,从语言到视觉和声音到动态,每个柱子都延伸什么才是重要的证据.
行:围绕模型组织多少系统,从一个单传到一个代理吊带内部的过程.
两轴是独立的,因为一个牵引装置可以包裹在三个模型中任何一个的周围;破碎的路径是系统通过网格移动的可能顺序,重线是个人模型的信息界面,每个细胞的信息界面都是相同的.

blocks.en: 7.5  Two World Models
blocks.zh: 7.5 两种世界模式

blocks.en:
A world model, as a backbone, contributes to the personal model in two forms.
An external physical world model takes the environment seen in first person as its object, scene, objects, people present, their dynamics, and predicts the next moment: the cup is about to tip, the bus is arriving, the slide is about to change.
It serves help in the physical world, grounds mental cues in the situation (the person is tense because the deadline is on the screen), and supplies the extended reach of Section 14.2 ; its sources are the video world models and first-person data of Section 3.4 .
An internal mental world model takes the person’s beliefs, attention, intentions, emotions, and goals as its object and predicts how they change after an event and after an action by the symbiont.
It is the predictive version of the mental-state layer of Table 9 , and its sources are theory-of-mind research, individual-level simulation ( Park et al., 2024 ) , and mental world modeling, which places these variables inside the world state ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) .
The two are coupled: physical events change mental states, and mental states drive actions in the physical world.
blocks.zh:
一个世界模式作为骨干,以两种形式为个人模式做出贡献.
一个外部物理世界模型将第一人称中看到的环境作为它的对象,场景,物体,在场的人,他们的动态,并预测下一瞬间:杯即将倾斜,巴士即将到达,幻灯片即将改变.
提供第14.2节的延伸范围;其来源是第3.4节的视频世界模型和第一人称数据。
内在精神世界模式将人的信仰、注意力、意图、情感和目标作为它的目标,并预言他们如何在事件后和共鸣后改变。
它是表9的精神状态层的预测性版本,其来源为心学理论研究,个人层面的模拟(Park et al., 2024),以及精神世界的建模,将这些变量置于世界状态之内(Fei and Zhao, 2026).
两者是相辅相成的:物理事件会改变精神状态,精神状态会推动物理世界的行动.

blocks.en:
A competent world model has a state representation, temporal and relational reasoning, prediction of future states, prediction of the consequences of candidate actions, an expression of uncertainty, and detection of its own misspecification.
Replace “the world” with “this person’s world” and every requirement stands, and the last one matters most.
People change, so a model of a person will go wrong; the ability to detect that it has gone stale is what separates a symbiont from a static profile, and it is the same class of problem as misspecification detection in open-world modeling.
In the smallest notation, with z t z_{t} the joint latent state, z t = ( z t phys , z t mind ) , b t ​ ( z ) = P ⁡ ( z t ∣ O ≤ t , R ≤ t , K t ) , z ^ t + 1 ∼ P ⁡ ( z t + 1 ∣ z t , a t , x t + 1 ) , z_{t}=\big(z^{\mathrm{phys}}_{t},\,z^{\mathrm{mind}}_{t}\big),\qquad b_{t}(z)=P\!\left(z_{t}\mid O_{\leq t},\,R_{\leq t},\,K_{t}\right),\qquad\hat{z}_{t+1}\sim P\!\left(z_{t+1}\mid z_{t},\,a_{t},\,x_{t+1}\right), (3) where z t phys z^{\mathrm{phys}}_{t} is the task-relevant state of the world around the person, z t mind z^{\mathrm{mind}}_{t} the latent state of intention, emotion, and goals, b t b_{t} the system’s belief over both, and the third expression says that the model must predict how both change after the system’s action a t a_{t} and the new situation x t + 1 x_{t+1} .
The notation fixes what is predicted and conditioned on; it prescribes no Bayesian implementation.
It underlies the intervention policy of Section 8.4 , which needs b t b_{t} , and the learning rule of Section 10.2 , which needs a t a_{t} .
Without a world model the third expression degrades to heuristic rules, and the system still stands.
blocks.zh:
一个胜任的世界模型具有状态代表,时间和关系推理,对未来状态的预测,候选人行动的后果的预测,不确定性的表达,以及发现其自身的错位.
将 " 世界 " 改为 " 这个人的世界 " ,而每一项要求都存在,最后一项要求最为重要。

blocks.en: 7.6  Knowing When It Is Wrong
blocks.zh: 7.6 知道何时是错误的

blocks.en:
“It knows you better than you know yourself” has three defensible meanings and one that is not.
It can hold the person’s whole self-context at once while they hold a small part (Definition 4.1 ); it can see patterns across years that the person is inside of and cannot see; and it remembers the reasons they gave and have since forgotten.
The fourth meaning, reading thoughts that were never expressed, the paper gives up explicitly.
Two kinds of limitation must also be kept apart.
Familiarity with the person and competence on the problem in front of them are different things, and a system that knows someone very well may be poor at the specialist question they face this minute.
The confidence of the personal model and the reliability of the backbone in that domain are estimated and reported separately; when the second is low the system narrows its advice or suggests asking a person, and it never covers its ignorance of the problem with its familiarity with the person.
Understanding runs both ways, since the person also learns under which conditions the system is reliable, and mutual understanding has degrees and costs; the grounding framework of Clark and Brennan (1991) describes the process without the infinite regress of each knowing what the other knows.
Finally, every judgment about the person carries a confidence, any of them can be overturned by a sentence from the person, the system learns to ask when it is unsure, and an overturned judgment propagates through the repair of Section 6.5 . Collins et al. (2024) argued that machines that think with people must model them; this section says what is modeled, on what evidence, on which backbone, and within which limits.
blocks.zh:
“它比你自己更了解你”,有三个合理的含义,一个不是。
它能同时保持一个人的全部自我通融(定义4.1%);它能跨年地看到一个人内在且无法看见的规律;它能记住他们给出并自此被遗忘的原因.
第四个意义,读取从未表达过的思想,论文明确放弃.
两种限制也必须分开。
在他们面前熟悉个人和能力是不同的,在他们现在面临的专家问题上,一个非常了解某人的系统可能很差。
个人模型的信心和该领域骨干可靠性是分别估计和报告的;当第二个低级时,系统缩小其建议或建议询问一个人,而它从未用对一个人的熟悉来掩盖其对问题的无知.
理解是双向的,因为个人也学会了在何种条件下系统是可靠的,而相互理解有程度和成本;克拉克和布伦南(1991年)的地基框架描述了过程,而没有让每个人知道对方所知道的无限倒退.
最后,对一个人的每个判决都带有信心,任何判决都可以被一个人的判决推翻,系统学会询问何时不确定,推翻的判决通过修改第6.5节来宣传. Collins等人(2024年)认为,与人一起思考的机器必须建模它们;本节讲述什么是建模的,在什么证据上,在什么骨干上,以及在什么限度内.

blocks.en: 8  Living Alongside
blocks.zh: 8 边生活边生活

blocks.en:
Understanding has to become participation at the right moment.
This section turns private, real-time, low-friction, embedded presence, and proactivity that is timely, into mechanisms.
It is about how the symbiont is present, when it speaks, and in what form.
What it says is the subject of Section 9 .
blocks.zh:
理解必须在适当的时候参与。
本节将私密,实时,低调,嵌入式存在,以及及时的主动性转化为机制.
在于共鸣是怎样存在的,当它说话,以什么形式出现.
它所说的是第9节的主题。

blocks.en: 8.1  Two Conversations at Once
blocks.zh: 8.1 一次两次谈话

blocks.en:
Real-time voice assistants solved one problem: the person and the AI can speak and listen at the same time ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) .
A symbiont solves a different one.
The person is talking to another person; the symbiont is listening, thinking, and preparing at the same time, and through the private channel it hands the person a line, so that the person never has to stop for it.
We call this cognitive full-duplex , the real-time form of the symbiosis Licklider (1960) imagined: two conversations at once, the person’s with the world and the person’s with the symbiont, with the second never interrupting the first.
Figure 12 shows one instance.
A colleague mentions a figure the person reported last quarter; the slow loop retrieves it and checks it against the record; a question is detected and a cue appears in the glasses within a second; the person answers with the figure; the topic moves on and the cue expires and is withdrawn.
Four tracks run through the exchange, the external world, the person’s outward expression, the private channel, and the symbiont’s internal state, and the figure follows them along one timeline.
This capability belongs in the first usable system, since without it the symbiont is confined to the moments when the person is alone.
blocks.zh:
实时语音助理解决了一个问题:人物和AI可以同时说话和聆听(Défossez等人,2024年).
毗卢遮那解脱门.
这个人在和另一个人说话;共鸣者在同时倾听,思考,准备,通过私人渠道,将一个人的一行交给一个人,这样一个人就永远不必为此停下来.
我们称之为这种认知的全方位,即共生体Licklider(1960年)的实时形式:一次两次对话,一个人与世界对话,一个人与共生体对话,第二次对话从未打断第一次对话。
图12显示了一个实例。
一名同事提到上个季度报告的人的一个数字;缓慢的循环检索并对照记录加以检查;在一秒钟内发现一个问题,并在眼镜中出现一个提示;个人用该数字回答;话题动起来,提示结束并撤销。
四个音轨贯穿交易所, 外部世界, 人物的外向表达, 私人频道, 以及共鸣的内部状态,
这种能力属于第一个可用的系统,因为没有它,韵母就局限于一个人孤独的时刻。

blocks.en:
Figure 12 : Cognitive full-duplex.
One exchange in a team meeting: a colleague raises a figure the person reported last quarter, the slow loop retrieves and checks it, the fast loop places a one-line cue in the glasses within a second, the person answers, and the cue is withdrawn once it expires.
The timeline below follows the exchange across the four tracks of the external world, outward expression, the private channel, and the symbiont’s internal state.
The help is a reminder of the person’s own figure, the kind of assistance most settings accept (Section 15.5 ), and most of the time the right output is silence.
blocks.zh:
图12:认知全复式。
一个团队会议中的交换:一位同事提出上个季度报道的人的数字,缓慢的循环检索和检查,快速循环在眼镜中放置一行提示在一秒内,人物回答,提示一旦到期就会撤回.
以下时间线遵循了跨越外部世界的四条轨道的交流,外向表达,私人通道,以及共鸣的内部状态.
帮助是提醒一个人自己的身影,是大多数环境所接受的帮助(第15.5节),而大多数时候正确的产出是沉默。

blocks.en: 8.2  Fast Loop, Slow Loop
blocks.zh: 8.2 快速循环,慢循环

blocks.en:
Real time has two timescales, and conflating them leads to the mistaken demand that everything be low-latency.
The fast loop handles the immediate: a name, a number, “what he just said contradicts last week.”
The slow loop handles the background: retrieval, reasoning, updating the model, preparing a summary for after the meeting.
Between them sits a rolling current state: what this conversation is about, who wants what, what is still unresolved.
Cues must update incrementally, an updated cue must replace its predecessor, and an expired cue must disappear.
The latency budget has a shape.
The fast loop’s ceiling is set by the pace of conversation, since a name is useless two seconds late, so it can use only small models on the device or at the edge together with material the slow loop has already prepared.
The slow loop may be slow but must think ahead, preparing before the person opens their mouth what they are likely to need, which is where the prediction of Section 7.5 is put to use.
Section 17.4 lists the end-to-end latency budget as an open problem.
blocks.zh:
实时有两种时间尺度,而将时间尺度混为一谈会导致错误地要求一切事物都是低纬度的.
快速循环处理眼前的问题:一个名字,一个数字,“他刚才说的话与上星期的说法相矛盾。 “
慢环处理背景:检索,推理,更新模型,为会后编写摘要.
他们之间坐落着一个滚动的当前状态:这段对话的内容,谁想要什么,什么仍未解决.
库斯必须渐进更新,更新的提示必须取代其前身,过期的提示必须消失.
潜伏预算有成型.
快速循环的天花板是由对话速度设定的,因为一个名字是无用的迟到2秒,所以它只能使用设备或边缘的小模型,加上慢循环已经准备的材料.
缓慢的循环可能是缓慢的,但必须提前思考,在人张开口前准备他们可能需要的东西,这就是第7.5节的预测被使用的地方.
第17.4节将期终期预算列为一个未决问题。

blocks.en: 8.3  Implicit Intent
blocks.zh: 8.3 隐性意图

blocks.en:
Much of what a person needs is never asked for.
The evidence for implicit intent comes from the current activity, recent behavior, unfinished business (Section 6.6 ), the personal model (Section 7 ), and the half-sentence the person whispers.
The purpose of inferring it is to have candidate help ready and to wait for a suitable moment, never to decide in the person’s place.
When the inference is uncertain, the right move is one very short question, and the answer to that question is itself new evidence for the record; active clarification is a source of context in its own right.
blocks.zh:
一个人需要的很多东西从来不需要。
暗示意图的证据来自当前活动,最近的行为,未完成的事业(第6.6节),个人模型(第7节),以及当事人低语的半句.
推论其用意是让候选人做好准备,等待合适的时机,永远不要代替本人作出决定。
当推论不确定时,正确的举动是一个非常短的问题,对该问题的答案本身就是记录的新证据;积极澄清本身就是上下文的来源.

blocks.en: 8.4  The Intervention Policy
blocks.zh: 8.4 干预政策

blocks.en:
Timeliness has to become a decision problem, and silence has to be one of the formal decisions.
Table 10 separates the three judgments: what to help with, when, and how.
The decision can be written as a constrained choice, a t ∗ = arg ⁡ max a ∈ 𝒜 t ⁡ 𝔼 ⁡ [ Δ ​ U ​ ( a ) ∣ b t ] − λ t ⋅ Interrupt ⁡ ( a , attention t ) − ρ ⋅ Risk ⁡ ( a ) , s.t. conf ⁡ ( b t ) ≥ θ ⁡ ( a ) , a^{*}_{t}\;=\;\arg\max_{a\in\mathcal{A}_{t}}\;\mathbb{E}\!\left[\Delta U(a)\mid b_{t}\right]\;-\;\lambda_{t}\cdot\mathrm{Interrupt}(a,\,\mathrm{attention}_{t})\;-\;\rho\cdot\mathrm{Risk}(a),\qquad\text{s.t.}\ \ \mathrm{conf}(b_{t})\geq\theta(a), (4) where 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} always contains silence ∅ \varnothing with zero interruption cost, and the confidence threshold θ ⁡ ( a ) \theta(a) rises with the intrusiveness of the action: the louder the help, the surer the symbiont has to be , and acting on the person’s behalf carries the highest threshold of all.
The three terms say that help must have expected value, that interruption has a cost which varies with the person’s current attentional state, and that risk is counted separately because a wrong reminder is worse than none.
We add a notion of an attention budget : the amount of a person’s attention a symbiont may consume in a day is finite, and it should be managed the way battery charge is managed.
The just-in-time adaptive intervention framework of mobile health has studied for a decade when an intervention of what strength is acceptable, with its notions of states of vulnerability and receptivity ( Nahum-Shani et al., 2018 ) , and those notions transfer directly.
Earlier work on interruption and recovery shows how expensive an ill-timed intrusion is ( Iqbal and Horvitz, 2007 ) , and mixed-initiative principles already warned that initiative must be weighed against the cost of poorly timed action ( Horvitz, 1999 ) .
The goal is therefore accuracy of intervention rather than a greater amount of it.
The weights λ \lambda , ρ \rho , and θ \theta are given no numerical values in this paper and are research variables of Section 17 .

blocks.en: 8.5  Low Friction
blocks.zh: 8.5 低滑动

blocks.en:
Low friction means that the person never works for the help: no re-explaining the background, no reaching for a phone, no switching applications, no waiting.
Friction has four sources, and each is removed elsewhere in the paper: explaining the background (the record, Section 6 ), switching devices (the runtime, Section 11 ), waiting for a reply (the two loops above), and tidying up afterwards (consolidation, Section 6.3 ).
Some friction is worth preserving.
Being asked one more question before an important decision, or being left to think for a moment, is friction that should survive optimization (Section 10.5 ); interfaces that make people examine a recommendation before accepting it reduce overreliance at the cost of being liked less ( Buçinca et al., 2021 ) , and that trade is the one a symbiont must learn to make per person and per moment.
blocks.zh:
低摩擦意味着人从不为帮助工作:不能重新解释背景,不能联系电话,不能切换应用程序,不能等待.
Friction有四个来源,每个来源都在文件中被删除:解释背景(记录,第6节),切换设备(运行时间,第11节),等待答复(以上两个循环),以及随后的清理(合并,第6.3节)。
有些摩擦值得保护
在做出重要决定之前,再问一个问题,或者留待一时再思考,就是摩擦,这种摩擦应该能够维持最优化(第10.5节);使人们在接受建议之前先审查一个建议,然后以少受人喜欢为代价减少过度依赖(Buçinca等人,2021年),而贸易是共鸣者必须学会一个人和每个时刻制造的。

blocks.en: 8.6  Beyond the Meeting Room
blocks.zh: 8.6 会议室以外

blocks.en:
The meeting is the first proving ground: time pressure is high, information is dense, and timing decides everything, which is why a desktop copilot that analyzes a meeting as it happens and feeds cues back in real time is the natural starting point.
The symbiont must, however, leave the room.
Three settings of presence have different rhythms and channels.
Sitting at a screen, in the desktop or the editor, the channel is wide and help can be expanded.
In conversation, in a meeting or at dinner, only a line or a whispered word fits.
On the move, in the street, in transit, in an unfamiliar city, the earpiece and the overlay carry what the moment needs.
The second moment of the day in Section 1 resolves here: the result the researcher could not recall arrives as a line in the glasses while the conversation continues.
What the symbiont does once present begins with doing things for the person, which is where the next section starts.
blocks.zh:
会议是第一个证明理由:时间压力高,信息密集,时间决定一切,这就是为什么一个台式副驾驶在开会时分析会议并实时反馈提示是自然的起点。
然而,韵母必须离开房间。
三种存在设置有不同的节奏和频道.
坐在屏幕,桌面或编辑器上,频道宽,可以扩展帮助.
在谈话中,在会议或晚餐中,只有一句台词或低语的词适合.
移动时,在街上,在中转时,在一个陌生的城市,耳机和盖子承载着瞬间需要的东西.
第1节中的第二刻在这里解决:研究者在谈话继续进行时无法记得的结果是作为眼镜中的线条而到达的.
共鸣者一出现就从为人做事开始,这就是下一节的起点.

blocks.en: 9  The Ladder of Assistance
blocks.zh: 9 援助梯子

blocks.en:
Once present, what does a symbiont do?
The answer is a ladder with three tiers (Figure 13 ).
At the bottom it gets things done, which is what today’s autonomous and personal agents do, and a symbiont must do it as well as they do and better.
In the middle it thinks and feels with the person: decisions, goal formation, learning, creative work, emotional steadiness, mentorship, and psychological support within clinical limits, the settings of highest cognitive density.
At the top it lives among others with the person: real-time social cognition, hard conversations, culture and dialect, and the meeting of two symbionts.
Three facts organize the ladder.
Each tier rests on the one below, and a symbiont that cannot book a flight will never be worn.
Each tier up moves the object of evaluation further from task completion and closer to how the person is changed.
And all three tiers run on the same machinery of Sections 6 to 8 , differing only in how deep into the personal model they reach and how much intervention they are allowed (the threshold θ \theta of Eq. ( 4 )).
One function, patient care, runs across all three tiers and receives its own treatment in Section 9.5 .
blocks.zh:
一旦出现,一个共鸣会做什么?
答案是三层的梯子(图13).
在最底层,它让事情得到完成,这是今天的自主和个人代理人所做的事情,一个共鸣者必须比他们做得更好。
在中间,它与人思考和感受:决定,目标形成,学习,创造性的工作,情感的稳健,辅导,以及临床范围内的心理支持,认知密度最高的环境.
在顶部,它与人生活在一起:实时的社会认知,硬对话,文化与方言,以及两个韵母的会面.
三个事实组织起梯子.
每层都靠下面的一层 无法预订飞行的连锁装置永远不会穿戴
每个级别向上移动评价对象,从任务完成到更接近人物的改变.
所有这三层都运行在第6至第8节的同一机制上,只在它们达到的个人模式的深度和允许它们采取多少干预措施方面有所不同(起点(eq.(4))。
一种功能,即病人护理,贯穿所有三个层次,并在第9.5节中接受自己的治疗。

blocks.en:
Figure 13 : The ladder of assistance.
Tier 1 is where today’s agents stop; a symbiont does the same tasks with the person’s context in hand.
Tier 2 is thinking and feeling with the person, and Tier 3 is living among others.
The depth of the personal model required grows with each tier, and caring runs across all three.
blocks.zh:
图13:援助梯级。
第一级是今天的代理人停止的地方;一个共鸣者在个人的手头执行同样的任务。
第2层是思考和与个人的感受,第3层是生活等人.
所需个人模型的深度随着每个层次的提高而增加,照料贯穿所有三个层次。

blocks.en: 9.1  Getting Things Done
blocks.zh: 9.1 使事情得到解决

blocks.en:
The floor of the ladder is general-purpose assistance: booking travel and hotels, shopping and comparing prices, keeping the calendar and the inbox, forms and payments, desktop work with files, slides, and spreadsheets, coding and technical work inside the editor, retrieving and organizing information, and multi-day tasks such as an application, a move, or an event.
A symbiont does not rebuild these capabilities.
Through its harness (Sections 3.2 and 11.3 ) it delegates them to standard agents and tools, computer-use agents, tool protocols, and coding agents, and keeps three jobs for itself: defining the task correctly, supplying the right personal defaults, and deciding when the person must be consulted.
The reason the same task comes out better is the record and the personal model.
An agent told “book my flight to the conference” has to ask where the person leaves from, what they will spend, when they prefer to travel, whether they want a window seat.
A symbiont already knows that the person has a meeting on Monday morning that cannot move, that they dislike overnight flights, that they want to stay near the venue because they hope to meet a particular colleague, and that the last time they took a short connection they missed it.
So it asks nothing, or it asks the one question that only the person can answer.
One layer deeper, it knows why the person is making the trip, from the goals layer of Table 9 , so it frames the task correctly and books the meeting they were hoping for alongside the flight.
Table 11 works through five everyday tasks in this way, and its last column lists what can be measured: clarifying questions asked, corrections the person had to make, time to completion, how much of a plan actually holds.
blocks.zh:
梯子的地板是通用辅助:预订旅行和酒店,购物和比较价格,保留日历和收件箱,表格和支付,桌面工作与文件,幻灯片,电子表格,编辑器内部的编码和技术工作,检索和组织信息,以及应用程序,动作或活动等多日任务.
共鸣不能重建这些能力。
通过它的利用(第3.2和11.3节),它将他们委托给标准代理人和工具、计算机使用代理人、工具协议和编码代理人,并为自己保留三个工作:正确界定任务、提供正确的个人缺省,以及决定何时必须咨询该人。
同一个任务更好出场的原因是记录和个人模型.
一位经纪人说,“订下我前往会议的机票”必须问此人离开何处,他们愿意旅行时会花费什么,他们是否想要一个窗口座位。
一个共和党人已经知道,这个人在星期一上午有一个会议,不能动,他们不喜欢过夜的航班,他们想留在会场附近,因为他们希望会见某个特定的同事,最后一次他们接通了一个短的连接,他们错过了.
所以它不问什么,或者它问一个只有一个人才能回答的问题.
更深一层,它知道为什么一个人要进行旅行, 从表9的球门层, 所以它正确地设定任务 并记录他们希望的会议 与飞行同时进行。
表11以这种方式完成了5项日常任务,其最后一栏列出了可以衡量的内容:澄清所问的问题,纠正个人必须做的,完成的时间,计划的实际持有量.

blocks.en: Table 11 : The same task, done by an agent and by a symbiont. The task is unchanged; what changes is how much must be asked, how the task is framed, and how often the result has to be corrected. The last column makes the difference measurable.
blocks.zh: 表11:同一任务,由代理人和符号完成。 任务不变;需要问多少问题,任务框架如何,结果需要多久纠正一次。 最后一栏使差异可以衡量。

blocks.en:
Acting for the person is the most intrusive action in Eq. ( 4 ) and needs the firmest boundary.
We propose five levels of action permission: look, suggest, draft, execute what can be undone, and execute what cannot, such as paying, sending, and committing; each level is earned along the trust curve of Section 12.2 .
A draft composed in discussion, a line rehearsed for a conversation, or a candidate plan never becomes an outward action or commitment on its own.
Long tasks carry state, verify their results, and hand back to the person when they fail.
Evaluation at this tier can keep task completion as its object as long as it adds a personalization differential : the same task, the same base model, with and without the person’s context, which Section 17.1 writes as Eq. ( 8 ).
Current benchmarks measure the floor and say nothing about the differential ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) .
We make no claim of novelty for this tier; the single claim is that the same tasks are done better with personal context, and that this can be shown.
blocks.zh:
为个人采取行动是Eq.(4)中最侵入性的行为,需要最严格的边界。
我们提出五个级别的行动许可:看、建议、起草、执行可以取消的东西,以及执行不能取消的东西,例如支付、发送和承诺;每一级别都是根据第12.2节的信任曲线获得的。
由讨论构成的草案、为对话排练的一行,或候选人计划从不成为单独对外的行动或承诺。
长任务携带状态,验证结果,失败时交给人.
只要增加个性化差异, 第17.1节写为Eq. (8)条。
现行基准衡量底数,不说差数(谢等人,2024年;周等人,2024年;姚等人,2025年).
我们没有对这一层次提出新的主张;唯一的主张是,根据个人情况,同样的任务做得更好,这一点可以显示出来。

blocks.en: 9.2  Thinking With You
blocks.zh: 9.2 与你一起思考

blocks.en: The first half of the second tier is cognition itself, in six forms.
blocks.zh: 第二层的前半部分是认知本身,有六种形式.

blocks.en:
A symbiont that remembers the person can help them reason with themselves.
It returns what they forgot (why they declined last time, and whether the constraint still holds), lays out what they did not think of (a third option, a counterexample, a value they usually weigh and this time left out), and writes down what they concluded, with the reasons, for next time (Section 6.6 ).
Its stance is to help the person see, never to choose for them, and it owes them a reasoned objection when a choice conflicts with a long-term goal they stated themselves, after which the decision returns to them. Reicherts et al. (2025) compared an AI that builds on the person’s own reasons with one that gives recommendations: the first integrated better with people’s thinking and produced slightly better outcomes, the second surfaced more novel insights at less effort, and the first is the form of help this paragraph describes.
The third moment of the day in Section 1 resolves here.
blocks.zh:
一个记得这个人的共鸣可以帮助他们自己理性.
它返回了他们忘记的东西(他们上次为何拒绝,以及限制是否仍然有效),列出了他们没有想到的东西(第三个选择,一个反例,他们通常重的值,这次却被忽略),并写下他们下次的结论和理由(第6.6节)。
它的立场是帮助人们看到,从不为他们选择,当一项选择与他们所宣称的长期目标相冲突时,它欠他们一个有道理的反对,然后,决定又回到他们身上。 Reicherts 等人著. (2025年)将基于个人自身原因的AI和给出建议的AI进行比较:第一个更好地融入了人们的思维,并产生了略好的结果,第二个在更少的努力中浮现出更多新的见解,第一个是本段描述的帮助形式.
第1节中的第三个时刻在这里解决.

blocks.en:
Many important matters start without an executable goal: changing direction, taking or declining an opportunity, handling a relationship.
The symbiont can unfold candidate goals, bring back the reasons that conflict, and ask which cost the person would find hardest to bear, so that a provisional choice forms in the conversation.
It makes no claim to have discovered the person’s “true” goal.
blocks.zh:
许多重要事项开始时没有可执行的目标:改变方向,抓住或拒绝机会,处理关系.
共鸣可以展开候选目标,带回冲突的原因,并询问一个人要付出什么代价才能最难以承受,这样在对话中就可以有临时选择表.
它没有声称发现了此人的 " 真正 " 目标。

blocks.en:
This is help with knowing where one is uncertain, whether to check, and whether this is a moment to think alone, to think with the symbiont, or to ask a person.
Such help arrives before an answer, and sometimes it takes the form “that is not the question you need.”
A rise in confidence is never counted as a rise in understanding, and the cognitive-offloading literature ( Risko and Gilbert, 2016 ) is the background for when offloading is the right choice.
blocks.zh:
这帮助人们知道一个人的不确定之处,是否要检查,以及这是否是一个单独思考,与共鸣思考,或问一个人的时刻.
这种帮助是在答复之前提供的,有时它采取的形式是“这不是你需要的问题。 “
信心的提升从未被算作理解的提升,认知卸载文学(Risko and Gilbert, 2016)是卸载是正确选择的背景.

blocks.en:
A tutor who knows where the person does not understand, because it has seen every place they got stuck, can give a hint at the moment they need it instead of an answer, and can step back when they say they want to learn this themselves (Section 10.5 ).
Language learning is the most natural case and connects to the dialect help of Section 9.4 .
blocks.zh:
一个知道一个人不明白的地方的辅导员,因为它已经看到他们被卡住的每一个地方,可以在他们需要的时候给出提示而不是答案,当他们说他们想自己学习这个东西时可以退一步(第10.5节).
语言学习是最自然的案例,与9.4节的方言帮助连接.

blocks.en:
Two services belong here: catching the idea that slips away (the first moment of the day in Section 1 , the typical use of the whisper channel), and holding a thread across weeks, where this project got to, which hypothesis was dropped, which is still open, which is the working state of Section 6.1 .
The failure to watch for is a symbiont that generates a great deal and drifts away from the question the person wanted to pursue.
blocks.zh:
两个服务属于这里:捕捉溜走的想法(第1节中的第一天,低语通道的典型使用),并持有一条线穿过几周,这个项目到达的地方,这个假设被放弃,这个假设仍然开放,这是第6.1节的工作状态.
未能观察是一个共鸣,产生很多东西,并偏离人们想要追求的问题。

blocks.en:
This includes guarding focus, by noticing that the person has been refreshing the same page for ten minutes, and the plainest memory support of all: a name, a detail, where something was put, what was said last time.
These six forms draw on the goals and mental-state layers of Table 9 , use the expanded dialogue or the whisper channel, and span seconds to days, and it is here that the friction worth preserving (Section 8.5 ) matters most.
blocks.zh:
这包括守护焦点,通过注意到这个人已经刷新了10分钟的同一页,以及所有人最简单的记忆支持:一个名字,一个细节,一个东西放在哪里,上次说的话.
这六种形式借鉴表9的目标和心理状态层次,使用扩展的对话或低语通道,并持续数秒至数天,在这里,值得保护的摩擦(第8.5节)最为重要。

blocks.en: 9.3  Feeling With You
blocks.zh: 9.3 对你的感觉

blocks.en: The second half of the tier runs from everyday emotion to the edge of clinical care, in four steps of increasing weight.
blocks.zh: 下半层从日常情感到临床护理的边缘,分四步增加重量.

blocks.en:
The small disturbances of a day: a remark that stung, nerves before a talk, a piece of bad news.
The symbiont’s help is to be present, to know what happened, and to say the one sentence that fits, or to say nothing and simply note it.
Physiology gives early signs of stress and fatigue, and their interpretation has to remain conservative.
blocks.zh:
一天的小扰动:一个令人眩晕的言论,在谈话前的神经,一个坏消息.
共济会的帮助是在场,知道发生了什么,并说出一个合适的句子,或者一言不发,简单地记下来.
生理学给出了压力和疲劳的早期迹象,它们的诠释必须保持保守.

blocks.en:
Useful comfort is never generic encouragement; it rests on a precise understanding of the person’s actual history, so that what is said touches the real point: this failure relates to those efforts and those hopes.
Three levels follow.
Being heard, when the symbiont restates the situation and the person thinks “yes, that is it.”
Being understood, when it points out an attribution error the person could not see.
Being moved, when it builds a next step from the way the person got through a similar time before.
The preconditions, an established relationship of trust and a general competence that in many domains exceeds an ordinary person’s, are stated as conditions throughout.
blocks.zh:
有益的安慰从来不是一般的鼓励;它取决于对一个人的实际历史的准确理解,因此,所说的话触及了真正的问题:这种失败与这些努力和希望有关。
三级依次.
听到,当共鸣者重申情况时,人会认为“是的,就是这样。 “
被理解,当它指出一个归属错误时,人无法看到.
被移动,当它构建下一个步骤 从人的方式 通过相似的时间之前。
先决条件、既定的信任关系和在许多领域超越普通人的一般权限,一直被说成是条件。

blocks.en:
This is where the section has to be most careful.
Relative to any mental-health application, a symbiont has three advantages: it knows the person’s life and does not need it retold; it is present when the trigger happens, days before the next appointment; and it can see patterns, in sleep, in social withdrawal, in language.
It is therefore suited to three things: being a daily practice partner for evidence-based methods such as the identification and reframing used in cognitive behavioral therapy; providing support and a record between professional sessions; and recognizing early signs of relapse.
It is not suited to carrying treatment on its own.
For depression and anxiety the paper says that this is a direction that deserves serious study, with randomized evidence for particular systems under particular conditions, from the early Woebot trial ( Fitzpatrick et al., 2017 ) to the recent trial of a generative chatbot ( Heinz et al., 2025 ) , and it does not say that these conditions can be treated by an AI.
The symbiont’s first duty in such moments is to recognize when a human professional must be brought in, with a clear path for doing so when crisis signals appear, and in regulated jurisdictions this function is itself regulated, which the paper acknowledges.
blocks.zh:
这一部分必须非常小心。
相对于任何心理健康应用来说,共鸣有三个优点:它知道人的生活,不需要重提;当触发发生时,即下一次预约前几天;它可以看到规律,在睡眠,社会退出,在语言上.
因此,它适合三件事:作为基于证据的方法的日常实践伙伴,如认知行为治疗中使用的识别和再造方法;在专业课程之间提供支持和记录;以及识别早期的复发迹象。
它不适合单独进行治疗。
对于抑郁症和焦虑症,论文称这是一个值得认真研究的方向,对特定条件下的特定系统有随机化的证据,从早期Woebot试验(Fitzpatrick等人,2017年)到最近基因聊天器试验(Heinz等人,2025年),并没有说这些条件可以由AI治疗.
共和党在这种时刻的首要职责是承认何时必须引进一名人类专业人员,并在出现危机信号时有一条明确的道路,在受监管的法域中,这一职能本身就受到管制,文件承认这一点。

blocks.en:
Long-term behavior change, in sleep, exercise, or recovery, is the home ground of just-in-time adaptive interventions ( Nahum-Shani et al., 2018 ) , and a symbiont turns the phone notification into a sentence from someone present.
As company it can be patient and non-judging, and the risk has to be stated directly: it must never substitute for human relationships, and it should steer the person back toward people.
Studies of companion chatbots show both relief of loneliness and dependence, with effects that vary with how and how much they are used ( Maples et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
长期行为改变,在睡眠,锻炼,或恢复中,是及时适应性干预(Nahum-Shani等人,2018年)的家居之地,一个韵母将电话通知转化为在场人士的句子.
作为公司,它可以是耐心的和没有判断力的,风险必须直接说明:它绝不能取代人际关系,它应该把人引向人。
对同伴聊天员的研究表明,他们既能减轻孤独感,又能减轻依赖感,其影响随使用方式和程度而不同(Maples等人,2024年;Fang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
After a Setback The same sentence, “I messed up again”, and three responses a symbiont might give.
It listens and makes a note, and says nothing.
It looks back at the facts and points out what differs between this time and last time.
With the person’s agreement, it works through the causes and a next step together with them.
Three things it does not do: offer a paragraph of generic encouragement; insist “I know you better” after the person has rejected an interpretation; and continue alone when a crisis signal appears.
blocks.zh:
倒计时后 同一句,“我又搞砸了”,以及一个韵母可能给出的三个答复。
其听而作笔记,无所言也.
它回顾事实,并指出这次和上次有什么不同。
经当事人同意,它通过各种原因发挥作用,并与它们一起采取下一步行动。
它没有做三件事:提出一个一般性的鼓励段落;在当事人拒绝解释后坚持“我更了解你”;在危机信号出现时单独继续。

blocks.en: 9.4  Relating
blocks.zh: 9.4 有关

blocks.en:
The third tier is help with people and cultures, in four forms. Real-time social cognition. A meeting is one kind of social setting.
In any of them the symbiont can recall the person opposite (where the conversation left off, what they care about), read the moment (the implication of what was just said, the tension between the person’s argument and the other’s position), and help the person say it (a better phrasing, the number they forgot).
Reading the moment relies on the theory-of-mind ability of large foundation models, which has shown both promise and brittleness ( Kosinski, 2024 ; Ullman, 2023 ; Strachan et al., 2024 ) , and on inferences about other people that are used only for the interaction at hand and never accumulate into a portrait (Sections 6.7 and 12.5 ). Rehearsal and hard conversations. Practice beforehand for a salary negotiation, a breakup, or negative feedback to a colleague; a line during (the person’s pace is rising; the other is really asking something else); a review afterwards.
A simulated counterpart in rehearsal is only a rehearsal and never a prediction of a real person.
De-escalation belongs here too: the symbiont can see, in voice and heart rate, that the person is heating up before they notice, and a single vibration on the private channel is enough. Relationship maintenance. This goes deeper than a birthday reminder: the person has not spoken to their father in a month and he mentioned a medical test last time.
It draws on the relations layer and on prospective memory (Section 6.6 ), and it is where the limits of Section 12.5 bite hardest. Language, culture, and the dialect self. Behind each language are different habits of thought and social rules.
The help consists less in translation than in entering the frame: how people here greet, how they decline, what cannot be said directly.
It needs the context-indexed model of Section 7.3 , which knows who the person is in that language, and the online learning of Section 10.3 , which learns the dialect of a small place.
Those two sections share one example, used here and learned there, and we avoid claims of the form “language X makes people more open”: shifts of this kind have been reported in bicultural individuals ( Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006 ) , and they do not license a rule about any particular person.
blocks.zh:
第三层以四种形式帮助人们和文化。 实时社会认知. 开会是一种社会环境。
在其中任何一种情况下,共鸣可以使人想起对面的人(即谈话所离开的地方,他们所关心的),读一下瞬间(刚才所说的话的含义,人的论点与他人的立场之间的矛盾),并帮助人说(一个更好的措辞,他们忘记的数字)。
阅读这一瞬间依赖于大型基础模型的思维理论能力,这些模型既表现了希望,也表现出了脆性(Kosinski, 2024年;Ullman, 2023年;Strachan等人, 2024年), 也依赖于对其他人的推论,这些推论仅用于手头的相互作用,从未积累成肖像(第6.7和12.5节). 排练和艰苦的对话。 事先进行工资谈判、分手或对同事的负面反馈;
在排练中模拟的对应者只是排练,从来不是真实人物的预言.
降级也属于这里: 音节能从语音和心率上看,在注意前人正在加热,在私人频道上单振动就足够了. 关系维持。 这比生日提醒更深:这个人一个月没跟父亲说话了,他上次提到体检。
它借鉴了关系层和未来的记忆(第6.6节),也是第12.5节的界限最难咬的地方。 语言,文化,以及方言的自我. 每种语言背后都有不同的思想习惯和社会规则.
帮助在翻译方面比在进入框架方面要少:这里的人如何问候,如何拒绝,什么不能直接说.
它需要第7.3节的上下文索引模式,它知道该语言中的人是谁,需要第10.3节的在线学习,它学习一个小地方的方言。
这两个部分有一个例子,在这里使用,并在那里学到,我们避免声称“语言X使人们更加开放”:据报告,这种转变发生在双文化个人身上(Ramírez-Esparza等人,2006年),它们不允许对任何特定的人制定规则。

blocks.en: 9.5  Caring
blocks.zh: 9.5 照顾

blocks.en:
The function the user of a symbiont may value most is one that is patient when they are not.
Its core is consistency, patience, tirelessness, and noticing what people stop noticing, and it runs across all three tiers.
Four settings follow; the populations themselves are treated in Section 13 .
In parenting , a symbiont answers a child’s hundredth “why” without weariness, hands the parent a sentence when the parent’s own temper is rising, leaves the child to the parent, and notices developmental or emotional signs worth a professional’s attention; the symbiont belongs to the parent, and all-day sensing of children raises separate ethical questions (Sections 13.9 and 16.7 ).
In aging and memory decline it is a memory prosthesis, who this is, whether the medication was taken, what was being looked for, with the SenseCam studies of memory-impaired patients as precedent ( Berry et al., 2007 ) ; it supports orientation and safety and connects the person to family.
For caregivers , the people who care for others and receive the least support, it holds the detail of care so that they can rest.
In rehabilitation and chronic self-management , where the task is long, repetitive, and easy to abandon, its patience is worth most, and the handoff to clinical systems must be explicit.
The failure mode common to all four is the handing over of a person to a machine, and in each setting the symbiont’s last duty is to return the person to other people.
blocks.zh:
一个韵母的用户可能最珍视的功能是当它们不具有耐心时的功能.
它的核心是一致性,耐心,不懈,注意人们停止注意的事物,它贯穿所有三个层次.
以下四个环境;人口本身在第13条中得到处理。
在养育子女方面,一个同义词回答儿童的第100个“为什么没有疲惫”,当父母自己的脾气正在上升时,将一个句子交给父母,将孩子留给父母,并注意值得专业人员注意的发展或情感迹象;同义词属于父母,对孩子的全天感知提出了单独的伦理问题(第13.9和16.7节)。
在衰老和记忆衰减中,这是一种记忆假体,即这是谁,是否服用了药物,正在寻找什么,而SenseCam对记忆障碍患者的研究是先例(Berry等人,2007年);它支持定向和安全,并将个人与家庭联系起来。
对于照顾者、照顾他人并获得最少支助的人来说,它保留着照顾的细节,以便他们能够休息。
在康复和慢性自我管理中,任务很长、重复和容易放弃,其耐心最值得,向临床系统移交必须明确。
这四个人常见的失败模式是将一个人交给机器,在每次设定共鸣时,最后的责任是将一个人交还给其他人。

blocks.en: 9.6  Symbiont to Symbiont
blocks.zh: 9.6 连带关系

blocks.en:
The most imaginative scene in the vision is two people, each with a symbiont, in one room and not yet near each other, while their symbionts exchange cards, filter shared interests, decide whether a greeting is worth it, and if so bring the two together.
It is at once fanciful and practical, and Figure 14 turns it into four research questions.
Which information may represent the person in an exchange, in four rings of authorization: visible, discoverable, shareable, and committable, with the inner personal model never crossing the boundary.
By what criterion symbionts match, and who sets it.
Whether a greeting made on the person’s behalf counts as their commitment.
And when two symbionts each optimize for their owner, whether the outcome is good for both.
Section 15.7 asks what happens when this scales to a crowd.
No protocol is proposed, and everything in Sections 5 to 8 stands even if symbionts never talk to each other.
blocks.zh:
视觉中最有想象力的场景是两个人,每人有一个韵母,在一个房间里,还没有靠近对方,而他们的韵母互换卡片,过滤共享兴趣,决定一个问候是否值得,如果是这样的话,将两者合在一起.
它同时具有幻想性和实用性,图14将其变为四个研究问题。
哪些信息可以代表个人进行交换,在四个授权环中:可见、可发现、可分享和可承诺,内部个人模型从未跨越边界。
以何种标准共鸣相匹配,谁设定.
以个人名义问候是否构成他们的承诺。
而当两个韵母各自为主人优化时,结果是否对两者都有利.
第15.7节问,当这种规模达到人群时会发生什么。
没有提出任何协议,第5至8节中的一切都站立着,即使共和党从不互相交谈.

blocks.en:
Figure 14 : The symbiont handshake.
Four rings of authorization around each person, from visible to committable; exchange happens only within the ring both have opened, and the inner model never crosses.
blocks.zh:
图14:共鸣手握.
每人周围有4个授权环,从可见到可承诺;交换只在环内进行,两者都已经打开,内部模型从不交叉.

blocks.en: 9.7  A Catalogue of Functions
blocks.zh: 9.7 函数目录

blocks.en:
Table 12 lists every function of this section with the layers of the personal model it needs, its channel, its timescale, the failure that would best distinguish a good system from a bad one, and its maturity.
The table is deliberately long: it is the full functional claim of the paper, each row has to find its population in Section 13 and its evaluation in Section 17 , and it is what we mean when we say the framework is testable.
blocks.zh:
表12列出了本节的每个功能,包括它所需要的个人模型的层次,通道,时间尺度,最能区分一个好系统与坏系统的失败,以及它的成熟度.
表格刻意很长:这是文件的全部功能性要求,每行必须在第13节中找到其人口,并在第17节中找到其评价,这就是我们所说的框架是可以检验的。

blocks.en: Table 12 : A catalogue of cognitive-level functions as tests of the framework. Every row names the layers of the personal model it needs, the channel it uses, its timescale, the failure that would best discriminate a good system from a bad one, and its maturity. Section 13 maps rows to populations and Section 17 to evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表12:作为框架测试的认知层次功能目录。 每行都命名它需要的个人模型的层,它使用的通道,时间尺度,最能区分一个好系统与坏系统的失败,以及它的成熟. 第13节绘制人口图,第17节绘制评价图。

blocks.en: 10  Growing Together
blocks.zh: 10 共同成长

blocks.en:
After many rounds of participation, how do the system and the person each change?
This section holds the paper’s most ambitious claims, the personal data flywheel, self-evolution, test-time training, learning a dialect from a few days of conversation, and it is written to be the strictest.
