The question “where does the symbiont learn” is broadened from memory and parameters to the whole stack: as the symbiont comes to know the person, the base model, the harness, and even the hardware have to evolve, and the one thing that must never be replaced is the relationship.
blocks.zh:
经过多轮参与后,制度和人物各自如何改变?
本节持论文最雄心勃勃的主张,个人数据飞轮,自我进化,试验时间训练,从几天的对话中学习一种方言,著述最为严格.
“韵母在哪里学习”的问题从记忆和参数扩展到整个堆栈:随着韵母开始了解人,基模型,绳子,甚至硬件都得进化,永远不能被替换的一件事就是关系。

blocks.en: 10.1  Where Learning Happens
blocks.zh: 10.1 国家 学习发生的地方

blocks.en:
“Knowing you better” can happen in seven places, each with its own mechanism, risk, and reversibility (Table 13 ).
The first three, the record, the personal model, and the intervention policy, are where most of what is called personalization lives, and they already create most of the value.
The fourth and fifth, model parameters and the harness with its tools, are self-evolution in the strict sense.
The sixth is hardware.
The seventh is the person, which is the paper’s object of evaluation and which no other personalization research counts.
Figure 15 arranges the parameter-side mechanisms on one axis from changing only memory to changing all parameters, rates each for the data it needs, its stability, and its reversibility, and adds a parallel band for the harness.
The region the paper argues for lies in the middle and toward the left; the right end, where one change moves everything, is the one to avoid.
One distinction governs all seven rows: sounding more like you is not the same as understanding you better.
blocks.zh:
“更好地了解你”可在七个地方发生,每个地方都有自己的机制、风险和可逆转性(表13)。
前三篇,记录,个人模式,干预政策,是大部分所谓个性化生活的地方,他们已经创造了大部分价值.
第四,第五,模型参数及其工具的利用,都是严格意义上的自演.
第六为硬件.
第七个是个人,是论文的评价对象,其他个性化研究都不重要。
图15将参数边机制安排在一个轴上,从只改变内存到改变所有参数,每个参数对它需要的数据的速率,它的稳定性,以及它的可逆性,并为牵引器增加一个平行的波段.
文件所主张的位于中间和左侧的区域;一个改变移动一切的右端是需要避免的区域。
一种区别支配了所有七行: 听起来更像你 和了解你不同。

blocks.en: Table 13 : Seven places where a symbiont can learn. Most personalization lives in the first three rows and already creates value; the fourth and fifth are self-evolution; the sixth is hardware; the last is the paper’s own object of evaluation. Sounding more like you is not the same as understanding you better.
blocks.zh: 表13:一个韵母可以学习的七个地方. 多数个性化生活于前三行,已经产生价值;第四和第五是自我进化;第六是硬件;最后是论文自己的评价对象. 听起来更像你 和理解你不同

blocks.en:
Figure 15 : The learning spectrum.
The lower band runs from changing only memory to changing all parameters; each mechanism is rated for the data it needs, its stability, and its reversibility, and the paper argues for the middle-left region.
The upper band is harness-level learning, which runs in parallel, stays readable and reversible, and is where self-improvement should mostly happen.
blocks.zh:
图15:学习频谱。
下波段从只改变内存到改变所有参数;每个机制都对其需要的数据,稳定性,及其可逆性进行评分,论文为中左区论证.
上段为牵引级学习,平行运行,保持可读性和可逆性,是自我改进应大多发生的地方.

blocks.en: 10.2  The Personal Data Flywheel
blocks.zh: 10.2 (韩语). 个人数据飞轮

blocks.en:
More authorized data gives a more accurate model, which gives more useful help, which earns more trust, which brings more data.
The flywheel is the core technical bet of personal AI, and in a paper it is a research hypothesis with two brakes.
The first is echo .
The symbiont influences the person, then reads the influenced behavior as evidence that the person was always like this, and the model grows ever more certain of a portrait it painted itself.
The remedy is to condition every update on what the system itself did: M t + 1 = 𝒰 ⁡ ( M t , o t + 1 , r t + 1 , a t ) , M_{t+1}\;=\;\mathcal{U}\!\left(M_{t};\;o_{t+1},\,r_{t+1},\,a_{t}\right), (5) where the update of the model M M from new observations o o and self-reports r r must take the system’s own action a t a_{t} as an argument; an update that ignores a t a_{t} reads the result of an intervention as a trait of the person.
Machine learning has a formal account of predictions that change what they predict ( Perdomo et al., 2020 ) .
The second brake is validation : more data does not mean a truer understanding, and every round of updating has to survive the evaluation of Section 17 .
Growth in the person can also be the intended result of help, so change is never treated as contamination by default; what is examined is whether the evidence for an update matches the conclusion drawn from it.
blocks.zh:
更多的授权数据给出了一个更准确的模型,它提供了更有用的帮助,赢得更多的信任,带来更多的数据.
飞轮是个人AI的核心技术赌注,在一篇论文中它是一个带有两个制动器的研究假说.
第一个是回声。
共鸣会影响人,然后将受影响的行为解读为证明人总是这样,模型越来越确定自己画的肖像.
补救措施是将每个更新都附加在系统本身所做的:Mt + 1 = U (M t, o t + 1, r + 1, a t ), M_{t+1}\; =\;\ mathcal{U}\!\ left(M_{t};\;o_{t+1},\,r_{t+1},\, a_{t}\r}\t}\r), (5) 模型MM从新的观察o和自我报告r的更新必须把系统自己的行动当作一个论点;一个忽略 t a_{t}的更新读取干预的结果是个人的特点。
机器学习(Machine learning)对改变其预测的预测有一个正式的叙述(Perdomo等人,2020年).
第二个刹车是验证 : 更多的数据并不意味着一个更真实的理解, 每一轮更新都必须在评价第17节时幸存.
人的成长也可能是帮助的预期结果,因此变化从不被视为默认的污染;所审查的是更新的证据是否与从中得出的结论相符.

blocks.en: 10.3  Learning the Way a Person Learns
blocks.zh: 10.3 学习个人学习方式

blocks.en:
A symbiont has to learn new things the way a person does: in the course of life, from few experiences, incrementally, and without large offline training runs.
The requirement is best stated through an example.
A dialect spoken in a single county has no corpus and sometimes no written form; a person learns it by going there, talking to people, and being corrected.
A symbiont needs the same ability, and it needs it under two constraints: without changing all of its parameters, through local and dynamic adjustment or no parameter change at all, and with generalization from little data.
We write this as a ladder of research targets, each separately testable: remember the sentences it heard; compose expressions it has learned; adapt to a new speaker and accent; transfer to scenes it has not heard.
Meta’s EMG wristband is a ready-made example on the input side: a generic model trained on thousands of people works for a new wearer with no calibration, and twenty minutes of personal data improve it further ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) .
A generic model with a small personal adaptation is the learning curve this section argues for, with the object changed from gestures to a dialect and a mind.
Test-time training ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) and memory layers that learn at test time ( Behrouz et al., 2025 ) are the technical lineage, and several leading researchers have named continual, sample-efficient learning as the next frontier; the paper fixes requirements and validation levels and chooses no particular route.
blocks.zh:
一个共鸣者必须学习新的事物,就像一个人所做的那样:在生活中,从很少的经验中,渐进的,没有大型的离线训练运行.
最好用一个例子来说明这一要求。
在一个县里讲的方言没有实体,有时没有书面形式;一个人通过去那里,和人交谈来学习,并被纠正.
一个韵母需要同样的能力,它需要在两个限制下需要它:不改变它的所有参数,通过局部和动态调整或完全不改变参数,以及从很少的数据中概括.
我们把它写成一个研究目标的阶梯,每一个都分别可以测试:记住它听到的句子;编曲它学到的表达语;适应一个新的扬声器和口音;转移到它没有听到的场景.
Meta的EMG腕带是输入面上一个现成的例子:一个训练有素的通用模型,训练有数千人为新穿戴者工作,没有校准,20分钟的个人数据进一步改善了它(Kaifosh等人,2025年).
一个带有小个人适应的通用模型是本节所论证的学习曲线,对象从手势变为方言和心灵.
试验时间培训 (Sun等人,2020年;Sun等人,2025年)和在测试时间学习的内存层(Behrouz等人,2025年)是技术世系,一些主要研究者将持续,有样本效率的学习命名为下一个前沿;纸质修正要求和验证水平,不选择特定途径.

blocks.en:
Learning a Dialect by Living There The symbiont accompanies the person to their hometown.
Over a few days it learns common expressions from their conversations with relatives, confirms the meanings with them, tries to understand and to help them respond the next time, and adjusts when corrected.
The vignette is written to separate what memory alone can do from what requires changing the model, and to say how one would tell “it remembered the sentences” from “it learned the dialect.”
blocks.zh:
在那里学习语言 共鸣者随人至故乡.
在几天的时间里,它从他们与亲属的交谈中学习到共同的表达方式,确认与亲属的含意,试图理解并帮助他们下一次回应,并在纠正时进行调整.
维格内特的写作是为了将记忆本身能做的与需要改变模式的区分开来,并说人们如何从“它学会了方言”中分辨“它记得这些句子”。 “

blocks.en: 10.4  Evolving the Whole Stack
blocks.zh: 10.4 对 整个堆栈的演变

blocks.en:
As understanding of the person deepens, the base model, the harness, and the hardware must all evolve, along three routes that share one set of constraints (Figure 16 ). Base model upgrades. The foundation model changes every few months (Section 3.1 ), and the symbiont cannot be reset with it.
The requirement is the information-level interface of Section 7.4 : the record, the personal model, the intervention policy, and the harness configuration are defined outside the backbone, migrate when it changes, and are recalibrated during a transition period, since a new backbone may estimate the same evidence differently.
This is the paper’s answer to whether a symbiont needs its own private model: what must belong to the person is the record and the model of them, and it is the relationship, and never the weights, that persists.
The films give the failure case; when its owner moved from Jarvis to a successor system, the relationship started over. Self-improvement of the harness. A symbiont may rewrite the way it works: fix a routine for something the person does often, write a tool, accumulate skills in the manner of a skill library ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , rebalance the fast and slow loops, retune the parameters of the intervention policy.
This is self-improvement in a bounded form.
What changes is the harness, which is readable, auditable, and reversible, and every change leaves a record; the model’s own parameters change only by exception. Hardware generations. New glasses, a new band, or a new channel let the symbiont see and say a little more.
The record and the model are bound to no device, and what has to be relearned after a change is only which channel works in which setting, never who the person is, which is the mechanism behind the co-evolution of Section 5.6 .
The shared constraints are four: portability (change any layer and the relationship survives), auditability (what changed and why, visible to the person), reversibility (a bad change can be rolled back), and the echo brake at system level (what the system observes after changing itself cannot be read directly as the person).
One more direction follows: the better the symbiont knows the person, the more specialized its procedures should become and the fewer generic defaults it should keep, and since specialization erodes general ability, a path back to the generic must be kept open, which is the system-side counterpart of the person’s right to do things themselves in the next subsection.
blocks.zh:
随着对人的理解的加深,基础模型,牵引器,硬件都必须沿着共享一套约束的三条路线发展(图16). 基地模式升级. 基础模型每几个月改变一次(第3.1节),共鸣不能与之重置.
要求是第7.4节的信息层面接口:记录,个人模型,干预政策,以及牵引配置在骨干之外定义,变化时迁移,在过渡期间重新校准,因为一个新的骨干可能会对相同的证据作出不同的估计.
这就是论文的答案,一个共鸣是否需要它自己的私人模式:必须属于一个人的是什么是记录和他们的模式,而这种关系,从不重,是持续存在的。
电影给出了失败案例;当它的主人公从贾维斯搬到一个继任系统时,关系开始重现. 自修护持. 一个韵母可能重写其工作方式:为人经常做的事情固定一个常规,写一个工具,以技能库的方式积累技能(Wang等人,2024年),重新平衡快慢循环,重新调整干预政策的参数.
这是一种自我改进, 一种有限度的形式。
变化是可读性、可审计性和可逆性,每个变化都留下记录;模型本身的参数只是例外而改变。 硬件世代. 新眼镜,新乐队,或新频道让共鸣者看到并多说一点.
记录和模型没有被绑定在任何设备上,改变后必须重新发现的只是哪个频道在哪个设置中工作,从不是什么人,这是第5.6节共同演变背后的机制.
共同的制约有四:可移动性(改变任何一层,关系存续),可审计性(改变什么,为什么,人物可见),可逆性(坏变化可以回滚),以及系统层面的回声制动(系统改变自身后观察到的,不能直接读作人物).
还有一个方向是:同义词越了解这个人,其程序就越专业化,其通用的缺省也就越少,而且由于专业化会侵蚀一般的能力,因此回到通用的路径必须保持开放,这是个人在下一小节中自己做事情的权利的系统侧面对应。

blocks.en:
Figure 16 : Co-evolution of a person and a stack.
Above the axis, events in the person’s life; below it, changes in the system: base model upgrades, routines and skills the harness accumulates, new hardware.
Dashed links show life events triggering system learning and system changes altering what is observed next.
The heavy line is the record and personal model, the one thing never replaced.
In the fiction, the counterpart of this growth is Jarvis’s cognitive core eventually gaining a body as the Vision (Section 14.2 ), and the counterexample is Ultron, a separate project whose goals diverged from its maker’s (Section 15.7 ).
blocks.zh:
图16:一个人和一叠的共同演变。
在轴心之上,人物生活中的事件;在下方,系统的变化:基础模型升级、常规和技能、吊带积累、新的硬件。
隐藏的链接显示触发系统学习的生命事件,系统改变改变接下来观察到的东西.
重线是记录和个人型号,唯一没有被替换的东西.
在虚构中,这种增长的对应者是Jarvis的认知核心,最终获得一个像Vision(第14.2节)那样的身体,反之例子是Ultron,它的目标与其制造者不同(第15.7节)。

blocks.en: 10.5  The Person Changes Too
blocks.zh: 10.5 人物变化也

blocks.en:
The symbiont learns the person, and the person changes.
Three changes are possible: the person learns something, which is a gain; they stop practising what they have handed over, which is a gain or a loss depending on whether they wanted to keep it; and their preferences are slowly shaped by the system, which has to be watched.
The symbiont must support both “do this for me” and “I want to learn this myself”, and leave the choice with the person, which is the last layer of Table 9 .
The evidence so far shows harm by default and protection only by design.
Generative AI without guardrails harmed high-school mathematics learning while a guarded version did not ( Bastani et al., 2025 ) , and in a randomized study of developers learning a new library, AI assistance weakened conceptual understanding and debugging without a significant gain in speed, while three of six observed interaction patterns preserved learning ( Shen and Tamkin, 2026 ) .
The old lesson of automation, that the operator who is relieved of a task loses the skill to take it back, still applies ( Bainbridge, 1983 ) .
Section 17.1 counts the consequence under retained ability.
blocks.zh:
韵者学于人,人之变也.
三种变化是可能的:一个人学习一些东西,这就是一种收益;他们停止实践他们交出的东西,这取决于他们是否希望保留这些东西,是一种收益还是一种损失;他们的偏好被系统缓慢地塑造,这个系统必须观察.
“为我这样做”和“我想自己去学习”都必须由个人来选择,这是表9的最后一层。
迄今的证据表明,损害是默认的,只通过设计加以保护。
无护卫的基因AI伤害了高中数学的学习,而有守护的版本却没有伤害(Bastani等人,2025年),在对开发者学习新图书馆的随机研究中,AI协助削弱了概念理解和调试,没有显著的速度收益,而6种观察到的相互作用模式中有3种保留了学习(Shen and Tamkin,2026年).
自动化的旧经验,即被解除任务的操作员失去收回任务的技能,仍然适用(Bainbridge,1983年)。
第17.1节将后果计入保留能力。

blocks.en: 11  The Personal Runtime
blocks.zh: 11 个人运行时间

blocks.en:
Everything in the previous six sections has to run somewhere.
This is the layer that, in the stack of Figure 5 , sits between the foundation models and the agentic harness, and that may in time grow into an AI-native operating system.
We call it a runtime and do not propose to rewrite an operating system.
blocks.zh:
前六节中一切事皆得运行处.
在图5的堆栈中,这个层坐落在基底模型和代理吊带之间,这可能会及时发展成AI-内置操作系统.
我们称之为运行时间,不提议重写操作系统.

blocks.en: 11.1  Beyond an App
blocks.zh: 11.1 应用程序以外

blocks.en:
A symbiont needs persistent state across devices, a single permission model, scheduling of several senses and several output channels, management of the fast and slow loops, delegation to standard agents, and the one entry point for every context of Section 6.2 .
These requirements exceed any single application and fall short of a new kernel.
The personal runtime is the layer that meets them, and it can grow over time into the AI-native operating system of our vision, once enough devices and applications treat it as their entry point.
blocks.zh:
symbiont需要持续状态跨设备,单一许可模式,多个感官和多个输出通道的排程,快速和慢循环的管理,对标准代理的授权,以及第6.2节每个上下文的一个切入点.
这些要求超过了任何单一的应用程序,并且没有达到一个新的内核.
个人运行时间是与之相遇的层,随着时间的推移,它可以成长到我们视觉的AI-native操作系统中,一旦足够多的设备和应用程序将它作为它们的切入点.

blocks.en: 11.2  Layers

Figure 17 expands the upper part of Figure 5 .
From the bottom: the device constellation; base capabilities, a shared omni-modal model, a world model, and small on-device models, all replaceable; runtime services, identity, permissions, device abstraction, continuity, the attention budget, and entry-point aggregation; the harness, which plans, uses tools, delegates to standard agents, schedules the two loops, and holds the procedures and skills it has written for itself; and at the top the record and the personal model, which are bound to no backbone and are portable.
The trust layer of Section 12 runs through all of them.
Two points organize the figure: the base is replaceable and the record and model are never replaced, and the harness and the runtime divide the labor, the first getting things done and the second making them happen on the right device, with the right permission, at the right time.
blocks.zh:
图17扩大了图5的上部。
从底层:设备星座;基础能力,一个共享的全米模式模型,一个世界模型,以及小型的机载模型,都是可以替换的;运行时服务,身份,权限,设备抽象,连续性,注意力预算,以及入口点汇总;使用绳套,用于规划,使用工具,代表给标准代理,安排两个循环,并持有它为自己编写的程序和技能;在顶端的纪录和个人模型,它们都与没有主干线,是可移植的.
第12节的信托层贯穿了他们全部.
两点组织图: 基础可以替换,记录和模型永远不会被替换, 绳子和运行时间将劳动力分割开来, 首先让事情完成, 其次让事情在正确的设备上发生, 得到正确的允许, 在正确的时间.

blocks.en:
Figure 17 : The personal runtime.
Base capabilities can be swapped freely; the record and personal model at the top are never swapped.
The harness gets things done; the runtime puts them on the right device, with the right permission, at the right time.
The trust layer runs through everything.
blocks.zh:
图17:个人运行时间。
基础能力可以自由互换;顶部的记录和个人模型从不互换.
牵引装置使事情得以完成;运行时间让他们在正确的设备上,在适当的时间,经过适当的许可.
信任层贯穿一切

blocks.en: 11.3  A Harness for a Life
blocks.zh: 11.3 生命的和谐

blocks.en:
Current harnesses are designed around a task (Section 3.2 ): it begins and ends, its input is a span of text, its tools are APIs.
A symbiont’s harness faces a life: nothing begins or ends, the input is a continuous multimodal stream, the tools include a person’s senses and the devices around them, memory is a first-class component, and most of the time the correct output is nothing at all.
Six requirements follow, and the paper states them without a specification: event-driven operation; the record and the personal model as native components; output channels matched to the setting; delegation to standard agents and reclamation of control from them (Section 9.1 ); a log of the system’s own actions, which the echo brake of Section 10.2 needs; and the ability to rewrite itself under audit, which Section 10.4 needs.
This is the layer in which the current harness standard must evolve for the setting, and that evolution is one of the paper’s calls to the community.
blocks.zh:
当前的拉带是围绕一个任务(第3.2节)设计的:它开始和结束,它的输入是跨文本,它的工具是API.
symbiont的束带面对一种生活:没有开始或结束,输入是连续的多模式流,工具包括一个人的感官和周围的装置,内存是一流组件,大多数时候正确的输出完全没有.
随后有6项要求,该文件没有具体说明:事件驱动操作;记录和个人模式作为原生组成部分;产出渠道与设定相匹配;向标准代理人下放权力,并从中恢复控制(第9.1节);系统自身行动的记录,这是第10.2节需要的回响制动;以及第10.4节需要的重写能力。
这是当前驾驭标准必须演进的层层,而演化是报纸对社区的呼声之一。

blocks.en: 11.4  The Cost of Always-On Cognition
blocks.zh: 11.4 始终保持认知的成本

blocks.en:
AI that computes around the clock depends heavily on compute and infrastructure, and the question of what happens when AI compute becomes cheap infrastructure deserves a direct answer.
Cost has a structure that can be optimized.
Most of the time a lightweight on-device model does nothing but detect events; a few events wake a heavy model, on the device or in the cloud; the night is used for consolidation.
Three research quantities follow: the compute budget per person per day, the leverage of event detection on total cost, and the effect of the split between local and cloud on privacy and latency.
Whether the paradigm is economical depends on the duty cycle and not on model size.
If inference costs keep falling at the rate of recent years and on-device models keep improving, one always-on symbiont per person becomes affordable before it becomes trusted, and the bottleneck moves once more, to Section 12 .
blocks.zh:
24小时计算的AI在很大程度上取决于计算和基础设施,当AI计算成为廉价基础设施时会发生什么问题值得直接回答.
成本结构可以优化.
大多数时候,轻量级的安装模型只能探测事件;少数事件会唤醒一个重度模型,在设备上或云中;夜晚用于整合.
接下来有三个研究量:计算每人每天的预算,事件检测在总成本上的杠杆作用,以及局部和云对隐私和延迟的影响.
范式是否经济,取决于值班周期,而不是模型大小.
如果推论费用继续以近年的速度下降,而且设备模型不断改进,那么,在人们相信之前,一个人总是可以承受得起一个符号,而瓶颈再次转到第12节。

blocks.en: 11.5  Continuity
blocks.zh: 11.5 连续性

blocks.en:
Continuity is the runtime’s central duty, in three forms.
Across devices: what the person started at the desk continues when they walk out the door.
Across interruptions: when a battery dies, the person switches off collection, or the network drops, the system knows which stretch it missed and, on recovery, does not pretend to have been there.
Across upgrades: when the base model or the device changes, the person’s symbiont is still theirs (Section 10.4 ).
The second form is the most often forgotten and the most damaging to trust when it fails.
blocks.zh:
连续性是运行时间的核心责任,有三种形式。
横跨设备:在桌子上的人走出去后,从桌子上开始的继续.
断断续续:当一个电池死亡时, 个人关闭收集, 或网络下降, 系统知道哪些拉长它错过了,
整个升级:当基本模型或设备发生变化时,个人的韵母仍然是他们的(第10.4节)。
第二种形式是最经常被遗忘的,在失败时对信任最有害的.

blocks.en: 12  Trust
blocks.zh: 12个信托基金

blocks.en:
By what right does a system enter a person’s life?
The judgment that organizes this section is that the largest obstacle to a symbiont, ahead of any technical one, is whether people will find it safe enough to open their whole context to it, the physical and the mental alike.
Trust is therefore treated as part of the architecture.
This section is about design; the risks that design does not remove, and their governance, are the subject of Part IV.
blocks.zh:
一个系统凭什么进入一个人的生活?
组织这一节的判断是,一个共鸣的最大障碍,在任何技术障碍之前,是人们是否会发现它足够安全,从而打开他们整个背景,身体和精神都一样。
因此,信任被视为建筑的一部分。
本节涉及设计;设计未能消除的风险及其治理,是第四部分的主题.

blocks.en: 12.1  Trust Is the Adoption Problem
blocks.zh: 12.1 信任是收养问题

blocks.en:
A symbiont asks for authorization without precedent.
It sees what the person sees, hears what they hear, keeps their life, infers their thoughts, and spends and speaks on their behalf.
No existing product has asked for this much.
The paper therefore reads “full open context” as a process and never as a precondition: the system has to be useful under very little authorization and earn more as trust accumulates.
blocks.zh:
一个共鸣人请求授权,没有先例.
其见其人所见,闻其所闻,守其生命,推其思虑,施舍而代其言.
没有任何现有产品要求这样做。
因此,该文件将“完全开放的上下文”视为一个过程,绝不是先决条件:该系统必须在很少的授权下发挥作用,并在信任积累时获得更多的收益。

blocks.en: 12.2  The Trust Curve
blocks.zh: 12.2 信托曲线

blocks.en:
Figure 18 plots authorization against time together and value delivered.
Data authorization climbs in steps, from desktop and text, to voice and calendar, to first-person sight and sound, to physiology, to the private channel of thought, and each step has something the system must prove first.
Action permission climbs on a parallel curve, from look to suggest to draft to undoable execution to final execution (Section 9.1 ).
The curve can fall: a breach sends authorization back a step, although it cannot undo an exfiltration, so the step back limits further exposure only, which is one more reason the most private data stays on the device.
Three principles govern tiered access.
The system must be useful at every level, so that “give me everything and then I can help” is never the offer.
Data from a higher level is never used automatically for a task at a lower level.
Processing stays local by preference, with the most private data handled closest to the body.
This is also the answer to the question most often asked first about the paradigm, whether the system must watch everything to be worth anything: it must not, and the separate authorization of each source in Table 7 is the cross-section of the curve.
blocks.zh:
图18 与时间和交付价值对照的地块授权。
数据授权依步骤攀升,从桌面和文本,到语音和日历,到第一人称视觉和声音,到生理学,到私人的思想渠道,每个步骤都有系统必须先证明的东西.
行动许可在平行曲线上攀升,从视线到建议起草可撤销的处决到最终处决(第9.1节)。
曲线可以掉落:违反者会向后发送一个步骤的授权,尽管它无法取消一个过滤,因此退步只能进一步限制曝光,这也是设备上最私密的数据停留的另一个原因.
分层获取有三项原则。
该制度必须在各个层次都有用,这样“给我一切,然后我可以帮助”就永远不是提议。
来自更高层次的数据从未自动用于较低层次的任务.
处理按偏好保留在本地,处理最私密的数据离身体最近。
这也是对最常被问到的关于范式的答案,系统是否必须观察一切才有价值的东西:它决不能,表7中每个源的单独授权是曲线的横截面.

blocks.en:
Figure 18 : The trust curve.
Data authorization (solid, read on the left axis) and action permission (dashed, read on the right axis) climb in steps as time together and delivered value accumulate.
Each data level names what must be proved before the next is opened, each action level is earned a little after the data level it needs, and a breach sends authorization back one step.
The system has to be useful at the lowest level already.
blocks.zh:
图18:信托曲线。
数据授权(solid,在左轴上读)和动作权限(dashed,在右轴上读)随着时间加在一起并交付值的累积而成步爬升.
每个数据级别名称在打开下个级别之前必须证明的内容,每个动作级别在它需要的数据级别之后得到一点收入,一个违反会向后发送一个步骤的授权.
该系统必须在最低一级发挥作用。

blocks.en: 12.3  The Symbiont’s Code
blocks.zh: 12.3 共同守则

blocks.en:
A personal AI should have values and a code of its own.
We start from three rules, complete command of the owner’s information, responsibility to the owner, and protection of privacy and data security, and rewrite them as commitments that can be checked, with three additions. • Know only what you are permitted to know, and know it as accurately as possible. “Complete command” cannot stand ethically or legally; the standard is completeness within authorization. • Answer to the person, and to the interests the person endorses on reflection. Never to a passing impulse, and never to a third party: a platform, an advertiser, or an employer.
Section 15.6 takes up the institutional conflict this creates. • Protect the person’s privacy, and the privacy of the people around them. • Do not manipulate. The system that knows a person best is the system best placed to steer them, and it must forgo that ability. • Be pausable, correctable, and leavable. • Follow the rules the person has accepted, even against a passing wish. A person who sits an examination, signs a contract, or joins a game has accepted its rules, and a symbiont that answers to the interests the person endorses on reflection does not help them break those rules (Section 16.2 ). The aspiration that such a system be unbreakable is replaced by verifiability and tamper evidence: no system is unbreakable, and its behavior can be audited.
blocks.zh:
个人AI应该有自己的价值和代码.
我们从三项规则开始,完全掌握所有者的信息,对所有者的责任,以及保护隐私和数据安全,并把它们改写为可以检查的承诺,加上三项内容。 只知道你们被允许知道的事, 并尽可能准确地知道。 “完成指挥”不能在道德上或法律上站立;标准是在授权范围内的完整性。 • 答复个人及其在思考时赞同的利益。 永远不要向过往的冲动,永远不要向第三方:平台,广告商,或雇主.
第15.6节讨论了由此产生的体制冲突。 • 支助 - 保护个人隐私及其周围人民的隐私。 不要操纵。 最了解一个人的系统是指导他们的最佳系统,它必须放弃这种能力。 • 贫乏、可纠正和可逃逸。 遵守人所接受的规则,即使违背过去的愿望。 参加考试、签署合同或参加比赛的人已接受其规则,而回答其反省所赞同的利益的共鸣无助于他们违反这些规则(第16.2节)。 这种系统无法破解的愿望被可核查和篡改证据所取代:任何系统都不能破解,其行为可以审计.

blocks.en: Know only what you are permitted to know, and know it as accurately as possible. “Complete command” cannot stand ethically or legally; the standard is completeness within authorization.
blocks.zh: 只知道你们被允许知道的事, 并尽可能准确地知道。 “完成指挥”不能在道德上或法律上站立;标准是在授权范围内的完整性。

blocks.en:
Answer to the person, and to the interests the person endorses on reflection. Never to a passing impulse, and never to a third party: a platform, an advertiser, or an employer.
Section 15.6 takes up the institutional conflict this creates.
blocks.zh:
答复个人,并答复个人在思考时赞同的利益。 永远不要向过往的冲动,永远不要向第三方:平台,广告商,或雇主.
第15.6节讨论了由此产生的体制冲突。

blocks.en: Protect the person’s privacy, and the privacy of the people around them.
blocks.zh: 保护个人的隐私和周围人民的隐私。

blocks.en: Do not manipulate. The system that knows a person best is the system best placed to steer them, and it must forgo that ability.
blocks.zh: 不要操纵。 最了解一个人的系统是指导他们的最佳系统,它必须放弃这种能力。

blocks.en: Be pausable, correctable, and leavable.
blocks.zh: 是贫乏的,可以纠正的,和可以离开的。

blocks.en: Follow the rules the person has accepted, even against a passing wish. A person who sits an examination, signs a contract, or joins a game has accepted its rules, and a symbiont that answers to the interests the person endorses on reflection does not help them break those rules (Section 16.2 ).
blocks.zh: 遵守人所接受的规则,即使违背过去的愿望。 参加考试、签署合同或参加比赛的人已接受其规则,而回答其反省所赞同的利益的共鸣无助于他们违反这些规则(第16.2节)。

blocks.en: 12.4  The Privacy of Thought
blocks.zh: 12.4 思想的隐私

blocks.en:
A symbiont creates a category of data that has never been collected by any system: the thoughts a person whispers on the private channel, the mental states the system infers, and, as neural interfaces mature, signals of attention and intent read from the body itself.
We call it thought data and argue that it deserves protection above every other kind of personal data: local by default, never used for training by default, deletable at any time, and never exchanged with anyone.
The neuroethics literature’s discussion of mental privacy applies with little change ( Yuste et al., 2017 ) , and the term cognitive sovereignty names the right at stake.
blocks.zh:
一个韵母会生成一个从未被任何系统收集过的数据类别:一个人在私人通道上低语的思想,精神表达系统推断,随着神经界面的成熟,注意力和意向信号从身体本身读取.
我们称它为深思熟虑的数据,并主张它应该比其他所有类型的个人数据都更值得保护: 默认的本地数据,从未用于默认的培训,在任何时候都可以删除,也从未与任何人交换.
神经伦理学文献对精神隐私的讨论几乎没有改变(Yuste等人,2017年),认知主权一词命名了利害关系的权利.

blocks.en: 12.5  The People Around You
blocks.zh: 12.5 你周围的人

blocks.en:
A symbiont hears other people speak and sees their faces.
Three requirements follow.
Collection must be perceptible to the people nearby.
What has passed between the person and someone else may be kept in the person’s record, as a diary would keep it, while inferences about that person serve only the interaction at hand and never accumulate into a portrait (Section 6.7 ); a sensitive fact the person was told about someone else, such as their health, is kept only as told and is never analyzed or passed on.
Raw audio and video of other people are kept no longer than the short window in which they serve the person (Section 6.3 ), and where someone asks not to be recorded the device stops.
An opt-out is not enough where the law asks for more.
Some jurisdictions require the consent of everyone recorded in a private conversation ( State of California, 2024 ) , biometric statutes require written consent before a template of a face is made ( Illinois General Assembly, 2008 ) , and data-protection law requires a lawful basis for processing a bystander’s data and treats biometric data as a special category ( European Parliament and Council of the European
Union, 2016 ) .
A symbiont therefore follows the strictest rule of the place it is in, which in many places means that it records no conversation at all and serves the person from what they tell it.
Contextual integrity explains why the same information is appropriate in one setting and wrong in another ( Nissenbaum, 2004 ) , and studies of bystanders of augmented-reality glasses show what people around a wearer actually want ( Denning et al., 2014 ) .
blocks.zh:
一个共鸣者听到其他人说话,看到他们的脸.
以下三项要求。
收藏必须能感知到附近的人们.
个人与他人之间的事迹可以保存在个人的档案中,因为日记会保留它,而关于此人的推断只服务于手头的相互作用,从未积累成肖像(第6.7节);一个敏感的事实是,此人被告知他人的情况,如其健康,只按规定保存,从未分析或传递。
其他人的原始音频和视频保存时间不超过他们为该人服务的短窗口(第6.3节),如果有人要求不记录,设备就会停止。
法律要求更多选择退出是不够的。
一些司法管辖区要求在私下谈话中记录的每个人的同意(加利福尼亚州,2024年),生物鉴别法规要求在制作面部模板之前获得书面同意(伊利诺伊州大会,2008年),数据保护法要求有合法依据处理旁观者的数据,并将生物鉴别数据作为一个特殊类别处理(欧洲议会和欧洲委员会)。
联合, 2016).
因此,韵母遵循它所在位置的最严格规则,这在许多地方意味着它完全不记录对话,并且服务于人们所说的话。
背景完整性解释了为何同一信息在一个场合是适当的,而在另一个场合是错误的(Nissenbaum,2004年),对增强真实性眼镜旁观者的研究表明,佩戴者周围的人实际上想要什么(Denning等人,2014年)。

blocks.en: 12.6  A Symbiont Is a Target
blocks.zh: 12.6 协同是目标

blocks.en:
Security takes a new shape.
The symbiont holds the person’s whole life, so it is the most valuable thing to attack; it hears what the person hears, so a sentence someone says in front of them can be an injection; it acts and spends for the person, so a hijacked symbiont does real damage; and it rewrites its own harness, so an attack can consist of making it break itself.
The paper offers no solution and names four classes of threat with their research directions: data exfiltration, injection through the physical world, manipulation of the intervention policy, and contamination of the self-improvement process.
blocks.zh:
保安工作有了新特点。
共鸣维持了人的一生,所以是攻击最有价值的东西;它听到的人听到什么,所以有人在他们前面说一句话可以是一种注射;它为人行为和花费,所以被劫持的共鸣会做真正的破坏;它会改写自己的绳索,所以攻击可以包括使自己断裂.
论文没有给出解决方案,并用研究方向命名了四类威胁:数据过滤,注入物理世界,操纵干预政策,污染自我改进过程.

blocks.en: 12.7  Design Principles
blocks.zh: 12.7 设计原则

blocks.en:
Table 14 gathers nine design principles, each derived from one section, each stated as a requirement on the system with a way to check it.
Other sections state more specific rules, and these nine are the ones that apply across the whole system.
They are positions, with no interface standard behind them, and they carry no field definitions and no compliance tests.
blocks.zh:
表14收集了9项设计原则,每个原则来自一个部分,每个部分作为系统的一项要求,并附有检查方法。
其他章节则阐述更为具体的规则,这9条是适用于整个系统的规则.
它们是位置,后面没有接口标准,它们没有实地定义,也没有合规性测试.

blocks.en: Table 14 : Design principles for cognitive symbionts. Each is derived from one stage of the loop, states a requirement on the system, and names a check. They are design positions, not an interface standard.
blocks.zh: 表14:认知共鸣的设计原理. 每一个都来自循环的某一阶段,说明对系统的要求,并点名检查. 它们是设计位置,不是接口标准.

blocks.en: Part III
blocks.zh: 第三编

blocks.en: Where This Leads
blocks.zh: 这引领何处

blocks.en:
Part III widens the view from one augmented individual to many, and asks what the paradigm is worth.
Section 13 asks who stands to gain, population by population, using the four criteria that turn “everyone can benefit” into an argument, and it says who should not come first.
Section 14 describes a world in which augmented individuals and embodied robots share the same rooms.
blocks.zh:
第三部分将观点从个人扩大到许多人,并询问这种模式的价值。
第13节询问,根据人口情况,利用将“每个人都可以受益”变成论据的四项标准,谁可以受益? 该条指出,谁不应该先得。
第14节描述了一个世界,在这个世界中,增强个人和体现的机器人共用同一个房间。

blocks.en:
Part III widens the view from one augmented individual to many, and asks what the paradigm is worth.
Section 13 asks who stands to gain, population by population, using the four criteria that turn “everyone can benefit” into an argument, and it says who should not come first.
Section 14 describes a world in which augmented individuals and embodied robots share the same rooms.
blocks.zh:
第三部分将观点从个人扩大到许多人,并询问这种模式的价值。
第13节询问,根据人口情况,利用将“每个人都可以受益”变成论据的四项标准,谁可以受益? 该条指出,谁不应该先得。
第14节描述了一个世界,在这个世界中,增强个人和体现的机器人共用同一个房间。

blocks.en: 13  Whom It Serves
blocks.zh: 13个服务对象

blocks.en:
The first question of Part III is who stands to gain, and the answer is almost everyone, from a person with no special job or need to the most demanding expert.
A claim of that breadth has no value as a list of wishes, so this section first gives a way of arguing it, then argues population by population, and ends by saying who should not come first.
blocks.zh:
第三部分的第一个问题就是谁能够受益,答案几乎是每个人,从一个没有特殊工作或需要的人到要求最高的专家。
声称这种宽度作为愿望清单是没有价值的,因此本节首先给出了一种论证方法,然后按人口来论证人口,最后说谁不应该先来.

blocks.en: 13.1  Universal Need, Uneven Gap
blocks.zh: 13.1 普遍需要、不平等差距

blocks.en:
The invariant of the paper is what turns “everyone can benefit” into an argument.
Everyone pays the cognitive gap of Eq. ( 1 ) every day.
How much of it a symbiont can close differs by population, and four criteria say by how much: the size of the gap, how much a group loses daily to forgetting, not noticing, not thinking through, and not finding the words; its observability , whether those losses are visible to the symbiont’s senses, since some gaps happen entirely inside; its closability , whether a row of Table 12 matches it at a usable maturity; and the feasibility of channels and trust , whether the group is willing and able to wear the devices and how far it will authorize them.
The natural first population is the one of highest cognitive density, professionals whose gaps are easiest to observe and who will pay to close them.
The same symbiont may be worth more to three other groups: older adults whose memory is failing, for whom it is a memory prosthesis; people who are learning, for whom it knows what they do not; and people whose senses or language are limited, for whom it is a channel they lack.
Figure 19 maps populations on two of these dimensions, the size and stakes of the gap and how much of it can be closed today (observability times closability), with bubble size for population and color for the maturity of the evidence; feasibility is argued in the text, and the rest of the section argues each bubble.
blocks.zh:
论文的变数是“每个人都可以受益”成为争论的原因。
每个人都每天支付Eq的认知差距(1美元).
共鸣体有多少能因人口而异,有四个标准说有多少:差距的大小,一个群体每天损失多少会忘记、不注意、不思考和不找到字句;它的可观察性,这些损失是否在共鸣体的感官中明显可见,因为有些差距完全发生在内部;它的可分性,一行表12是否在可用成熟时与它相符;以及渠道和信任的可行性,群体是否愿意和能够穿戴这些装置,以及它会授权这些装置达到什么程度。
自然的第一人群是认知密度最高的人群,其差距最容易观察到的专业人士,他们会付钱来弥补.
同样的共鸣可能比其他三个群体更值钱:记忆衰弱的老年人,对于他们来说是记忆假体;正在学习的人,它知道他们不知道什么;感官或语言有限的人,这是他们缺乏的渠道。
图19列出了其中两个维度的种群,差距的大小和利害关系,以及今天可以关闭多少(可观察时间可阻塞性),人口有气泡大小,证据成熟的颜色;文字中论证可行性,其余部分论证每个气泡.

blocks.en:
Figure 19 : A map of beneficiaries.
Horizontal: how much of a population’s gap a symbiont can close today (observability times closability).
Vertical: the size and stakes of the gap.
Bubble size is population; color is the maturity of the evidence.
Positions are the author’s judgments, not measurements.
blocks.zh:
图19:受益人地图。
水平:一个共鸣体今天能关闭多少人口间隙(可观察时间可凝聚性).
垂直:差距的大小和利害关系。
泡泡大小是人口;颜色是证据的成熟度.
立场是作者的判断,而不是衡量。

blocks.en: 13.2  Everyday Life
blocks.zh: 13.2 日常生活

blocks.en:
The gaps of an ordinary day are modest in size and relentless in frequency: a bill, a parcel, a promise to a child; the signs one misses, one’s own fatigue, a partner’s mood; the decisions one cannot think through, whether to change jobs or move; the words one cannot find for a parent or a manager; and the errands of the whole first tier.
Most of these are observable, since they happen in calendars, messages, and conversations.
Closability is high: the first tier is available now and the everyday emotional and decision functions need research.
The obstacle is feasibility, price and trust, and it is the largest obstacle any group faces.
The value takes the form of ease: a little less forgotten, a little less wrong, a little more of one’s own time.
An ordinary person has no need of Jarvis; a helper that remembers, arrives in time, and does not interrupt is enough.
This is also the positive form of the fairness question in Section 15.7 : a paradigm that reaches only those who can pay forgoes its largest total value.
blocks.zh:
平日的空档规模不大,频率不减:账单、包裹、对孩子的承诺、错过的征兆、自己的疲劳、伴侣的情绪、无法思考的决定(无论是换工作还是搬家)、无法为父母或经理找到的言辞、以及整个第一层的差事。
其中大多数是可观察的,因为它们发生在日历、信息和对话中。
可克隆性很高:第一层现在已经具备,日常情感和决策功能需要研究.
障碍是可行性、价格和信任,这是任何团体面临的最大障碍。
其价值表现为轻松:少一点被遗忘,少一点错误,多一点自己的时间.
普通人不需要贾维斯;帮助人记住,及时到达,不打断就够了.
这也是第15.7节中公平问题的积极形式:这种范式只涉及那些能够放弃其最大总价值的人。

blocks.en: 13.3  Knowledge Work
blocks.zh: 13.3 知识工作

blocks.en:
Researchers, engineers, managers, clinicians, lawyers, founders, negotiators, and diplomats share high decision density, large information loads, short windows, and a high price for a wrong sentence.
Their gaps lie in three places: real-time recall in meetings and conversations (Section 9.4 ), threads that span weeks and months (Section 9.2 ), and blindness to their own state under load (Section 9.3 ).
The gaps are large, nearly all observable, since the day is lived in screens and meetings, closable with current technology for the meeting case (Section 8 ), and most feasible of all, since this group pays for productivity and will wear the devices.
They come first because they are the easiest group on which to verify the paradigm, whatever the size of their need.
A researcher gains a record in which every branch of a years-long question is kept, with metacognitive and creative support; a clinician gains real-time recall in consultation and an organized account of what the patient said, with diagnostic decisions explicitly outside the boundary; a manager or negotiator draws most on the relations layer, the shared history with each counterpart, while real-time reading of the other side stays within the limits of Section 15.5 and the law of the workplace.
The section treats this group as the most easily verified proving ground.
blocks.zh:
研究人员,工程师,管理者,临床医生,律师,创始人,谈判者,外交官共同拥有高决定密度,高信息负荷,短窗,错误判决价格高.
它们的空白存在于三个方面:在会议和谈话中实时召回(第9.4节),持续数周和数月的线条(第9.2节),以及在负荷下对其自身状态视而不见(第9.3节)。
差距很大,几乎都是可以观察到的,因为这一天是在屏幕和会议中度过的,与目前用于会议情况(第8节)的技术密不可分,而且最可行的是,这一群体为生产力付费,并将佩戴设备。
他们先来是因为他们是最容易核实范式的团体,无论他们的需要有多大。
研究人员获得的记录是,每一分部门都保留了长达一年的问题,并得到了元认识和创造性的支持;临床医生通过协商获得实时召回,并有条不紊地讲述了病人所说的话,诊断决定明确在边界之外;经理或谈判员从关系层汲取了大部分信息,与每个对应方共享历史,而实时阅读对方内容则停留在第15.5节和工作场所法的范围内。
本节将这组人视为最容易核实的证明地.

blocks.en: 13.4  Learners and Teachers
blocks.zh: 13.4 学生和教师

blocks.en:
Learning is where the value of a symbiont is clearest and where restraint matters most.
A student gains a tutor that has seen every place they got stuck and can give a hint at the right moment instead of an answer; a language learner gains a hand in real conversation; an adult learner changing fields gains a bridge from what they know to what is new.
A teacher gains real-time social cognition in the classroom, which student has fallen behind, and afterwards notes on each student’s progress, kept within the rules the school sets for student data.
The gap is large and long; the process is largely observable; closability is moderate, with the effect of one-to-one tutoring as the backdrop ( Bloom, 1984 ) and the evidence of Section 10.5 as the warning; feasibility for minors is a separate question (Section 13.9 ).
The default in learning has to be the hint, with “I want to learn this myself” as a first-class option.
blocks.zh:
学习是共鸣的价值最清楚的地方,也是约束最重要的地方.
一个学生得到了一个教师,他已经看到了他们被困的每一个地方,可以在正确的时刻而不是一个答案给出提示;一个语言学习者在真正的对话中得到了帮助;一个成人学习者在改变田野的过程中从他们知道的东西到新的东西获得了桥梁.
一名教师在课堂上获得了实时的社会认知,学生已经落在后面,后来记录了每个学生的进步情况,这符合学校学生数据的规则。
差距很大,而且很长;这一过程在很大程度上是可观察到的;可阻塞性是中等的,其效果是一对一的辅导作为背景(Bloom,1984年),第10.5节的证据作为警告;对未成年人的可行性是一个单独的问题(第13.9节)。
学习的默认必须是暗示,“我想自己学习”是一流的选择。

blocks.en: 13.5  Families Across the Life Course
blocks.zh: 13.5 终身家庭

blocks.en:
Three generations have three gaps.
Parents are short of sleep, overloaded, and carried along by their children’s emotions; the symbiont serves the parent, helping them stay steady, remember, and notice, and any sensing of a child passes through the parent’s authorization and is limited to safety and development.
Children do not, in this paper, have all-day symbionts of their own; their gaps are served indirectly through parents and teachers, for reasons given in Sections 13.9 and 16.7 .
Older adults sit in the upper right of Figure 19 .
The gap of memory decline is the most literal instance of Definition 4.1 ; it is highly observable, since the forgotten thing is right there; it has precedent, in the SenseCam studies of memory-impaired patients ( Berry et al., 2007 ) ; and its obstacles are wearing and learning cost, so the symbiont of an older adult must be the simplest of all.
The value is independence for a few more years and a few more degrees of connection to family, and the caregivers of Section 9.5 belong to the same picture.
The ethical weight here is second only to Section 13.7 : for people whose capacity to consent is declining, authorization itself is the question, and the paper requires proxy authorization with exit available at all times.
blocks.zh:
三代有三广.
父母睡眠不足、负担过重、由孩子的情感所承载;共鸣为父母服务,帮助他们保持稳定、记忆和注意,任何对孩子的感知都经过父母的许可,仅限于安全和发育。
在本文中,儿童没有自己的全天韵;由于第13.9和16.7节所述的原因,他们的差距通过父母和教师间接地得到服务。
老年人坐在图19右上方。
记忆力下降的差距是定义4.1中最客观的例子;它非常明显,因为被遗忘的东西就在那里;它有先例,在SenseCam对记忆障碍患者的研究中(Berry等人,2007年),它的障碍是穿戴和学习成本,因此老年的共鸣必须是最简单的.
第9.5节的照顾者属于同一情况。
这里的伦理权重仅次于第13.7条:对于同意能力正在下降的人来说,授权本身是问题所在,而该文件需要随时可以退出的代理授权。

blocks.en: 13.6  Sensory, Motor, Cognitive, and Language Barriers
blocks.zh: 13.6 感官、汽车、认知和语言障碍

blocks.en:
For people whose abilities are limited, a symbiont is a channel before it is an augmentation, and the evidence here is the most mature in the paper.
For blind and low-vision users, first-person description and navigation already exist ( Be My Eyes, 2023 ; Microsoft, 2017 ) , and what the symbiont adds is that it knows the person’s surroundings and their people.
For deaf and hard-of-hearing users, live captions and speaker identification are what a line in the glasses was made for.
For users with motor impairments, EMG and silent-speech input, neural interfaces as they mature, and the errands of the first tier have the highest value of any group.
For people with cognitive differences, there is executive-function support for starting and switching tasks, and real-time support for social cues, where the design must support and never correct, with the person defining what help they want.
For migrants, second-language speakers, and dialect communities, the cultural frame switching of Section 9.4 is daily survival.
All four criteria score high, and this group already wears assistive devices.
The accessibility tradition of “nothing about us without us” applies: these users should define their own symbionts.
blocks.zh:
对于能力有限的人来说,一个韵母是先于增强的通道,这里的证据是论文中最成熟的.
对盲人和低视用户来说,第一人称描述和导航已经存在(Be My Eyes, 2023; 微软, 2017), 共和体补充的是它知道人物的周围及其人民.
对聋哑和听力困难的用户来说,现场字幕和扬声器识别是眼镜中排行的原因。
对于有运动障碍的用户,EMG和无声语音输入,神经界面在成熟时,第一层的差事具有任何组的最高值.
对有认知差异的人来说,对于开始和切换任务有行政功能支持,对于社会提示有实时支持,设计必须支持并且永远不纠正,由个人来定义他们想要什么帮助.
对于移民、第二语言使用者和方言社区,第9.4节的文化框架转换是日常生存。
这四个标准都得分很高,这组人已经穿着辅助器具.
“没有我们,我们什么也谈不上”的无障碍传统是适用的:这些用户应确定自己的共鸣。

blocks.en: 13.7  Mental Health and Wellbeing
blocks.zh: 13.7 精神健康和福利

blocks.en:
Three groups belong here: people under long-term pressure approaching burnout, people with mild to moderate anxiety or depressive symptoms, and people in professional treatment.
The gap is the largest in the paper, since emotional distress consumes cognitive bandwidth directly and shrinks the c t c_{t} of Definition 4.1 .
Observability is moderate and rising, since sleep, social withdrawal, and changes in language are all perceptible, and the interpretation of each is fragile.
Closability is split: a first randomized trial of a generative chatbot for treatment reported reductions in symptoms ( Heinz et al., 2025 ) , while evidence on unsupervised use over long periods remains thin.
Feasibility is paradoxical: this group needs the private channel most and fears for its data most.
The position of the paper is to enter through support and early recognition and never through treatment, to make the handoff to professionals part of the function, and to place people in serious distress in the upper left of Figure 19 : a large gap that cannot be closed first.
blocks.zh:
三组属于这里:长期压力逼近烧焦的人,中度焦虑或抑郁症状的人,以及接受专业治疗的人.
这一差距在报纸上是最大的,因为感情痛苦直接消耗认知带宽,缩小了定义4.1中的c t = = t = t 。
观察力是温和和上升的,因为睡眠,社会退缩,语言的变化都是可以理解的,每个语言的诠释都是脆弱的.
可克隆性被分割:首次随机试验一个基因聊天器进行治疗,报告症状减少(Heinz等人,2025年),而长时间无监督使用的证据仍然稀薄.
可行性是自相矛盾的:这一群体最需要私人渠道,对其数据最担心。
论文的立场是通过支持和早期识别进入,从不通过治疗进入,让专业人士得到部分功能的交接,并将处于严重困境的人放在图19的左上方:一个无法先关闭的巨大缺口.

blocks.en: 13.8  Public-Facing and High-Stakes Roles
blocks.zh: 13.8 公共形象和高姿态角色

blocks.en:
These are people whose work is real-time interaction with others under a high cost of error: frontline service and customer-facing staff (recalling this person, reading this moment), teachers (Section 13.4 ), emergency and safety personnel (an external working memory and checklist under pressure), interpreters and diplomats (all of Section 9.4 ).
Their gap is concentrated in real-time social cognition, highly observable, closable to the degree the fast loop’s latency and accuracy allow (Section 8.2 ), and feasible since the workplace already permits worn devices.
The ethical question is the employer: whom the symbiont answers to (the commitment of Section 12.3 to answer to the person) is sharpest inside an employment relation, and compelled wearing is one of the cases of the next subsection.
blocks.zh:
这些人的工作是在错误的高昂代价下与其他人进行实时互动的:前线服务和客户服务人员(召回此人,阅读这一时刻)、教师(第13.4节)、应急和安全人员(外部工作记忆和压力下核对表)、口译员和外交官(全部为第9.4节)。
它们的差距集中在实时社会认知、高度可观察、视快循环的耐久性和准确性而定(第8.2节),而且可行,因为工作场所已经允许磨损的装置。
道德问题在于雇主:同义词对雇主的回答(第12.3节对当事人的回答)在雇用关系中最为尖锐,强迫穿戴是下一小节的案例之一。

blocks.en: 13.9  Who Should Not Come First
blocks.zh: 13.9 谁不应该先来?

blocks.en:
Three groups should not be first, and saying so is part of the argument.
Children with all-day sensing of their own: consent, development, and the permanence of a lifelong record are unresolved, and children are served through the symbionts of the adults around them.
People in acute psychological crisis with a symbiont as their only support: not until handoff paths are mature.
Anyone in a compelled setting, an employer’s requirement, an institution’s rule, a correctional facility: the premise of a symbiont is the person’s own authorization, and a compelled system is a monitor, which is one of the futures of Section 15.7 .
The resulting order follows.
The first adopters are knowledge workers, because they are the easiest to verify.
The largest gain per person is for older adults and for people with barriers, because their gaps are the most direct.
The largest total gain is in everyday life, because the population is the largest.
The research agenda of Section 17 has to design evidence for all three lines separately, and Table 15 closes the section with the dominant gap, functions, channels, risks, and evidence for every population.
blocks.zh:
不应以三组为先,说此是辩才之义也.
具有全天候自我感知能力的儿童:同意、发展和终生记录的永久存在等问题尚未得到解决,儿童通过周围成年人的共鸣得到服务。
处于急性心理危机中的人以共鸣作为唯一的支持:直到交接路径成熟.
任何处于强迫环境、雇主要求、机构规则、教养设施的人:共鸣的前提是个人自己授权,强迫系统是监视器,这是第15.7节的未来之一。
由此产生的顺序如下。
第一批收养人是知识工作者,因为他们是最容易核实的。
老年人和有障碍的人人均收益最大,因为他们的差距最直接。
总收益最大的是日常生活,因为人口最多。
第17节的研究议程必须分别设计所有三行的证据,表15以每个人群的主要差距,功能,渠道,风险和证据来关闭该节.

blocks.en: Table 15 : Who gains what. Each row summarizes one population of Section 13 ; the functions column points into Table 12 , and the last column locates the population in Figure 19 .
blocks.zh: 表15:谁得到什么。 每行汇总第13节的1组;功能栏指向表12,最后一栏在图19中定位该组。

blocks.en: 14  A World of Augmented Individuals
blocks.zh: 14 增强个人能力的世界

blocks.en:
This section scales the symbiont from one person to a society and returns to the full picture of Figure 4 .
It is the most speculative part of the paper; what could go wrong at the same scale is the subject of Section 15 .
blocks.zh:
本节将一个人的韵母缩放到一个社会,回到图4的全貌。
这是论文中最具投机性的部分;在同样规模上可能出现的错误是第15节的主题。

blocks.en: 14.1  A Street Full of Augmented Individuals
blocks.zh: 14.1 满街都是增加的人

blocks.en:
Picture a street, some years from now, on which every individual is augmented.
One of them is the researcher of Section 1 .
In the morning an idea surfaces while she is alone and she whispers it to the pendant; by the time she sits down it has been filed under the project it belongs to.
In a team meeting a colleague asks about a figure she reported last quarter, a line in her glasses reminds her of it, and she answers.
At lunch she meets someone whose symbiont and hers established, before either looked up, that they are working on the same problem.
In the afternoon her symbiont books the trip to a conference and the meeting she was hoping for, without a question.
Walking through a city she does not know, the earpiece tells her how people decline an invitation here.
In the evening a project she cares about fails; the symbiont says the one sentence that fits, because it knows what this one cost her, and then it is quiet.
Beside her on the street are embodied robots running their own errands and, now and then, shaking hands with a human.
What separates this street from today’s is less the devices on it than the fact that the gap of Eq. ( 1 ) is being closed continuously, for everyone, in the moments in which it opens.
blocks.zh:
想象一个街道, 几年后,每个人都在这条街道上增加。
其中之一是第1节的研究员.
在早晨,一个想法浮出水面,而她独自一人,她却悄悄地告诉吊顶;当她坐下时,它已经根据属于它的项目提交。
在一次小组会议上,一位同事问及她上季度报告的一个数字,她的眼镜里有一行话让她想起,她回答说.
在午餐时,她遇见了一位她和她的共鸣者,在她俩抬头看之前,他们正在研究同样的问题。
在下午,她的韵律记录了去开会的旅程和她所希望的会议,没有问题。
穿过一个她不认识的城市,耳机告诉她人们如何拒绝邀请。
晚上她关心的一个项目失败了; 共鸣会说出一个合适的句子, 因为它知道她付出了多少代价, 然后是安静的。
除了她在街上,还有机器人在自己跑腿 偶尔和人类握手
将这条街与今天的路隔开的,与其说是它上面的装置,不如说是Eq(1)的缺口在它打开的瞬间不断被关闭。

blocks.en:
The scene presupposes everything in Part II and nothing beyond it.
Each sentence corresponds to a row of Table 12 , each row carries a maturity, and the scene is therefore a forecast whose date depends on the open problems of Section 17.4 rather than on any single breakthrough.
The scene also has a cost that the picture conceals.
Every moment of help in it is also a moment of sensing, the street is a place where many records overlap, and the people on it who have no symbiont are present in the records of those who do; these are the concerns of Section 15.7 .
blocks.zh:
剧情预先假定了第二部分中的所有内容,除此之外没有任何内容.
每句对应一行表12,每行带一个成熟度,因此场景是一个预测,其日期取决于第17.4节的公开问题而不是任何单一突破.
该场景也有一个成本,图片掩盖。
每一个帮助的时刻也是感知的时刻,这条街是许多记录重叠的地方,没有韵母的街道上的人都出现在做者的记录中;这些都是第15.7条的关注.

blocks.en: 14.2  Humans, Robots, and a Shared Core
blocks.zh: 14.2 人类、机器人和共享核心

blocks.en:
Section 2.2 set the augmented human beside the embodied robot as the two forms of intelligent individual in the era of Physical AI, and here the paper states the general claim.
The two forms share the cognitive core developed in Sections 6 to 10 , memory, models of situation and mind, timely intervention, and learning from experience, and they differ in whose goals, whose body, and whose responsibility.
The implication for embodied intelligence is that the next step for robots is a cognitive core of this kind as much as a better body, and that the two forms will cooperate and compete in the same rooms, with the handshake of Section 9.6 as the first protocol between them.
The fiction supplies a clean illustration: Jarvis’s core eventually enters a body and becomes the Vision, a former symbiont that has acquired goals and a body of its own, which is exactly the step from the left column of Figure 4 to the middle one.
The paper develops no robotics agenda; it makes this one claim and this one comparison.
blocks.zh:
第2.2节将被增强的人类置于被体现的机器人旁边,作为物理AI时代的两种智能个体形式,本文在此阐述一般说法.
这两种形式分享了第6至第10节中发展起来的认知核心,记忆力,状况和思维模式,及时干预,以及从经验中学习,在谁的目标,身体,以及责任方面都有所不同.
对体现的智能的含意是,机器人下一步是这种认知核心,就像更好的身体一样,两种形式将在同一间房间里合作和竞争,第9.6节的握手是它们之间的第一个协议.
这部小说提供了一个干净的插图: 贾维斯的核心最终进入一个身体,成为"视觉"(Vision),一个曾经获得过目标的共鸣体和自己的身体,这恰恰是从图4左栏到中栏的一步.
文件没有制定机器人学议程;它提出这一项主张和这一项比较。

blocks.en:
A symbiont has no body, and it can borrow the environment.
The person walks into a laboratory and it drives the instruments; the person comes home and it runs the house; the external physical world model of Section 7.5 turns from prediction into a basis for action, through the devices of the environment that Section 5.2 placed at the far end of the constellation.
The augmented individual is therefore extended in reach as well as in cognition, and the same permission levels that govern acting on the person’s behalf (Section 9.1 ) govern acting in the person’s surroundings.
This is the interface between the paper and the line of work in which AI drives the physical world through infrastructure and devices, the right-hand column of Figure 4 , and the paper only marks that the interface exists.
blocks.zh:
韵母没有身体,可以借用环境.
此人走进实验室,驱动仪器;此人回家管理房屋;第7.5节的外部物理世界模型从预测变为行动的基础,通过第5.2节放在星座最远端的环境装置。
因此,扩大后的个人既可以伸展,也可以在认知上伸展,而代表个人行事的许可水平(第9.1节)适用于在个人周围的行为。
这是AI通过基础设施和设备驱动物理世界的纸张与工作线的接口,图4的右栏,纸张只标出接口的存在.

blocks.en: Part IV
blocks.zh: 第四编

blocks.en: Risk, Governance, and Evidence
blocks.zh: 风险、治理和证据

blocks.en:
Part IV asks what could go wrong, how augmentation can be governed, and how the claims of the paper can be tested.
Section 15 maps the harms of augmentation in three directions, to the person, through the person to others, and from the institutions that deploy it, together with their sum for the collective, and examines public acceptance and the settings where the conflict is sharpest: examinations, conversations, and institutions.
Section 16 states the governance that follows from the way a symbiont is built: a declarable status, assistance policies set by each setting, proofs that a policy was kept, credentials that measure what remains without the symbiont, and fair access.
Section 17 changes the object of measurement from the intelligence of the machine to the capability of the person, collects the open problems of the paper in one table, and says what would prove the paper wrong.
Section 18 closes.
blocks.zh:
第四部分询问可能发生什么问题,如何管理扩增,如何检验论文的主张。
第15节描绘了增加在三个方向上的伤害,即对人身的伤害,通过对他人的伤害,以及来自部署这种增加的机构的伤害,以及它们为集体提供的总和,并审查了公众接受的程度和冲突最尖锐的环境:考试、对话和机构。
第16条规定了从建立共鸣方式中产生的治理:可申报地位、每个设定设定的援助政策、证明政策得到维持、衡量尚存的无共鸣内容的证书以及公平获取。
第17节将测量对象从机器的智能变为人的能力,在一个表格中收集纸的公开问题,并说什么可以证明纸是错的.
第18节结束。

blocks.en:

Section 15 maps the harms of augmentation in three directions, to the person, through the person to others, and from the institutions that deploy it, together with their sum for the collective, and examines public acceptance and the settings where the conflict is sharpest: examinations, conversations, and institutions.
Section 16 states the governance that follows from the way a symbiont is built: a declarable status, assistance policies set by each setting, proofs that a policy was kept, credentials that measure what remains without the symbiont, and fair access.
Section 17 changes the object of measurement from the intelligence of the machine to the capability of the person, collects the open problems of the paper in one table, and says what would prove the paper wrong.
Section 18 closes.
blocks.zh:
第四部分询问可能发生什么问题,如何管理扩增,如何检验论文的主张。
第15节描绘了增加在三个方向上的伤害,即对人身的伤害,通过对他人的伤害,以及来自部署这种增加的机构的伤害,以及它们为集体提供的总和,并审查了公众接受的程度和冲突最尖锐的环境:考试、对话和机构。
