blocks.en: 15  The Risks of Augmentation
blocks.zh: 15 增加的风险

blocks.en:
Part II treated risk where it arises inside the system: in what the symbiont collects, what it infers, and what it may do (Section 12 ).
This section turns to the risks that arise between the augmented person and everyone else, which design alone does not remove.
blocks.zh:
第二部分处理系统内部出现的风险:共鸣收集的内容、推断的内容和可能采取的行动(第12节)。
本节论述增强人与其他人之间产生的风险,仅凭设计并不能消除这些风险。

blocks.en: 15.1  Why Augmentation Is Different
blocks.zh: 15.1 扩大为何不同

blocks.en:
Four features of the paradigm, each a design choice made earlier in the paper, change the shape of its risks.
The first is attribution.
A symbiont changes what a person can do, so its effect appears as the person’s own performance: an answer in an examination, a sentence in a negotiation, a kind word after a loss.
Whether such a performance belongs to the person is a question that a system which only completes tasks never raised.
The second is invisibility.
Discreet delivery (Section 5.4 ) lets a person receive help without interrupting anyone, and the same property hides the help from an examiner, an interviewer, or a friend, which sets the privacy of the person against the accountability that others may expect; this is why the paradigm keeps the content of an exchange private and makes the presence of assistance declarable (Section 16.1 ).
The third is reach.
The record that holds a person’s life also holds parts of other people’s lives, and the symbiont reads the people its owner meets, so its effects extend to people who never chose it.
The fourth is position.
Part of what a symbiont provides is valuable only relative to others, in admission, hiring, negotiation, and competition, and where gains are relative, one person’s augmentation is another’s loss and everyone comes under pressure to adopt it; six in ten respondents in a large survey of US adults already expected such pressure should cognitive implants become widespread ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
范式的4个特征,每个特征都是在论文之前作出的设计选择,改变了其风险的形状.
第一个是归属。
共鸣会改变一个人所能做的事,所以其效果表现为一个人自己的表现:在考试中回答,在谈判中句子,在损失后是友善的词.
这样的表演是否属于个人是一个只完成任务的制度从未提出的问题.
二是隐身.
秘密交付(第5.4节)允许一个人接受帮助而不会打断任何人,同一财产隐藏了检查者、面谈者或朋友的帮助,从而将个人的隐私与他人可能期待的问责相对抗;这就是为什么这种模式将交换的内容保密,并使援助的存在可以申报(第16.1节)。
第三是伸缩.
拥有一个人生命的纪录也掌握着其他人生活的部分内容,共鸣者读到其主人遇见的人,因此其效果延伸到从未选择的人.
其四为位.
共鸣提供的一部分只是相对于其他人有价值的,在录取、雇用、谈判和竞争方面,如果收益是相对的,那么一个人的增强就是另一个人的损失,每个人都会受到压力来采用它;在对美国成年人的大规模调查中,有六分之六的受访者已经预料到,如果认知植入变得普遍的话(皮尤研究中心,2022年)。

blocks.en: 15.2  Three Directions of Harm
blocks.zh: 15.2 三种损害方向

blocks.en:
Harm runs in three directions around an augmented person, and at the scale of a society the three add up to a collective harm (Figure 20 ).
Harm to the person comes from the system, its provider, or an attacker: manipulation and sycophancy, dependence and the loss of skills, errors and false memories, exposure of thought data, and lock-in to one provider.
These are treated where they arise, in Sections 10.5 and 12 , and the evidence on dependence keeps accumulating.
People who expect information to remain available remember where to find it better than the information itself ( Sparrow et al., 2011 ) , although a large replication project could not reproduce another experiment of the same study ( Camerer et al., 2018 ) ; habitual reliance on satellite navigation goes with weaker spatial memory ( Dahmani and Bohbot, 2020 ) , knowledge workers who trust generative AI more report engaging less in critical thinking ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , and a first neurophysiological study of essay writing with a language model, a small preprint, points the same way ( Kosmyna et al., 2025 ) .
Most of this evidence points one way, so the loss of skills is treated here as a primary risk, and retention (Section 17.1 ) has to be reported alongside every gain.
Manipulation has a measured basis as well: a language model given a few facts about its opponent was more persuasive than a human in controlled debates ( Salvi et al., 2025 ) , and a symbiont holds far more than a few facts.
A system that answers to one person is also exposed to sycophancy, the tendency of models trained on human preferences to tell people what they want to hear ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) , which in a symbiont would wear away the honesty that makes its help worth having.
Error is a harm of its own kind, because a wrong cue delivered in real time is often spoken aloud as the person’s own before anyone can check it, and a system that holds a person’s memories can also distort them: in a study of witness interviews, a chatbot built on a language model induced more than three times as many false memories as a control condition ( Chan et al., 2024 ) .
Harm through the person runs outward, when the owner’s augmented capability is used on others: covert assistance in assessment, covert scripting in conversation, covert inference about the people the owner meets, an advantage in negotiation that the other side cannot see, and fraud carried out with real-time cues.
Sections 15.4 and 15.5 take up the two settings in which this direction is hardest.
Harm from institutions arises when an employer, a school, an insurer, a platform, or a state deploys the paradigm for its own purposes (Section 15.6 ).
Harm to the collective is the sum of the others at the scale of a society (Section 15.7 ).
blocks.zh:
伤害在三个方向上围绕一个被增强的人,在一个社会的规模上,这三种伤害加起来就是集体伤害(图20)。
对人的伤害来自系统,其提供者,或攻击者:操纵和节制,依赖和技能的丧失,错误和错误的记忆,思想数据的曝光,以及锁定到一个提供者.
第10.5节和第12节对这些问题作了处理,依赖的证据不断积累。
期望信息保持可用性的人记得信息本身的更好之处(Sparrow等人,2011年),虽然一个大型的复制项目无法复制同一研究的另一项实验(Camerer等人,2018年),习惯上依赖卫星导航的空间记忆较弱(Dahmani和Bohbot,2020年),相信基因AI较多的报告较少参与批判性思考的知识工作者(Lee等人,2025年),以及用语言模型对散文写作进行的第一个神经生理研究,一个小的预印本,指向相同的方向(Kosmyna等人,2025年).
这些证据大多指出一种方式,因此,在此将丧失技能视为一种首要风险,保留(第17.1节)必须同每项收益一起报告。
操纵也有一个衡量的基础:一个语言模型给出了一些关于对手的事实,它比在受控辩论中的人更有说服力(Salvi等人,2025年),一个共鸣远远不止几个事实。
一个对一个人做出回答的系统也暴露在节奏中,即接受过人类偏好训练的模型往往会告诉人们他们想要听到什么(Sharma等人,2023年),在一个韵律中,这将会磨损其值得帮助的诚实.
错误本身就是一种伤害,因为实时发出的错误提示往往像一个人自己那样大声说话,然后才能检查,而持有一个人的记忆的系统也可能扭曲这些记忆:在对证人访谈的研究中,一个基于语言模型的聊天员像控制条件一样,诱发了三倍多的假记忆(Chan等人,2024年).
当业主增强的能力被用在他人身上时,
第15.4节和第15.5节采用了这一方向最难的两个环境。
当雇主、学校、保险人、平台或国家为其自身目的部署这一模式时,就会产生机构损害(第15.6节)。
对集体的损害是社会上其他人的总和(第15.7节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 20 : Three directions of harm around an augmented person, and their sum at the scale of a society.
Harm to the person comes from the system, its provider, or an attacker; harm through the person reaches the people and institutions the person deals with; harm from institutions comes from those that deploy the paradigm for their own ends.
Chips name the risks, and section marks point to where each is treated.
blocks.zh:
图20:围绕增强的人的伤害的三个方向,以及其社会规模的总和。
对人身的伤害来自系统、其提供者或攻击者;通过人身的伤害波及人所处理的民众和机构;机构的损害波及为其自身目的部署模式的机构。
芯片标出风险, 分节标出每个被处理的地方。

blocks.en: 15.3  Public Acceptance
blocks.zh: 15.3 公众接受

blocks.en:
Whether people will accept a machine that makes others more capable is an empirical question, and the evidence so far is cautious.
In a survey of more than ten thousand US adults, a majority judged brain implants that improve cognition a bad idea for society ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ) .
Studies of attitudes toward pharmacological enhancement find that lay judgments against it are driven above all by perceived unfairness, more than by the sense that an enhanced achievement is hollow or undeserved ( Faber et al., 2016 ) .
The philosophical debate runs between the view that the enhancement of healthy people should be assessed on evidence and regulated responsibly ( Greely et al., 2008 ; Bostrom and Sandberg, 2009 ) and the view that the drive to enhance erodes the appreciation of what is given ( Sandel, 2007 ) .
Three conclusions follow for the paradigm.
Acceptance depends on purpose: restoring a lost ability is accepted, everyday support is largely accepted, and enhancement in competition and in emotional life is contested, and the order in which Section 13 proposes to serve populations follows this gradient.
What a symbiont raises is performance in a situation, the gain of Eq. ( 2 ), together with whatever ability remains after it is removed, the retention defined in Section 17.1 ; the paper claims no increase in a trait such as intelligence or emotional skill.
And since fairness is the main objection, the design question becomes how to keep augmentation fair where fairness matters, which Section 16 answers.
blocks.zh:
人们是否会接受一个使他人更有能力的机器是一个经验性的问题,迄今为止的证据是谨慎的.
在对超过一万个美国成年人的调查中,
对药物学增强态度的研究发现,对药物学的评判首先取决于所认为的不公正,而不是认为增强的成绩是空洞的或不应有的(Faber等人,2016年)。
哲学上的辩论介于以下两种观点之间:一种观点是,应当根据证据评估健康人的增强情况并进行负责任的监管(Greely等人,2008年;Bostrom和Sandberg,2009年),另一种观点是,加强的努力侵蚀了对所给予事物的理解(Sandel,2007年)。
关于范式,有三个结论。
接受取决于目的:恢复失去的能力被接受,日常支持被基本接受,竞争和情感生活中的增强受到争议,第13节提出的服务人群的顺序也遵循这一梯度.
共鸣产生的结果是,在某种情况下的性能,即Eq.(2)的收益,以及除去后留下的任何能力,即第17.1节所界定的保留;该文件声称,智力或情感技能等特性没有增加。
而由于公平是主要的反对意见,设计问题就变成了如何在公平重要的地方保持增强公平,而第16节回答了这一点.

blocks.en: 15.4  Examinations, Learning, and Credentials
blocks.zh: 15.4 考试、学习和全权证书

blocks.en:
Assessment is where the conflict is sharpest, because an examination exists to measure what a person can do.
Three kinds of assessment have to be kept apart.
Some certify unaided ability, because the person will later have to act alone, as in the licensing of a profession whose emergencies leave no time to consult anything.
Some measure performance with the tools of the work, as open-book examinations and most jobs already do.
Some give a learner feedback, and there what matters is that learning takes place.
A symbiont that is legitimate in the second kind defeats the first and can empty the third, so a single rule for all assessment cannot work.
Learning raises a problem that examinations only make visible.
A student who hands homework to a symbiont gains a grade and loses the practice, which is the loss of retention in its most familiar form, and it is the reason the symbiont of Sections 9.2 and 13.4 gives hints by default.
A symbiont worn all day turns what is now an occasional temptation, a phone smuggled into an examination hall, into a standing condition of every assessment, and Section 16.2 gives the response.
blocks.zh:
评估是冲突最尖锐的地方,因为存在一项审查,以衡量一个人能够做些什么。
三种评价必须分开。
有些人证明自己的能力得不到帮助,因为此人以后将不得不单独行动,例如向一个紧急情况下没有时间咨询任何情况的专业发放许可证。
有的用工作工具衡量业绩,如开放式课本考试和大多数工作已经进行。
有些人给出了学习者的反馈,重要的是学习的进行。
一种在第二种中是正当的韵母击败了第一种,并且可以空出第三种,因此所有评估的单一规则是行不通的.
学习引起一个问题,即考试只能显露出来。
将功课交给韵母的学生会获得一个分级,并失去练习,这就是其最熟悉的形式的留存的丧失,这也是第9.2节和第13.4节的韵母默认给予提示的原因.
整天穿戴的节奏使现在偶尔发生的诱惑,电话走私到检查大厅,成为每次评估的常备条件,第16.2节给出答复。

blocks.en: 15.5  Conversations and Relationships
blocks.zh: 15.5 对话和关系

blocks.en:
In a conversation the other party is affected directly, and assistance comes in four kinds whose rules tighten in order.
Reminding a person of their own facts, a figure they reported or where a discussion left off, is the equivalent of a glance at notes and is accepted in most settings.
Rehearsal before a conversation and review after it affect no one else.
Persuasive or emotional lines supplied in real time, in a negotiation, a quarrel, or a courtship, are different, because the other party believes they are hearing the person, and the sincerity of an apology or a kind word is part of what it means.
Inference about the other party, their mood, their hesitation, or their identity, is the most sensitive, because that person has consented to nothing.
Identifying strangers from their faces has already been demonstrated with consumer glasses (I-XRAY) ( 404 Media, 2024 ) , and inferring the emotions of people in workplaces and educational institutions is prohibited in the European Union ( European Parliament and Council of the European
Union, 2024 ) .
The paradigm takes a position on each kind.
A person’s own facts may be supplied freely.
Real-time persuasive or emotional scripting is disclosed when it is used and switched off where a setting forbids it.
Inferences about another person serve only the interaction at hand and never accumulate (Section 6.7 ); a symbiont never identifies a stranger, never infers emotions where the law forbids it, and answers truthfully when the other party asks whether the person is being assisted, whether or not that party has a symbiont, showing the status on the device itself where a setting requires it; between two symbionts, the visible ring of the handshake protocol can carry it (Section 9.6 ).
Not identifying strangers has a technical cost that should be stated: faces are matched on the device only against the contacts the owner has enrolled, and a face without a match is discarded at once, but the matching still has to examine every face in view, and where biometric law requires consent before a template of a face is made ( Illinois General Assembly, 2008 ) , recognition stays off.
The underlying capability is the same as that of a tool sold for cheating in interviews and sales calls, and what separates a symbiont from such a tool is the rules it keeps and the person it answers to.
blocks.zh:
在一次谈话中,另一方直接受到影响,援助有四种,其规则严格有序。
提醒一个人了解他们自己的事实、他们报告的数字或讨论中断的地方,相当于一目了然,在多数情况下都得到接受。
谈话前进行排练,谈话后再审查,不会影响他人.
在谈判、争吵或求爱中,实时提供的劝阻或情感线是不同的,因为对方认为他们正在听到这个人的声音,道歉或善意的言词的诚意是其含义的一部分。
对另一方的推论,他们的情绪,他们的犹豫,或者他们的身份,是最敏感的,因为这个人什么也没有同意.
已经用消费眼镜(I-XRAY)(404 Media, 2024年)来辨别陌生人的面孔,欧洲联盟(欧洲议会和欧洲理事会)禁止推断工作场所和教育机构中的人们的情绪。
Union, 2024) (英语).
范式对每一种都采取立场。
个人的事实可以自由提供。
实时有说服力或情感的脚本在使用时被披露,在某一环境禁止的情况下关闭.
关于另一人的推论只服务于手头的相互作用,从未积累(第6.7节);一个韵母从不识别陌生人,从不推断法律禁止的情绪,当对方询问该人是否在被协助时,是否该方有韵母,显示设备本身在某种场合需要时的状况时,真实回答;在两个韵母之间,手握协议的可见环可以携带(第9.6节)。
不识别陌生人的技术成本应该说明:在设备上只与所有者所注册的联络人匹配面孔,没有匹配面孔的面孔会被立即丢弃,但匹配仍然需要检查每个面孔,在生物鉴别法需要同意后才能制作面孔模板(Illinois Assembly, 2008),识别不进行.
其基础能力与因在采访和销售电话中作弊而售出的工具相同,将一个韵母与这样的工具区分开来的是它所保持的规则和它所回答的人.

blocks.en: 15.6  Work, Institutions, and the State
blocks.zh: 15.6 工作、机构和国家

blocks.en:
Institutions can turn a symbiont against the person who wears it.
An employer or a school that requires one obtains a monitor with a better view than any camera, and the commitment of Section 12.3 to answer to the person does not survive a compelled setting (Section 13.9 ).
A lifelong record is also evidence: it can be demanded in a dispute or at a border, or used by an insurer or an employer to price or screen a person, and the inferred mental states it contains make it more revealing than any record kept before.
Where a provider earns its revenue from advertising or from the institution that pays for the device, loyalty to the person becomes a matter of business model, which the market layer of Section 16.6 has to carry.
A state can mandate the device outright.
Law has begun to respond to the most intimate part of such a record.
Chile amended its constitution in 2021 to protect brain activity and the information derived from it ( Republic of Chile, 2021 ) , Colorado classified neural data as sensitive personal data in 2024 ( Colorado General Assembly, 2024 ) , UNESCO adopted a recommendation on the ethics of neurotechnology in 2025 ( UNESCO, 2025 ) , and the proposed rights to cognitive liberty and mental privacy ( Ienca and Andorno, 2017 ) anticipate the thought data of Section 12.4 .
These instruments address neural signals, and a record that joins a whole life to inferences about a mind falls between them; local storage by default, encryption under the person’s control, and short retention of raw streams (Section 6.3 ) are the technical half of the answer.
blocks.zh:
机构可以将一个韵母对着佩戴者.
第12.3条要求雇主或学校获得比任何摄像头更清晰的显示器,而第12.3条承诺对某人负责并不能在迫不得已的情况下生存(第13.9条)。
终生记录也是证据:可以在争端中或在边界上要求,或被保险人或雇主用来定价或筛选一个人,它包含的推断精神状态使其比以前保存的任何记录更能揭示。
如果供应商从广告或支付设备费用的机构获得收入,那么对某人的忠诚就成为商业模式的问题,而第16.6节的市场层必须携带。
国家可以直接授权装置。
法律已开始对这种记录中最亲密的部分作出反应。
智利于2021年修订了宪法,以保护大脑活动及其产生的信息(智利共和国,2021年),科罗拉多州于2024年将神经数据列为敏感个人数据(科罗拉多州大会,2024年),联合国教科文组织于2025年通过了关于神经技术伦理的建议(UNESCO,2025年),拟议的认知自由和精神隐私权(Ienca and Andorno,2017年)预计到第12.4节的思想数据.
这些仪器处理神经信号,并且一个将整个生命连在一起的关于心灵的推断的纪录落在它们之间;默认的局部存储,在人物控制下加密,以及短暂保留原始流(第6.3节)是答案的技术半部分.

blocks.en: 15.7  The Social Fabric
blocks.zh: 15.7 国家 社会布局

blocks.en: At the scale of a society, the harms of this section add up to effects that no single pair of people can show.
blocks.zh: 在一个社会的规模上,本节的弊端加起来就等于是没有任何一对人能表现出来的效果.

blocks.en:
When the handshake of Section 9.6 scales to a crowd, the gain is lower social friction, fewer missed encounters, and fewer cross-cultural misunderstandings.
The harm, when every symbiont optimizes for its owner, is homogeneity, since one only ever meets people like oneself; manipulation, since symbionts can game one another; and exclusion, since people without a symbiont are systematically overlooked.
Whether the four rings of authorization hold under optimization by both sides, and what the equilibrium of a crowd of such systems looks like, are research questions at the level of the group (Section 17.4 ).
blocks.zh:
当第9.6节的握手向人群伸展时,收益是降低社会摩擦,减少错过的遭遇,减少跨文化误解.
伤害,当每一个共鸣为主人优化时,都是同质性的,因为只有一个人曾经遇到像自己这样的人;操纵,因为共鸣可以互相游戏;排斥,因为没有共鸣的人被系统地忽略.
4个授权环是否处于双方的优化状态,以及这些系统群的均衡情况,是该群体层面的研究问题(第17.4节)。

blocks.en:
If the most effective cognitive augmentation belongs to those who can pay, the gap between groups widens, and Section 13 showed that the people who need it most may be the least able to pay and that the largest total value lies with the people least willing to.
Where gains are positional the problem compounds, because each adoption raises the cost of not adopting, and an equilibrium in which everyone wears a symbiont and no one is better off is a possible outcome.
Section 16.5 takes up provision.
blocks.zh:
如果最有效的认知增强属于有能力支付的人,群体之间的差距就会扩大,第13节显示,最需要的人可能最没有能力支付,而最大的总价值在于最不愿意支付的人。
如果收益是固定的,问题就更加复杂,因为每次收养都会增加不收养的费用,而且每个人都要穿戴韵律,没有人会更好。
第16.5节涉及经费。

blocks.en:
If anyone might be assisted, every conversation carries a doubt about whom one is talking to, and the trust people place in an unassisted exchange may wear thin.
Norms will have to settle which settings presume assistance and which presume its absence, as norms once settled when a phone may lie on a dinner table.
blocks.zh:
如果任何人可能得到帮助,每一次谈话都对与谁交谈表示怀疑,人们在无人协助的交换中的信任可能会磨损。
规范必须解决哪些环境假定援助,哪些假设援助没有援助,因为规范一旦确定,电话可能放在餐桌上。

blocks.en:
Ideas from a language model made individual stories more creative and the collection of stories more alike ( Doshi and Hauser, 2024 ) .
When billions of people take suggestions from a few models, the same trade-off acts on opinions and decisions, and the diversity of thought in a population becomes a quantity to be measured.
blocks.zh:
来自语言模型的想法使得个人故事更具创意,故事集也更加相似(Doshi and Hauser, 2024).
当数十亿人接受少数模式的建议时,同样在意见和决定上的权衡行为,一个人群中的思想多样性成为需要衡量的数量.

blocks.en:
A society that relies on symbionts loses capacity when they fail, since an outage at a widely used provider would leave many people without their memory aids, routes, and errands at once, and a few providers holding the records of billions would concentrate a power that no company has held.
The ability to work without the symbiont is therefore a public good as well as a personal one, and portability across providers (Section 10.4 ) is a defense against concentration.
blocks.zh:
一个依靠共鸣的社会在失败时会失去能力,因为一个被广泛使用的供应商的停电会让许多人同时失去记忆辅助器、路线和跑腿,而少数持有数十亿记录的供应商会集中一个没有公司拥有的权力。
因此,没有共鸣体的工作能力既是一种公益物,也是一种个人利益,而服务提供者之间的可移动性(第10.4节)是防止集中的一种辩护。

blocks.en:
A symbiont for everyone has a material cost: electricity demand from data centres is projected to roughly double by 2030 ( International Energy Agency, 2025 ) , and an always-available companion for each person adds to it, which is why compute per person per day (Section 11.4 ) belongs in every report of a system’s value.
Its effects on work run in both directions, since the help that makes a person more capable can also make that person easier to replace, and which effect dominates is an empirical question the paper cannot settle.
The language and dialect support of Section 9.4 could also flatten what it serves, if a few models teach millions of people the same way to greet, decline, and apologize in a culture.
blocks.zh:
每个人的共鸣成本都很高:预计到2030年,数据中心的电力需求将几乎翻一番(国际能源机构,2025年),而每个人随时都可以得到的同伴会增加这一成本,因此,每个人每天的计算(第11.4节)都包含在每一份系统价值的报告中。
它对工作的影响是双向的,因为使一个人更有能力的帮助也可以使这个人更容易被替换,而这种影响占主导地位是文件无法解决的经验问题。
第9.4节的语言和方言支持也可以使它所服务的东西变得平淡,如果少数模式教给数百万人同样的方式在一种文化中迎接,拒绝,道歉.

blocks.en:
The paradigm is designed against five futures.
The first is a world in which everything is recorded and no one can leave; the second, a world in which people have outsourced their thinking entirely; the third, a world in which a symbiont is more loyal to someone else than to its owner; the fourth, a world in which symbionts are used to deceive the people their owners deal with; and the fifth, a system that improves itself with no one able to audit what it changed, which in the fiction is Ultron, a separate project whose goals parted from its maker’s and whose growth no one could see.
The design principles of Table 14 and the governance of Section 16 are written against these five, and the conditions of Section 17.6 include the costs that would make the first two unavoidable.
blocks.zh:
范式是针对五个未来设计的.
第一个是记录一切而无人能离开的世界;第二个是人们完全将思想外包的世界;第三个是共鸣者比主人更忠于他人的世界;第四个是利用共鸣者欺骗其主人所处理的人民的世界;以及第五是无人能够审计所改变事物而自我改善的系统,在虚构中是Ultron,这是一个独立的项目,其目标与其制造者分开,其增长无人能见。
表14的设计原则和第16款的管理是针对这5款编写的,第17.6款的条件包括使前两款不可避免的费用。

blocks.en: 15.8  Contested Uses of the Symbiont’s Own Functions
blocks.zh: 15.8 共生体自身功能的有争议的用途

blocks.en:
Table 16 returns to the functions of Table 12 and lists, for each family, its intended use, the misuse it invites, the settings in which it is contested, and the default the paper proposes.
Most of these functions are uncontested in most of life, and the table locates the exceptions.
blocks.zh:
表16恢复了表12的功能,列出了每个家庭的预期用途、它所招致的滥用、有争议的环境以及文件建议的默认情况。
这些功能大多在生活中是无可争议的,表格列出了例外情况。

blocks.en: Table 16 : Contested uses of the symbiont’s own functions, drawn from Table 12 and Section 15.5 . For each function: what it is for, the misuse it invites, the settings in which it is contested, and the default the paper proposes.
blocks.zh: 表16:自表12和第15.5节中抽取的共鸣体自身功能的有争议的用途。 对于每一项职能:它的目的、它所邀请的滥用、它受到质疑的设置以及文件建议的默认。

blocks.en: 16  Governing Augmentation
blocks.zh: 16 扩增

blocks.en:
Earlier cognitive enhancements were hard to govern because they could not be seen or switched off; a stimulant taken before an examination leaves no trace in the room.
A symbiont differs in the respect that matters.
It is external, removable, and inspectable, so it can follow the rules of the settings a person enters and show that it did.
This section turns that property into mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
早期的认知增强很难管理,因为无法看到或关闭;在检查前服用的兴奋剂在房间里没有任何痕迹。
韵母在关系上有所不同。
它是外部的、可移动的和可检查的,这样它就可以遵循一个人进入的设置的规则,并显示它确实这样做了。
本节将财产变成机制。

blocks.en: 16.1  Private Content, Declarable Status
blocks.zh: 16.1 私人内容,可申报地位

blocks.en:
The governing principle separates what is said from whether help is being given.
What a person and their symbiont say to each other belongs to the person, and no setting has a claim on it (Section 12.4 ).
Whether the person is being assisted, and at what level, is a different kind of fact, and a setting such as an examination, a court, a game, or a negotiation may ask for it.
In such settings the default is to declare it, without waiting to be asked.
Keeping the two apart resolves the conflict named in Section 15.1 : the private channel stays private, and the presence of assistance becomes legible where it matters.
blocks.zh:
指导原则将所说的话与是否得到帮助区分开来。
一个人和他们的韵母对彼此说的话属于这个人,没有任何设定对此有主张(第12.4节)。
该人是否正在得到帮助,在何种级别,是不同种类的事实,一个诸如考试,法庭,游戏,或谈判之类的环境可能要求这样做.
在这种设置中,默认是声明,而不等待被询问 。
将两者分开解决了第15.1节中提到的冲突:私人渠道保持私密,援助的存在变得可以看清。

blocks.en: 16.2  Settings Set the Rules
blocks.zh: 16.2 设置规则

blocks.en:
A setting can declare an assistance policy, and the symbiont follows it by design.
The policies form a short scale: unassisted; accessibility only; the person’s own record only; and full assistance.
A venue announces its policy at the door or in the invitation, the symbiont recognizes it, changes mode, and records that it did, and the sixth commitment of the symbiont’s code (Section 12.3 ) makes the policy binding against a passing wish of the owner, since a person who entered the setting accepted its rules.
Precedents exist for each part.
Examination boards publish lists of approved calculators, so that a permitted aid has a known capability; open-book examinations define a level of allowed help; competitive chess combines device bans, delayed broadcasts, and statistical detection of engine assistance, and its online platforms publish the findings of their fair-play investigations ( Chess.com, 2022 ) ; and chatbot providers have already restricted their services for the duration of a national examination (Section 1.3 ).
Detection on its own is an arms race that the detector tends to lose, which is why the policy has to be honored by the device itself, with detection kept as a check.
blocks.zh:
设置可以宣布援助政策,共鸣会通过设计来遵循.
这些政策是短期的:无援助;只有无障碍;只有个人自己的记录;以及全面援助。
一个会场在门前或邀请中宣布其政策,参赛者承认它,改变模式,并记录它所做的,参赛者代码的第六次承诺(第12.3节)使得政策对主人的过往愿望具有约束力,因为参赛者接受了它的规则.
每个部分都有先例。
考试委员会公布经批准的计算器清单,以便允许的援助具有已知的能力;开放式的考试界定了允许的帮助水平;竞争性的棋类结合了设备禁令,延迟广播和对引擎援助的统计检测,其在线平台公布其公平游戏调查的结果(Ches.com, 2022年);聊天机器人供应商已经在全国考试期间限制其服务(第1.3节)。
自行侦测是探测器往往会输掉的军备竞赛,这就是为什么这一政策必须被装置本身所遵守,并将侦测作为检查。

blocks.en: 16.3  Verifiable Abstention
blocks.zh: 16.3 可核实的退出

blocks.en:
A policy is useful only if keeping it can be shown.
A person should be able to prove that their symbiont was in a given mode for a given period without revealing anything it holds.
The ingredients exist in other fields: tamper-evident logs, hardware attestation of the software running on a device, and cryptographic proofs that establish one statement and reveal nothing else.
Combining them into a proof that a symbiont kept a policy, that a modified device cannot forge, and that leaks nothing about the record is an open problem (Table 18 ).
The design also has a limit that should be stated plainly.
Such a proof shows that the declared device abstained, and it cannot show that the person carried no second device, ran an open model on modified hardware, or was coached by someone outside the room.
Against an owner set on cheating, architecture helps little, and the weight falls where it falls today: on the design of assessment, on observation and detection, and on the sanctions of norms and law.
What a symbiont can do is make compliance cheap and checkable for the many people who intend to comply, which narrows the problem to the few who do not.
The same machinery yields a record of when assistance was given, which a person may choose to disclose, much as authors now disclose the use of AI in their writing.
blocks.zh:
政策只有在能够显示的情况下才有用。
一个人应该能够证明他们的韵母在一个特定时期处于特定模式,而不透露它持有的任何东西.
成份存在于其他领域:篡改不言明的日志、在设备上运行的软件的硬件证明、建立一种语句而又不透露其他内容的加密证明。
将它们合并成一个证据,证明一个韵母保留了政策,一个经过修改的装置不能伪造,并且没有泄露任何记录是一个公开的问题(表18).
设计也有一个限度,应该明确加以说明。
这种证明表明,宣布的设备投了弃权票,它无法证明这个人没有携带第二个设备,在修改后的硬件上运行一个开放的模型,或者由房间外的人担任教练.
建筑对业主的作弊作用不大,其重量会下降至今天的程度:评估的设计、观察和检测以及规范和法律的制裁。
共鸣能做的是让许多打算服从的人便宜和可以核查,这把问题缩小到少数不服从的人.
同样的机制也记录了何时得到援助,一个人可以选择披露,因为作者现在在书面中披露AI的使用。

blocks.en: 16.4  What Credentials Should Measure
blocks.zh: 16.4 何种全权证书应计量

blocks.en:
Credentials should measure what the role requires.
Where a role requires unaided ability, the credential measures the person with the symbiont in the unassisted mode; where the role is carried out with tools, it measures the person with the tools; and in learning, what is measured over time is retention (Section 17.1 ), the ability that remains when the symbiont is removed.
Assessment will also change form, toward oral examination held under the unassisted policy, observed process, and tasks whose value lies in reasoning that cannot be handed over in a line.
The vignette Exam Day below shows the parts working together.
blocks.zh:
全权证书应衡量这种作用需要什么。
在角色需要无辅助能力时,证书会以无辅助模式度量有伴奏的人;在角色用工具度量人时,则用工具度量人;在学习中,随时间而度量的是保留(第17.1节),即取消伴奏时留下的能力.
评估还将改变形式,改为在无协助政策下进行口试,观察过程和任务,其价值在于不能一线移交的推理。
下方的Vignette考试日显示各部分共同工作.

blocks.en:
Exam Day A student arrives at an examination wearing her symbiont.
The room announces an unassisted policy with listed accommodations, the symbiont switches to the unassisted mode, and it produces a proof of the switch that the examiner can check without seeing anything the symbiont holds.
A classmate with dyslexia keeps text-to-speech, which the policy lists as an accommodation.
In the preceding term the student’s symbiont tutored her with hints, and its record shows that answers were never supplied outright, so the grade measures what she can do.
After the examination, full assistance returns.
blocks.zh:
考试日 一个学生穿着她的韵律来参加考试.
房间宣布一项无协助政策,包含列出的住宿,韵母切换为无协助模式,并出具了切换的证明,考生可以在没有看到韵母持有的任何东西的情况下检查.
患有阅读障碍症的同学保留文字对语,政策将文字对语列为一种便利.
在前一个学期,学生的共鸣为她提供了暗示,其记录显示,答案从未直接提供,因此年级衡量她能做什么。
经考核后,全部协助返回.

blocks.en: 16.5  Access and Accommodation
blocks.zh: 16.5 出入和住宿

blocks.en:
Two questions of access arise once policies exist.
The first is accommodation.
For a person with a sensory, motor, or cognitive impairment a symbiont is a channel before it is an augmentation (Section 13.6 ), and a policy that ignores this excludes them; the exemptions that sport grants for the therapeutic use of otherwise banned substances show the form an accommodation framework can take.
The second is equal provision.
Where a setting allows assistance, the fairness objection of Section 15.3 is met by giving everyone the same level, as an examination supplies or approves a standard calculator, and outside such settings by forms of provision that reach people who cannot pay (Section 15.7 ).
Equal provision can equalize the assistance a setting permits, while the years of personal record behind it stay unequal, so a setting that needs strict fairness uses the unassisted mode or a standard symbiont without personal context.
blocks.zh:
一旦制定了政策,就会产生两个准入问题。
第一种是住宿.
对于有感官、运动或认知障碍的人来说,连带障碍是增强之前的渠道(第13.6节),而忽视这一点的政策则排除了这些障碍;体育为治疗性地使用其他被禁止的物质而给予的豁免表明一种住宿框架可以采取的形式。
二是平等供养.
如果环境允许提供援助,则第15.3条的公平反对通过向每个人提供与考试用品或批准标准计算器相同的水平,并在这种环境之外通过向无力支付费用的人提供的条款形式(第15.7条)。
平等规定可以将设定许可的援助等同起来,而之后的个人记录年数则不相等,因此需要严格公平性的设定使用无辅助模式或没有个人背景的标准韵律.

blocks.en: 16.6  Who Governs
blocks.zh: 16.6 谁是省长

blocks.en:
Governance runs on five layers, and the paper proposes law for none of them.
Design is the layer this paper controls: the code, the policies a symbiont honors, and the proofs it can give.
Norms belong to settings and professions, which decide what assistance they allow, as journals have decided how authors disclose the use of AI.
Law sets the floor, through data protection ( European Parliament and Council of the European
Union, 2016 ) , the prohibitions of the European AI Act, and the emerging law of neural data (Section 15.6 ).
Markets matter because the business model of a provider decides whom its symbionts serve, and independent audit of providers is a condition of trust.
Research supplies the evidence that each of the other layers needs, and Section 17 organizes it.
Design, norms, law, and markets are the four modalities of regulation that Lessig (1999) described, and of the four, norms and law will carry most of the weight, because design binds only the devices that comply.
blocks.zh:
治理分五层进行,论文为其中任何一层提出法律.
设计是这张纸所控制的层:代码,政策 一个共鸣荣誉, 和它能提供的证明.
规范属于环境和专业,它们决定它们允许何种援助,因为期刊已经决定作者如何披露AI的使用.
法律通过数据保护确定最低标准(欧洲议会和欧洲理事会)
2016年联盟),"欧洲AI法"的禁令,以及新出现的神经数据法(第15.6节).
市场很重要,因为供应商的商业模式决定其共鸣服务对象,对供应商的独立审计是信任的一个条件。
研究提供其他各层都需要的证据,第17节组织.
设计、规范、法律和市场是Lessig(1999年)所描述的四种监管方式,在四种方式中,规范和法律将承担大部分重担,因为设计只约束遵守的装置。

blocks.en: 16.7  Open Ethical Questions
blocks.zh: 16.7 公开伦理问题

blocks.en: Some questions remain after design and governance, and only further research and public deliberation can settle them. • The legitimacy of augmented achievement. When a performance shaped by a symbiont counts as the person’s own, and how settings can decide this in advance (Section 15.3 ). • Identity and authenticity. Whether a decision thought through with help, or a sentence handed to a person, is still theirs. • Measuring influence. How far a decision departed from what the person would have chosen alone, as a test of the commitment not to manipulate (Section 12.3 ). • Responsibility for acting on the person’s behalf. Where responsibility lies when an errand goes wrong; the permission levels of Section 9.1 are the design answer, and the legal answer is open. • The boundary of mental-health support. Where support ends and treatment begins, and who is responsible when a handoff fails (Sections 9.3 and 13.7 ). • Children and people who cannot fully consent. What proxy authorization may do, and what a lifelong record means for a child (Sections 13.5 and 13.9 ). • Death and inheritance. Who owns a person’s record and symbiont after their death, and whether it may be switched off or inherited.
blocks.zh: 一些问题在设计和治理之后仍然存在,只有进一步研究和公众审议才能解决这些问题。 扩大成就的合法性。 当一个音节塑造的性能算作个人的性能,以及设置如何事先决定这一点(第15.3节)。 • 身份和真实性。 无论是在帮助下做出的决定,还是判给一个人的判决,仍然是他们的决定。 • 衡量影响。 一项决定在多大程度上偏离了当事人单独选择的内容,作为不操纵的承诺的检验标准(第12.3节)。 代表个人行事的责任。 • 第9.1节的许可级别是设计答案,法律答案是开放的。 精神卫生支持的界限. 支助结束和治疗开始的地方,以及交割失败时由谁负责(第9.3和13.7节)。 • 儿童和不能完全同意的人。 代理授权可以做什么,以及终身记录对儿童意味着什么(第13.5和13.9条)。 • 死亡和遗产。 谁拥有一个人的纪录和死后共鸣,以及是否可以关闭或继承.

blocks.en: 17  Evaluation and Research Agenda
blocks.zh: 17. 评价和研究议程

blocks.en:
A vision has to be testable.
This section says how one would know that a symbiont has augmented a person, what should be studied next, and in what order.
blocks.zh:
一个视觉必须是可测试的。
本节说明,人们如何知道一个共鸣会增强一个人,接下来应该研究什么,以及按什么顺序研究。

blocks.en: 17.1  What to Measure
blocks.zh: 17.1 国家 衡量

blocks.en:
The most important move in the paper is a change of what is measured, from how intelligent the AI is to how much more capable the person has become.
Augmentation is the gain Δ aug ​ ( x t ) \Delta_{\mathrm{aug}}(x_{t}) of Eq. ( 2 ), and three further quantities complete it: Δ syn ​ ( x t ) \displaystyle\Delta_{\mathrm{syn}}(x_{t}) = U ⁡ ( x t , h ⊕ s ) − max ⁡ { U ⁡ ( x t , h ) , U ⁡ ( x t , s ) } , \displaystyle=U(x_{t};\,h\oplus s)-\max\{U(x_{t};\,h),\,U(x_{t};\,s)\}, (6) Δ ret ​ ( τ ) \displaystyle\Delta_{\mathrm{ret}}(\tau) = U ⁡ ( x , h τ after ) − U ⁡ ( x , h before ) , \displaystyle=U\!\left(x;\,h^{\mathrm{after}}_{\tau}\right)-U\!\left(x;\,h^{\mathrm{before}}\right), (7) Δ pers ​ ( x t ) \displaystyle\Delta_{\mathrm{pers}}(x_{t}) = U ⁡ ( x t , h ⊕ s ) − U ⁡ ( x t , h ⊕ s − ) . \displaystyle=U(x_{t};\,h\oplus s)-U(x_{t};\,h\oplus s^{-}). (8) Augmentation asks how much better the person does with the symbiont than without.
Synergy ( 6 ) asks whether the pair beats the better of the two alone, which need not be the case: a meta-analysis found that human–AI combinations are often worse than the best of the two ( Vaccaro et al., 2024 ) .
Retention ( 7 ) asks whether, after a period of use and with the symbiont removed, the person is stronger than before; both terms measure the person unaided on comparable situations x x , and τ \tau is the time since the symbiont was removed.
The personalization differential ( 8 ) asks how much of the gain comes from the person’s context, with s − s^{-} the same base model and the same agent without personal context.
Augmentation, synergy, and retention can all be positive, or one positive and two negative, and reporting only one is insufficient.
For tasks whose value lies in the person’s own experience, emotional and social ones, U ⁡ ( x t , s ) U(x_{t};\,s) has no meaning and ( 6 ) is not computed.
For the first tier, the differential ( 8 ) is the comparison to report, and its control is never “no AI”, or the capability of the model will be credited to the coupling.
This is the technical form of the sentence that AGI asks how intelligent the machine can be and AHI asks how much intelligence it can enable in a person.

blocks.en: 17.2  Dimensions of Evaluation
blocks.zh: 17.2 评价的方面

blocks.en:
Table 17 lists ten dimensions with their observables and with what each cannot establish alone.
Two are specific to this paper: the personalization differential of Section 9.1 , and the losslessness of evolution of Section 10.4 .
blocks.zh:
表17列出了10个维度及其可观测性,以及每个维度都无法单独确定的内容。
本文有两个具体内容:第9.1节的个性化差异,以及第10.4节演变的失落.

blocks.en: Table 17 : Dimensions of evaluation. Each observable is paired with what it cannot establish alone; no single dimension is sufficient.
blocks.zh: 表17:评价的方面。 每一个可观测物都与它无法单独确定的东西配对;没有一个单一的维度就足够了。

blocks.en: 17.3  How to Study a Symbiont
blocks.zh: 17.3 如何研究协同关系

blocks.en:
The unit of evaluation is one person, so the methods have to be designed for one person.
Four layers of method follow.
Component benchmarks for memory, personalization, first-person understanding, and task execution ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Salemi et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) test parts.
Simulation with generative agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) pre-screens intervention policies and tests mechanisms.
N-of-1 designs, the crossover trials medicine developed for a single patient ( Lillie et al., 2011 ) , fit the comparison “the same person, with it and without it” naturally.
Longitudinal studies in daily life over weeks and months record gains, costs, exits, and changes in behavior.
The paper’s position is that N-of-1 and longitudinal designs are the primary methods of the direction, with at least three baselines: no assistance, a generic assistant, and a personalized task agent on the same base model.
Learning effects cannot be washed out of a crossover, so conditions should be introduced in phases, with few switches, and studies of long-term use must report the people who left and the cases that went badly.
blocks.zh:
评估单位为一人,所以方法必须针对一人设计.
四层方法随顺.
记忆、个性化、第一人称理解和任务执行的组件基准(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Salemi等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年;Xie等人,2024年)测试部件。
与基因剂的模拟(Park等人,2023年)预屏干预政策和测试机制.
N-of-1的设计,即为单一患者开发的交叉试验医学(Lillie等人,2011年),自然符合“同一人,与其无关”的比较。
历时数周和数月的日常生活纵向研究记录了行为的增益、成本、退出和变化。
论文的立场是,N-of-1和纵向设计是方向的主要方法,至少有三个基线:无协助,一般助理,以及同一基模型上的个性化任务代理.
学习效果不能从交叉中冲掉,所以应该分阶段引入条件,开关很少,长期使用的研究必须报告离开的人和去向不好的病例.

blocks.en: 17.4  Open Problems
blocks.zh: 17.4 未决问题

blocks.en:
Table 18 collects twenty-three open problems in six groups: modeling a person and their record, participating in real time, learning across a life, systems and hardware, society and ethics, and governance.
Each problem names what has to be worked out and the sections it depends on, and four are starred because the first usable systems depend on them most: the modeling of a life’s record at scale, an end-to-end latency budget from sensor to ear, the cost of always-on cognition, and the iteration of wearable hardware, neural interfaces included, together with the cognitive core.
The groups are ordered from the inside of the loop outward, from the model of the person to the society around them and the rules it sets, and the roadmap of Section 17.5 places each problem at the stage of capability at which it becomes unavoidable.
blocks.zh:
表18收集了六组23个公开问题:模拟一个人及其记录、实时参与、学习人生、系统和硬件、社会和道德以及治理。
每一个问题都指需要解决的问题及其依赖的部分,四个是主演的,因为第一个可用的系统最依赖于它们:一个生命记录的规模模型化,一个从传感器到耳朵的端到端的耐久性预算,永远的认知成本,以及可穿戴的硬件,神经界面的迭代,加上认知核心.
第17.5条的路线图将每个问题置于无法避免的能力阶段。

blocks.en: Table 18 : Open problems of the paradigm, in six groups. Each problem names what has to be worked out and the sections it depends on; the starred problems are the ones on which the first usable systems most depend.
blocks.zh: 表18:模式的公开问题,分为六组。 每个问题都列出了必须解决的问题和它所依赖的部分;星形问题就是第一个可用系统最依赖的问题。

blocks.en: 17.5  A Capability Roadmap
blocks.zh: 17.5 能力路线图

blocks.en:
Figure 21 orders capabilities in six stages, from a streaming cognitive copilot on the desktop with Tier 1 by delegation, to a persistent record and model, to the device constellation, to private input, to lifelong co-adaptation, and to networks of symbionts, with the evidence needed to move from each stage to the next and the open problems mapped onto them.
The stages accumulate capability and are not a product schedule; full-duplex, private cues, and Tier 1 are requirements from the first stage onward.
blocks.zh:
图21按六个阶段排列能力,从按代表团排列的桌面上与第一级一起的流传认知副驾驶,到持续的记录和模型,到设备星座,到私人输入,到终身共适应,再到共振网络,需要从每个阶段向下一个阶段移动的证据,以及在其上绘制的公开问题。
阶段积聚能力,不是产品时间表;从第一阶段开始,完全双倍、私人提示和一级要求。

blocks.en:
Figure 21 : From components to a life.
Six stages of accumulating capability, the evidence that would justify moving to the next, and the open problems of Table 18 mapped onto them.
blocks.zh:
图21:从组件到生命。
六个阶段的积累能力,证明有理由转入下一个阶段的证据,以及表18所列的尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: 17.6  What Would Prove Us Wrong
blocks.zh: 17.6 证明我们错了什么

blocks.en:
The claims of the paper should be narrowed if any of the following holds: more personal context brings no measurable gain on most tasks, including a zero personalization differential on the first tier; timely intervention is no better than simple on-demand answering; long-term use generally erodes abilities people want to keep; value is obtained only at an unacceptable cost in surveillance or compute; people will not authorize anything above the desktop; or every change of backbone loses the relationship and cannot be prevented.
Two further conditions concern governance: assistance policies and proofs of abstention cannot be made reliable, so that a symbiont cannot be told apart from a tool for cheating; or the gains of augmentation in the main competitive settings prove to be mostly positional, so that adoption brings an arms race and no net gain.
The first six conditions correspond to dimensions of Table 17 , and the last two to the governance problems of Table 18 .
blocks.zh:
如果存在下列情况,文件的主张应该缩小: 更多的个人背景对大多数任务没有可衡量的好处,包括第一层的零个性化差异; 及时干预并不比简单的点播回答好; 长期使用一般会侵蚀人们想要保留的能力; 只有在监视或计算中以不可接受的成本获得价值; 人不会授权桌面之上的任何东西; 或 骨干的变化都会失去关系,无法阻止.
另有两个条件涉及治理:援助政策和弃权证明不能可靠,因此,除了作弊工具外,不能说出一种共鸣;或者,在主要竞争环境中,增加收益被证明主要是立场上的,因此,采用后带来军备竞赛,没有净收益。
前六个条件与表17的层面相对应,后两个条件与表18的治理问题相对应。

blocks.en: 18  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 18 结论

blocks.en:
The past decade was spent making machines more intelligent; the next is worth spending on making each particular person stronger.
As AI enters the physical world it will take two forms of intelligent individual, robots with bodies of their own and people augmented by AI, and this paper has argued for the second, giving it a name, AI-augmented human intelligence, a form, the cognitive symbiont, and a map.
A symbiont is lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive; it stands on foundation models, agents and their harnesses, memory and context engineering, world models, and wearable hardware; and it climbs a ladder from doing the person’s errands with their context in hand, to thinking a problem through with them, to holding them steady among other people.
The object of evaluation changes with it, from what the AI completes to what the person can now do, measured as augmentation, synergy, and retention.
The map has blank regions, and the three largest are the evidence on which a mind can be modeled, the timing of participation, and the stability of learning and evolution in the course of a life; the heaviest region is the governance of augmentation in the settings where people compete with and trust one another.
The paradigm will have succeeded when the sign of it is a person who has become more like who they wanted to be, and when no one mistakes that for the AI having become more like a person.
blocks.zh:
过去十年来,机器变得更加聪明;下一个十年值得花钱,使每个特定的人更加强大。
随着AI进入物理世界,它将采取两种智能个体形式,机器人有他们自己的身体和被AI所扩充的人,本文为第二种形式争论,赋予它一个名字,AI增强的人类智能,一种形式,认知共鸣,以及一张地图.
共鸣是终身的、嵌入的、实时的、私人的、低调的和主动的;它站立在基础模型、代理及其操纵器、记忆和背景工程、世界模型和可穿戴的硬件上;它爬上梯子,从用个人的背景来完成他的任务,到与他们一起思考一个问题,到在其他人中间稳住他们。
评估的对象随之而变化,从AI完成到个人现在能够做的,衡量为增强、协同和保留。
地图上有空白区域,最大的三个是可以建模心灵的证据,参与的时机,以及生活中学习和进化的稳定性;最重的区域是在人们互相竞争和信任的环境中治理增强.
当它的迹象是一个人变得更像他们想要成为的人时,当没有人犯错时,如果AI变得更像一个人,这个范式就会成功.
